articleTitle: The Impact of Federated Learning on IoT Security: An Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents how Federated Learning (FL) will be applied in multiple areas, including smart homes, work environments, and healthcare systems, to enhance the security level of Internet of Things (IoT) systems. The rising number of Internet of Things devices has put focus on obscuring and managing these connected systems as a severe security issue. Traditional centralized classifiers frequently lack the required cyber-threat vulnerability, scalability, and data protection attributes. In this way, federated learning fills the communication gap between users (aka data producers) and servers by processing data locally, and on-device study demonstrates that the FL models get a significant advantage in the performance of the false positive reduction and the threat detection accuracy in comparison with the conventional models of operation. FL, though, may not be giving 92% accurate prediction in detecting the hazards as traditional models do with 88% correct prediction. Also, FL excelled in prior models by scoring 90% in industrial settings and 89% in the hospital setting, with an accuracy of 95% in the industrial setting and 93% in a hospital.Conversely, the recognition rate for ties grew from 5% to 3%, with 2% for correctly matched tie types compared to the traditional methods at 10% for correctly matched ties and 8% for corresponding tie types. The contribution is made using a mixed-methods approach comprising simulations and experimental sets to quantify the performance of FL. INTERPRETATION: FL has proved to be the best (from the results) among other security measures because it reduces data exposure and compliance with data privacy laws (strictness).

articleTitle: A Scientometric Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Machine learning and deep learning has emerged as technological innovations transforming industries and changing landscape of the society. This review paper offers a comprehensive analysis of the present state of Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) as a burgeoning field, emphasizing its fundamentals, its workings and its types. Beginning with a literature review of ML and DL, this paper explores the core concepts underlying various ML techniques, including supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised and reinforcement learning. This study also discusses relevant topics including issues such as data privacy, security and ethical considerations inherent in ML and DL development and applications. The scientometric analysis reveals a substantial rise in ML and DL papers during the previous ten years, indicating growing interest in the field with the maximum number of documents published in the year 2023. The findings underscore the rapid growth and dynamic nature of ML and DL fields, driven by advancements in computational power and the increasing availability of big data. By analyzing recent trends and the number of publications done in the past years, this paper provides important perspective into the evolving landscape of machine learning and deep learning and its impact on society.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Gauntlet to Assist Physically Challenged and Fragile Mortals
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Individuals who are bedridden or incapacitated struggle to do particular daily tasks because they have trouble with specific hand movements. Some people can need extra help to do jobs or communicate easily. In this situation, flex sensors and an Arduino microcontroller are two features that make IoT smart gloves useful. When a person moves their fingers, the sensors detect those motions, interpret the gestures, and provide the appropriate output to an LCD monitor. The buzzer will sound, the LED will glow, and the carer will receive an emergency alert in case of an emergency. With the assistance of the smart glove, the user can utilize hand motions to turn on the fan or light.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Stroke
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Stroke is very common heath problem now. Early prediction of stroke is very essential to decrease the impact of this disease. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are very useful in making predictions for various diseases. In this paper, the power of machine learning algorithms is used for stroke prediction. Even after a lot of research the accuracy of machine learning algorithms is a challenging issue. Many researchers worked on improving the accuracy of ML models. Machine learning models worked on data sets. For stroke prediction using machine learning, a well-known data set is considered in this paper. The data set consist of many important factors which may affect the chances of stroke in a person. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree and Random Forest are three machine learning algorithms which are very popular and effective in prediction of stroke. In this work these three machine learning algorithms are applied for stroke prediction and their performance is checked and compared. From the results it is observed that the performance of Logistic Regression is best with 95.34% accuracy.

articleTitle: Quantum Machine Learning of Bigdata Set Using Randomized Measurements
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Utilizing discriminative deep belief networks (DDBNs) within the framework of semi-supervised learning, this technique leverages a combination of a limited set of labeled samples to enhance intrusion prevention efficacy while reducing recognition errors. By integrating both non-local and local regularization techniques, the method effectively tackles the inherent challenge of high error rates in cyber prevention models. Additionally, this approach is designed for implementation on Quantum Computing platforms, harnessing advanced machine learning algorithms to significantly improve cybersecurity measures.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Sugarcane Leaf Disease Prediction System for Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by sugarcane diseases, this research introduces a Sugarcane Disease Prediction System, employing deep learning through a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using TensorFlow and Keras. The CNN classifies sugarcane images into Bacterial Blight, Healthy, or Red Rot categories. The model is trained on a diverse dataset, employing data augmentation for enhanced generalization. Integrated into a Flask web application, the model enables users to upload sugarcane images, receiving disease predictions and confidence scores. This user-friendly tool aids farmers and researchers in early disease detection, contributing to precision agriculture. The system's efficacy is showcased through evaluations and visualizations of metrics, providing an automated solution for sugarcane disease prediction.

articleTitle: RSA-Based Anonymous Certificate for Security Credential Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Over the past few years, the U.S. Department of Transportation has embraced the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) 1609 series as the standard for establishing the Security Credential Management System (SCMS) in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication across the United States. Elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) has been adopted for a butterfly key expansion (BKE) method in the IEEE 1609.2.1 standard. This study proposes a RSA-based key expansion method for anonymous certificate with higher efficiency in SCMS. This paper presents mathematical principles to demonstrate the feasibility of encryption/decryption, car privacy, and method efficiency. In practical settings, our proposed method significantly improves the efficiency of the key expansion method specified in the IEEE 1609.2.1-2022 standard by thousands of times, all while maintaining the same level of security strength.

articleTitle: National Language Processing For Sentiment Analysis in Social Media-A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis (SA) is the computer study of end users' attitudes, opinions, and feelings around a certain subject or product. Sentiment analysis categorizes the message as favorable, negative, or neutral based on its polarity. Researchers have recently concentrated on sentiment analysis of social media posts using lexical and machine learning methods. Social media is a type of microblogging platform where users may leave comments in slang, which is made up of idioms, misspellings, symbols, and ironic statements. Social media data also suffer from the "curse of dimension," or the high dimensional character of the data necessitating certain extraction of features and preliminary processing processes to increase the precision of classification. Based on current research, this paper provides a thorough introduction of sentiment analysis approach. It then examines the methods of deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) in relation to sentiment analysis using social media data sets. Social media data are examined and pre-processed using the suggested framework, producing intersecting information on the strengths and weaknesses of sentiment analysis techniques.

articleTitle: Exploring the Efficacy of Various Machine Learning Approaches for Gold Price Forecasting : Insights and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The increasing prominence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) or machine learning in data analysis, particularly in Gold price forecasting, is explored in this article. With a specific focus on Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) Model, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) Model, and Categorical Boosting (CatBoost), the research delves into AI's transformative impact across various sectors globally, including agriculture, industry, and medicine. Utilizing datasets sourced from Kaggle encompassing daily gold rates from January 2013 to January 2024. The findings highlight the effectiveness of AI techniques in analyzing stock market behavior, providing valuable insights into forecasting methodologies and performance metrics such as Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Accuracy, and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) across different algorithms. The analysis is conducted using Python in Google Colab, emphasizing the practical application of AI in enhancing forecasting accuracy and informing investment decisions in the gold market.

articleTitle: Efficient Harvest to Storage: Advancing with Automated Grain Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Majority of the population in India depends on agriculture. So that the nation's economy greatly benefits from grain storage. Due to inadequate maintenance and monitoring inside the warehouse, a significant number of food grains are lost. There are critical atmospheric conditions that must be monitored and managed inside the warehouse, including temperature, humidity, and other factors. Therefore, these variables may affect the gains kept in the warehouse. In our approach, we designed a storage container using the concepts of silos and pusa bins. The redesigned bin is better since it includes multiple layers that are effective for storing grains. And as part of our strategy, we also use a few organic techniques that are safe and easily accessible. The suggested method involves taking the necessary corrective action while efficiently monitoring the atmospheric conditions inside the bin and notifying the farmer of the action's completion. With added features, this offers effective grain maintenance through a modified control atmosphere and proper storage. The temperature within the bin storage is monitored, and remedial action is taken if the environment changes. The suggested approach makes the grain in storage more consistent. This invention will maintain the quality of grains for a long period of time. The key to maintaining this state is by using modified controlled atmosphere, which provides a remarkable change in the areas of food and rural development. This storage system is highly useful and profitable to farmers and stabilizes the economy of agriculture.

articleTitle: Real-Time Hand Sign Language Translation: Text and Speech Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A real-time system that can decipher sign language from a live webcam stream is presented by the Sign Language Conversion Project. By using the Media Pipe library’s landmark identification capabilities, the project extracts crucial data from every frame, including hand landmarks. Following detection, the landmark coordinates are gathered and saved in a CSV file for later examination. This landmark data is used to train a Random Forest algorithm, which uses machine learning techniques to categorize various sign language patterns. The trained model predicts the sign language class and its probability in real-time during the processing of the webcam feed. Users get instant access to the subject’s sign language cues by superimposing the results over the live video feed. This work demonstrates the integration of computer vision and machine learning techniques to assess and comprehend nonverbal communication, with possible implications in human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Prototype of Coal Mines Safety Monitoring And Alerting System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The coal mining sector's hazardous conditions necessitate robust safety measures. IoT technology revolutionizes safety protocols by enabling gas, fire detection, temperature, humidity detection, and swift emergency responses. The work demonstrates a model prototype that collects the data from environmental changes through sensors and stores the values in the cloud. The controller can examine and take necessary actions. The prototype can be controlled by using an APP on mobile. LoRaWAN gateways ensure seamless sensor data transmission to central control, integrating with Thing Speak for real-time analysis and visualization. The system uses Arduino UNO at the transmitter end and ESP8266 at the receiver end and promptly alerts unsafe conditions and triggers automated shutdowns and evacuations during emergencies. Notably, sensors on a mobile-controlled robotic platform, facilitated by Bluetooth, offer dynamic protection, unlike static setups prone to damage during explosions. This paper addresses a comprehensive approach that enhances safety, minimizes downtime, fosters communication, and addresses privacy concerns in coal mining operations.

articleTitle: Stoneuro: Stone Detection Unveiled Through Advanced AI Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Renal lithiasis, an epidemic defined by the development of stones in the kidneys, represents an important global health issue due to its severe signs and prevalence. These stones, made from minerals including calcium, oxalate, and phosphorus, differ with regard to size and frequently lead to tremendous discomfort while they traverse the urinary tract. Being susceptible to renal lithiasis can be affected by variables like dehydration, eating habits, heredity, and age, with males demonstrating higher risk. Kidney stone detection that is both accurate and early is essential for prompt intervention. Our paper presents a novel deep learning method for nephrolith diagnosis that makes use of the VGG16, MobileNetV2, and a Convolutional Neural Network models. These models have been instructed using medical pictures (CT scans) to recognize the presence of calculus, cancerous growths, or cyst in the kidneys. Our results demonstrate the superior performance of CNN, achieving an accuracy of 98%, followed by VGG16 (96%) and MobileNetV2 (94%). The high accuracy of the CNN model showers its potential in terms of a powerful tool to aid medical professionals in diagnosing renal lithiasis and guiding appropriate treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Multi-class Waste Segregation using EfficientNetb3 Model through Waste Segregation Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Efficient waste segregation is critical for successful recycling and sustainable waste management methods. In this paper, we investigate the use of EfficientNetB3, a cutting-edge deep learning model, to obtain high accuracy in trash segregation tasks. Using the Adam optimizer and training the model for 30 epochs, achieving 97% accuracy rate in categorising various waste types. The Adam optimizer's adaptive learning rate approach improves model efficiency and convergence, allowing for rapid training and durable performance. Deep learning algorithms, particularly EfficientNetB3, have the potential to automate trash segregation procedures, streamline recycling efforts, and enhance environmental sustainability. This study helps to advance intelligent waste management systems by demonstrating the efficacy of AI-driven approaches in addressing difficult environmental concerns. Future research will concentrate on incorporating AI technology into practical problems waste management infrastructures to improve efficiency and support circular economy concepts.

articleTitle: Strategic Deployment of Deep Learning Algorithms to Mitigate Fraud in Online Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Today, the continuously growing number of clients and transactions that involve financial services over the internet makes it extremely vulnerable to fraud-related hazards. The conventional techniques of fraud-fighting enable a certain degree of fraud check yet these strategies prove to be considerably bland in the fight against fraud. This study seeks to determine the applicability of deploying deep learning algorithms for improving fraud identification within the online finance industry. Using a range of paradigms, including CNNs, LSTMs, and autoencoders, we examined various highly descriptive models with an extensive dataset of financial transactions. Our results demonstrate that the LSTM model achieved the highest performance, with an accuracy of 95.8%, precision of 86.3%, recall of 79.4%, F1-score of 82.7%, and AUC-ROC of 0.936. The CNN model also performed well, attaining an accuracy of 95.2%, precision of 84.1%, recall of 77.8%, F1-score of 80.8%, and AUC-ROC of 0.924. The autoencoder effectively identified anomalies, achieving an accuracy of 94.8%, precision of 83.2%, recall of 76.5%, F1score of 79.7%, and AUC-ROC of 0.918. Comparative analysis with state-of-the-art methods highlighted the superiority of deep learning models in detecting fraudulent transactions. The study shows that machine learning algorithms can revolutionize the approaches to fraud detection while increasing the efficiency of the approaches dramatically. However, the following limitations are observed; these include the difficulties experienced in model interpretability and scalability for large data sets. This work advances the field of interactions by enhancing the design and implementation of intelligent systems for the identification of fraud attempts and their minimization in the future, thus minimizing the level of losses of online financial services and strengthening user confidence in secure and reliable online platforms. Therefore, it remained evident that such concerns need to be addressed to apply these sophisticated methods in real-life operational financial situations in future research.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Optimized Controller For PV Fed High Gain Converter For Off-Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Off-grid power stations are independent energy systems that function autonomously from the centralized electrical grid. These setups are particularly useful in isolated locations where linking to the main grid is either impractical or too costly. They are also crucial in scenarios where the main grid’s reliability is compromised, such as during emergencies. These are supported by energy storage solutions such as battery banks and sometimes supplemented by conventional generators for additional backup. The renewable components primarily generate electricity when environmental conditions are favorable—during sunny or windy periods, for example. Energy storage systems, on the other hand, are critical for supplying power during times when renewable output is low. These installations are increasingly common across diverse sectors, including rural electrification projects, telecommunications infrastructure, and mining sites. Furthermore, there’s a growing trend in more developed regions for both residential and commercial entities to adopt off-grid solutions, driven by a combination of energy autonomy aspirations and the escalating costs associated with traditional grid electricity. Designing an off-grid station demands a comprehensive assessment of the specific energy needs of the application, the consistent availability of local renewable energy sources, and the capacity limits of the storage technologies employed. The system’s reliability and maintainability are paramount considerations, especially in remote areas where professional maintenance services might not be readily available. This approach ensures that off-grid power stations are both functional and sustainable, catering effectively to the unique demands of their users.

articleTitle: YogaPoseVision: MobileNetV3-Powered CNN for Yoga Pose Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Yoga is a popular type of meditation and exercise that has several health advantages. Recent developments in deep learning and computer vision have made it possible to automatically recognise and classify yoga poses, providing instructors and practitioners with useful resources and increasing life expectancy. This article suggests a unique method for classifying yoga poses using the MobileNetV3 architecture and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The durable and lightweight model that is appropriate for real-time applications is developed by utilising the MobileNetV3 architecture, which is widely recognized for its efficiency and accuracy. Through the use of transfer learning techniques, the model is fine-tuned on a specialized dataset of photographs depicting yoga poses after being pretrained on a sizable dataset of different images to extract generic features. The collection is made up of annotated photos of numerous yoga positions in a range of variations and difficulty levels. In terms of precisely categorizing yoga postures, the suggested CNN architecture with MobileNetV3 shows encouraging results, attaining high classification accuracy while retaining computational efficiency. To evaluate the model's ability to identify between various yoga positions, performance evaluation metrics like precision, recall, and F1-score are used. In general, the incorporation of CNNs into the MobileNetV3 architecture signifies a noteworthy development in the automation of yoga posture classification, hence further advancing computer vision technologies related to health and wellness.

articleTitle: A Pragmatic Enquiry to Learn Recent Trends in Insider Threat Detection Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Insider threat has become a recurring and serious challenge faced by organization throughout the world. It shows an increasing trend from 2003 onwards. Due to the widespread use of internet, the hackers and intruders crept into network system and its trend also increased continuously. To resist the issues of insider threat, enterprises adopted and implemented many intrusion detection and prevention mechanisms, which can be classified as traditional and modern security solutions. The insiders have legitimate access to the vital information system of an organization. It is noted that not all the insiders are threat to an enterprise. Only a minority group, who for the materialization of their personal gains, misuse their given administrative rights to access the sensitive resources of an enterprise. They either evade or hide themselves from being caught for their malevolent deeds by utilizing their legitimate access rights. Hence, their malicious activities go undetected, which cause greater damages to every organization and thus the prevailing threat detection and prevention mechanisms remain ineffective. Another reason for inefficacy of the various threat detection and prevention approaches is the lack of hand-to-hand awareness about the factors governing the formulation of threat detection and prevention approaches. Hence, this review presents an account of these factors in recent threat detection literature, by giving an overview of insider threat events, actors, insider threat detection techniques, datasets used for training and testing, feature domains, and performance metrics used to measure the accuracy of the models proposed. This study also envisages that our review on the insider threat will help the researchers in this field to get more clarity about the factors to be considered to frame effective threat detection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Obesity Risk in Older Adults using XGBoost Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Obesity is a complex disorder caused by hereditary, environmental, and behavioural factors. This work proposes a solid predictive model for assessing obesity risk, with a stunning 96% accuracy rate. The model use machine learning approaches to categorise individuals into different obesity risk categories based on pertinent variables such as demographic information, lifestyle habits, and medical history. The generated model predicts obesity risk levels with improved accuracy thanks to thorough data preparation, feature engineering, and model optimisation. With an accuracy of 96%, the model assists healthcare providers in identifying individuals with varied levels of obesity risk, allowing for focused interventions and personalised health management plans. Further research and validation efforts are needed to evaluate the model's efficacy across varied populations and healthcare contexts, assuring wider acceptance and applicability in real-world healthcare practice.

articleTitle: Smart Waste Management: VGG16-Based Classification System for Organic and Recyclable Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In today’s world, waste management is a major concern, and efficient trash classification and sorting are becoming more and more necessary. This work uses the VGG16 deep learning architecture to offer a novel garbage classification method that focuses on organic and recyclable materials. Convolutional neural networks like VGG16 are well-known for their superior performance in image classification applications. The goal of this project is to create an accurate and effective automated garbage sorting system based on visual analysis of waste photos by utilising the VGG16 model. The process entails using a dataset of photos of different waste items to train the VGG16 model, with a focus on organic and recyclable material differentiation. The collection has been carefully selected to contain a variety of garbage products that are frequently seen in actual waste management situations. The VGG16 model is extensively trained and fine-tuned, enabling the system to identify important visual cues linked to the categories of organic and recyclable garbage. Evaluating the efficacy of the suggested trash classification system involves employing metrics like F1score, recall, accuracy, and precision. Furthermore, testing on unknown datasets and cross-validation are used to evaluate the model’s robustness and generalization abilities. The outcomes show how well the VGG16-based method works to precisely identify and classify recyclable and organic waste materials with high recall rates.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a LoRa-Based Remote Health Monitoring System with Emergency Alert Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Saving human lives is essential in the field of medical science. Engineering technologies support to achieve this goal. This article explores the integration of Internet of Things and LoRa technology in hospital wristbands to enhance patient care and streamline healthcare operations. The proposed system employs Arduino Pro Mini microcontrollers and LoRa1276 in the LoRa enabled Patient Wrist Band Module (LPWM) to facilitate real-time monitoring of patient vital signs, such as temperature and pulse. The acquired data is transmitted wirelessly to a central nursing station. In the nursing station, a Raspberry Pi equipped with a LoRa receiver device consolidates and displays the data. Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm is used in Raspberry Pi to prioritize patient care based on predefined parameters. The integration of Explainable AI in the receiver module enhances the transparency and trustworthiness of AI-driven recommendations. This supports personalized patient care. This comprehensive approach aims to bridge the healthcare gap in ensuring efficient resource allocation and improved patient outcomes through advanced technological solutions.

articleTitle: Optimized NLP Model with Caching, Parallel Processing and Streamlined I/O
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research explores optimization strategies employed within Quesgen.ai, an advanced question generation system driven by natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning (ML) algorithms. The study delves into three pivotal areas of optimization: caching, parallel processing, and streamlining I/O operations. By implementing caching mechanisms using Python’s functool.lru_cache, parallelization via concurrent.futures and multiprocessing modules, and streamlining I/O operations through efficient batching and buffering techniques, significant enhancements in time and space complexity are realized. The effectiveness of these optimization approaches is empirically evaluated, showcasing their profound impact on the efficiency and scalability of the Quesgen.ai platform. This research contributes to the advancement of question generation systems, providing valuable insights into effective optimization strategies for NLP applications, such as question generation, semantic analysis, and language modeling.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Smart Traffic Signal Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Traffic congestion is becoming a critical issue with the increasing usage of vehicles. The rapid increase in vehicles has naturally led to traffic congestion all over the world. The traffic congestion forcing people to sit idle in their vehicles, consuming more fuel, and increase of air pollution. Traffic light control policies are not optimized, leading vehicles to wait pointlessly for non- existent traffic to pass on the crossing road. The current traffic signal systems follow fixed timing patterns that are not adjusted depending up on the volume of vehicles present on the traffic junction. Traffic light control policies can be greatly improved by implementing Deep learning (DL) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) concepts. Reinforcement Learning has become a popular method for controlling traffic signals in recent times as it can learn the best control policies through practical experience. By using RL, this research work aims to enhance traffic control efficiency and minimize issues such as delays, traffic congestion, fuel consumption, and pollution. The goal of this proposed work is to reduce the cumulative waiting time of vehicles at the junctions. Waiting time, Reward, Queue Length are considered as performance metrics. Moreover, the proposed approach is designed to be cost-effective and can be implemented in real-time systems.

articleTitle: Anemia Estimation Using Eye Conjunctiva Image: A Comparative Study Of Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Worldwide, anemia is a prevalent medical ailment that is defined by a lack of hemoglobin or red blood cells. Effective treatment and the avoidance of consequences depend on the early recognition and management of anemia. In this work, we propose comparing the Convolutional Neural Network, also called the CNN and EfficientNet models for estimation of anemia from eye conjunctival image. The conjunctiva is a readily accessible tissue that reflects systemic hemoglobin levels and is thus suitable for non-invasive anemia assessment. We collected a dataset of eye conjunctiva images from patients with varying degrees of anemia and healthy individuals. Our experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of both CNN and EfficientNet architectures in accurately estimating anemia from conjunctiva images, with the CNN approximately 85% for the model and roughly 90% for the EfficientNet model in terms of accuracy. However, we observed that the EfficientNet model outperformed the CNN model in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. Our findings suggest that deep learning models, particularly EfficientNet, hold promise for automated anemia estimation, offering a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in resource limited settings where traditional diagnostic methods may be inaccessible or impractical.

articleTitle: Medicare: A telemedicine healthcare website
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Despite the advancement of technology, the modern healthcare system still has many limitations. In order to address many unresolved issues, the world is moving toward digitalized systems, including the healthcare system. A telemedicine system would greatly benefit society if developed to be inexpensive, easily accessible, and equipped with substantial, dependable medical resources. This paper explores existing research on telemedicine within healthcare management systems (HMS) and the services it offers. Traditional healthcare has limitations in accessibility and keeps evolving with technology. Telemedicine addresses these limitations by providing convenient, affordable, and dependable medical services. Like other communication technologies, telemedicine is intended for wider adoption and use. Our web application "Medicare", incorporates features related to HMS that will significantly improve the usability and reliability of this technology management system. This research identified similar existing applications, and additional functionalities are implemented to make the telemedicine website more impactful and relevant for future needs.

articleTitle: Optimizing and Improving Unified Power Quality (UPQC) for Mitigation of Voltage Drop
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Now-a-days, Power system is progressively improving addicted to a power electronic based power system and survive various power quality issues, which encourages the expansion of active power filter (APF). APF has improved into a Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC). Voltage drops and swells are universal power quality issues in 3-phase electrical distribution systems, causing equipment malfunction and process disruption. This paper proposes a UPQC to compensate power quality issues in a 3ph3w distribution system. The UPQC integrates a shunt and series active power filter (APF), linked nonstop via a DC-link capacitor. The series filter of the UPQC adds a proper voltage component to retain a constant sinusoidal voltage at the load terminal, whereas shunt filter handles fluctuations in power demand. The capability of the proposed method is evaluated through comprehensive simulation studies in MATLAB/Simulink and enhancing power quality and protecting sensitive loads. The implementation process of various considerations, including topology selection and control algorithm design; crucial for optimizing UPQC performance. Successful voltage regulation is achieved during specified voltage drop and swell.

Author Keywords: series and shunt active power filter (SAPF)

articleTitle: Event Management System Using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This project depicts how Artificial intelligence is used in developing a "User-Engaging Event Management System". The developed system will spontaneously record all the events and online contests registered by an individual. Motivates the individual to participate the particular event by providing sufficient resources. It implements a persistent alarm or remainder system that operates continuously. The implementation of the system starts with choosing appropriate technologies (Deep learning Libraries, Natural Language Processor, DBMS, Web Development Framework and so on) focusing on generative AI followed by data collection (from existing event data, social media, crowdsourcing and so on) and preprocessing the data to ensure the quality for AI model training which integrates with app architecture. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the generative AI model in Event Management App by employing key numerical metrices. The accuracy metric gauges the model’s overall correctness in generating event-related content, while precision focuses on the accuracy of positive predictions. It incorporates a robust feedback mechanism ,allowing users to provide input and receive corresponding responses, enhancing the overall user experience. The system will provide security for user information, access controls, and authentication protocols

articleTitle: HRES based Battery System with Optimal ANFIS-MPPT for Microgrid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Microgrid represents a transformative localized energy management system that combines multiple Renewable Energy Sources (RESs) to provide a sustainable and reliable energy distribution. The proposed work focuses on an innovative microgrid architecture that incorporates Hybrid RES system such as Photovoltaic (PV), Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) and Fuel Cell (FC) as primary energy sources, while Battery serves as secondary sources, respectively. With the integration of Battery, the intermittency of power supply induced by the primary sources is subdued and stable power supply is ensured. Additionally, by avoiding the use of PV converter, the proposed work also aims to provide a cost effective solution for the integration of PV to microgrid. Moreover, with the application of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) based Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) for extracting optimal power from the PV system. The fuel cell is interfaced to the DC link via a Boot converter, whereas, battery is interfaced to the DC link via a Bidirectional Converter (BDC). Additionally, Proportional Integral (PI) based droop control approach is employed for the control of BDC. The proposed microgrid also features Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) controller to facilitate effective grid integration. To analyze the efficacy of the proposed microgrid architecture and its control methodology, MATLAB simulation is employed.

Author Keywords: PI Controller and Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG)

articleTitle: Application Monitoring and Telemetry Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In today's fast-paced software development landscape, the importance of robust monitoring solutions cannot be overstated. To achieve comprehensive observability in complex, distributed systems, it is essential to know how to connect Kafka for data streaming, OpenTelemetry for instrumentation, Prometheus for metrics gathering, and Grafana for visualization. With Kafka, data can be transmitted between dispersed systems with ease and real-time insights into the behavior of applications are obtained. OpenTelemetry gathers telemetry information from multiple sources, providing thorough insight into performance indicators and facilitating the tracking of requests throughout microservices. As a central point for metrics collecting, Prometheus collects information on the health of the system and the performance of applications. Real-time issue detection and decision-making are facilitated by Grafana's visualization capabilities, which transform this data into actionable insights. In today's cutthroat market, this alignment is essential to meeting service level agreements (SLAs), accomplishing company objectives, and providing great user experiences. By adopting a holistic approach to monitoring and leveraging real-time insights, organizations can enhance system reliability, agility, and performance, ultimately driving business success in the digital era.

articleTitle: Intelligent MPPT Controller for PV with Energy Storage System Fed UPQC System for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In a time when energy demands are growing and sustainability is becoming more and more important, making the best use of electrical resources is essential. Modern grid systems are placing an increasing emphasis on power quality and the integration of renewable energy sources. The objective of this study is to enhance the integration of renewable energy sources and power quality in a three-phase grid system. The report contains several important elements to guarantee the effective use of renewable energy and address power quality concerns. Power quality issues such as voltage swells and sags impact the grid system, despite being the main source of electricity. Power quality is enhanced by the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC’s) core, which consists of both series and shunt converters. The series converter is essential for preventing voltage spikes and falls, ensuring a steady and dependable power source. The shunt converter is in charge of reactive power compensation and harmonic mitigation at the same time. To capture solar energy, the system is equipped with solar panels. To optimize the power generation from these panels, a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controller with an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) is employed. This controller increases the energy generation’s efficiency. The DC-DC Luo converter is responsible for maintaining a constant DC link voltage. It ensures effective power transmission while managing the energy flow between the solar panels and the grid. When needed, the Bi-Directional Battery Converter makes it easier to discharge stored energy back into the grid and stores surplus energy produced by the PV system. It serves as an energy buffer to improve grid stability and encourage energy-saving practices. Concurrently, the system ensures ecologically friendly and sustainable power generation by optimizing the use of renewable energy sources. This paper is finally developed in MATLAB Simulation 2021a, and various situations are tested to get the desired results. An improved load voltage and current THD value of 0.67% and 1.49% are produced by the proposed UPFC system and the efficiency achieved with the Luo converter is 93%.

articleTitle: Fairness in CPU Scheduling: A Probabilistic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel CPU scheduling algorithm for uniprocessor systems that employs a probabilistic function to enhance fair resource allocation. Unlike traditional algorithms, our approach specifically tackles the challenge of equitable resource distribution by integrating a probabilistic methodology whilst also keeping the priority of each process in mind. We detail the implementation and evaluate its performance against established algorithms, assessing metrics such as average turnaround time, average waiting time and the gini index. All the related code, data used for testing and a working webpage to try out the algorithm first hand can be found at GitHub.

articleTitle: Detection of Counterfeit Products with QR Codes using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Supply chain management commonly encounters challenges such as duplicate products and a lack of standardization due to insufficient transparency. This creates problem in the supply chain which takes up valuable time and resources. The presence of counterfeit products adds on to these issues, which are very difficult to distinguish visually from the real ones. This paper focuses on providing a solution to this already existing problem by implementing a QR based detection method which uses blockchain technology. The paper provides a thorough analysis of the current scenario of fake products present in the supply chain management system and proposes a novel method for robust detection. This is achieved using blockchain technology, which guarantees the traceability and identification of genuine products all the way through the supply chain. A Blockchain-based system decentralizes information, allowing multiple parties simultaneous access. Novel advantage of the proposed system is the difficulty of altering recorded data without the consensus of all concerned parties, providing a high level of security and protection against vulnerabilities. This system can be readily integrated into the supply chain to identify fake products that are often used for impersonation or fraud.

articleTitle: Enhanced PV Grid-Connected System with Adaptive MPPT and Harmonic Mitigation Capability using High Gain Interleaved Cuk Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Solar energy is pivotal in renewable energy systems (RES) due to its clean, sustainable nature, and its rising demand, fuelled by escalating electricity costs, underscores its significance. Photovoltaic (PV) arrays, central to solar energy harnessing, exhibit varying output characteristics influenced by environmental changes. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) approaches are essential for optimizing power extraction. Considering current MPPT techniques, a new Incremental Conductance (INC) MPPT algorithm was developed, integrating adaptive variable step size, is introduced. This algorithm dynamically adjusts step size through a coefficient, eliminating the need for user-defined constants, thus streamlining PV system design. This study proposes an Interleaved Cuk Converter (ICC) to mitigate input current ripple and enhance transient response. Additionally, the linear relationship between MPP voltage and open-circuit voltage is used to generate a tuning strategy for initial step sizes. A PI controller controls the inverter gating sequence and the proposed system is validated through MATLAB simulation. Comparative analysis reveals the proposed INC method's superior dynamic response and steady-state performance, especially during extreme irradiance fluctuations. The proposed converter achieves a efficiency of 92.47% and proposed controller achieves accuracy of 90.64%.

articleTitle: DrownNet: Infant Drowning Alert System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Infant Drowning Prevention System (IDPS) is a vital innovation aimed at combating the tragic loss of young lives due to drowning incidents. The Infant Drowning Prevention and Alert System (IDPAS) is a crucial innovation designed to prevent the tragic loss of young lives due to drowning incidents. By leveraging advanced Video Vision Transformers (VVTs), the IDPAS accurately detects potential drowning behaviors in infants and toddlers, ensuring swift alerts to caregivers for timely intervention. Its Smart Watching System, powered by sophisticated deep learning algorithms like CNNs and RNNs, continuously monitors video streams for subtle cues indicative of distress in water. Through ongoing learning from annotated examples and historical data, the IDPAS refines its ability to differentiate between safe interactions and risky situations, enabling rapid alerts via SMS, push notifications, or audible alarms upon detecting potential drowning events.Administrators can easily configure settings through a streamlined web interface, while pool managers have a dedicated dashboard for camera setups and emergency contacts. Caregivers receive instant alerts via SMS, email, or in-app notifications, empowering quick responses to risks. Data privacy and security are prioritized, to protect sensitive information, ensuring compliance with regulations while significantly enhancing infant safety.The proposed DrownNet system within the IDPAS offers an impressive 96% accuracy compared to other models in the literature, highlighting its quality and completeness. The integration of high accuracy, real-time monitoring, and user-friendly interface makes the IDPAS an essential tool for drowning prevention, providing comprehensive coverage and reliable alerts to prevent potential drowning incidents effectively.

Author Keywords: Infant Drowning Prevention and Alert System (IDPAS)

articleTitle: Advances in Early Detection and Monitoring of Retinopathy in Preterm Infants Using CNN and MLP Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research showcases significant advancements in the timely identification and monitoring of retinopathy among preterm infants through the integration of Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models. We eradicate the necessity for subjective assessments by ensuring a precise and automated diagnosis through the implementation of these contemporary models. The CNN is capable of extracting robust features from retinal images, and the MLP model enhances the predictive precision and monitoring functionalities even further. By integrating these models, our approach enhances the precision and velocity of retinopathy diagnosis, thereby resulting in improved therapeutic outcomes. The proposed framework significantly improves neonatal care by incorporating cutting-edge technology that enables continuous and advanced detection of retinopathy in premature infants.

articleTitle: Spot Light: A Disaster Safety Assistance Mobile Application with Disaster Alert, Rescue Center Search, Relief Apply, and Seeking Help Features
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Climate change, deforestation, pollution, and geographical land characteristics have all contributed to a variety of disasters in South Asia. Humans can suffer a variety of consequences from disasters, including loss of life and property. The existing disaster-related work did not deliver an online-based disaster safety assistance system for citizens that included features like immediate disaster alerts, rescue center searches, relief fund transfer facilities, online relief application features for low-income people, volunteer job applications, necessary contact numbers, safety tips, inquiries, and help-seeking message posts. To resolve the existing limitations, this article inaugurates a disaster safety assistance mobile application that includes disaster-affected and needy people status checking, rescue and relief center search based on date, location, and shelter information, relief fund transfer, online relief application, disaster-related inquiry and response, emergency help message posting, existing system facility check, volunteer job application, and contact number. The app provides convenience, potential, and readiness analysis. According to the results, more than 52% of evaluators provided highly pleasing feedback on the proposed disaster safety assistance application.

articleTitle: Analyzing Dual-Stage Inverter Performance for Solar Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the performance of dual-stage inverters in the context of solar grid integration through simulation. Dual-stage inverters are increasingly recognized for their potential to enhance the efficiency and reliability of solar power systems by mitigating grid disturbances and optimizing energy extraction. Through detailed simulation studies, this research evaluates key performance metrics such as grid stability, power quality, and energy conversion efficiency. The simulation environment enables the exploration of various operational scenarios and system configurations to assess the versatility and robustness of dual-stage inverter solutions. Furthermore, the study investigates the impact of control strategies and parameter variations on the overall performance of dual-stage inverters, providing valuable insights for system optimization and design.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Optimized AXI using Verilog
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Optimization of Throughput and Delay is a crucial need in any SoC system. In order to achieve an appreciable performance in the exchange of data between the components of a AXI(advanced eXtensible Interface) Protocol is widely used to facilitate the communication between functional blocks of SoC systems. AXI (advanced eXtensible Interface) protocol is a high – speed standard which assists in transfer of multiple data items between source (master) and destination (slave). Major signals which are used in AXI are "Valid", "Ready" and "Response". After completion of a transaction successfully to the slave, master can proceed with its next burst of transaction only after getting a feedback from the slave which indicates its readiness to accept next transaction. In most of the cases, master has to wait for the response from the slave thereby creating a delay in the operation affecting the overall Performance of the system. In order to address the issues pertaining to the delay, we have proposed an AXI model which employs a counter that automatically decrements its value after completion of every single successful transaction to the slave. The master can proceed with its next transaction when the counter value decrements to zero without waiting for the response from slave.

articleTitle: Augmented-High Resolution Network for Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures have shown superior performance in computer vision. But in semantic segmentation, CNN based models suffer from loss of contextual information due to reduction in resolution. High Resolution Network (HRNet) addresses this issue by preserving parallel processing layers at high resolution, but it also suffers from loss of information due to low and high resolution fusion. In this work, a unique approach to do semantic segmentation of images using Augmented HRNet (Au-HRNet) is presented. To prevent information loss during fusion of low resolution with high we have added channel and spatial attention blocks. These blocks are added at each stage and within the fusion module. The augmented HRNet output is then passed to contextual representation segmentation header. By enriching pixel through weighted aggregation using object contextual representation, pixel’s label matching to the object category is ensured. Through this approach, we have achieved improved results on widely used datasets like PASCAL VOC+AUG and PASCAL CONTEXT.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Models for Intrusion Detection in Industrial IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Industrial Internet of Things has emerged as an essential tool for building Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0 where timely information can be retrieved from different scenarios. These devices are highly vulnerable to cyberattacks as heterogeneous types of devices can be used in the infrastructure that may or may not be equipped with standardized security protocols. Artificial intelligence-based methodologies can effectively identify these types of attacks on a prior basis for taking mitigation action. This method raises concerns about data privacy as building a machine learning-based method requires the sharing of network data that can reveal the actual information of industries. The proposed Federated Learning based framework handles this concern by preserving each device’s critical data by utilizing the benefits of the decentralized model aggregation. This research work presents the comparison of the proposed framework on the CICIoT2023 dataset with federated averaging and federated proximal techniques for achieving a global model. The performance evaluation of these two aggregation techniques is performed based on metrics of accuracy, loss, precision and recall. The results prove that the federated proximal method achieves higher accuracy in comparison to the federated averaging method.

articleTitle: Assessment and Evaluation of Music Genre Classification by employing various AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Music genre classification, the task of automatically assigning audio recordings to specific genres, offers exciting possibilities for music recommendation systems, personalized playlists, and music analysis. This abstract explores the potential of (K-NN), a versatile Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithm, in tackling this challenge- NN excels in its simplicity and interpretability. It classifies new music by identifying its closest neighbors within a labeled dataset based on predefined features, such as tempo, timbre, or spectral content. These neighbors then collectively "vote" on the genre of the new piece. The abstract delves into the feature engineering process, highlighting the crucial role of selecting relevant musical characteristics for accurate classification. Furthermore, the abstract discusses the impact of the "K" hyper parameter, which determines the number of neighbors considered in the voting process. Choosing the optimal "K" value balances accuracy and sensitivity to genre nuances. While K-NN offers advantages in ease of implementation and understanding, the abstract acknowledges its potential drawbacks. The storage requirements can be high for large datasets, and computational costs may increase with data size. It concludes by acknowledging the need for further research to address computational challenges and explore advanced feature engineering techniques to unlock the full potential of K-NN in this exciting domain.

articleTitle: Beyond the Pixels: Detecting Originality and Assessing Product Condition using Digital Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach using digital image processing for product management, focusing on authenticity verification and quality assessment. Advanced algorithms distinguish genuine from fraudulent products and evaluate their condition. The study highlights the potential of digital image processing to enhance supply chain security and consumer trust, promising significant business impacts by reducing counterfeit circulation, improving brand reputation, and optimizing inventory management

articleTitle: Comparative Performance of Random Forest versus Gradient Boosting Machines in Detecting Financial Fraud
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The detection of fraud conducted through financial operations is still a hard problem for financial institutions with global activity, the problem being the complexity and the scale of the operations. This research focuses on the assessment of the efficacy of ensemble methods especially Random Forest and GBM in detecting and blocking such cases. This paper uses a thorough dataset of different types of financial transactions to study this phenomenon, introduces and evaluates these methods, and analyzes their operational implications in the practical environment. The report analytics derived from the study demonstrate that both Random Forest and GBM performed equally well, with GBM indicating the highest accuracy. The models got high AUC-ROC of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, and exhibited decreased logarithmic loss and high MCC, which demonstrated their fractionation ability in distinguishing fake transactions. This evidence implies that artificial neural networks, sometimes referred to as ensemble methods, may be suitable for fraud detection in complex financial networks, providing versatile and efficient solutions that can easily adapt to changing trading environments. Firstly, the study confirms the high effectiveness of these methods in fraud detection; secondly, it focuses on the practical aspect of their implementation which offers useful information for financial institutions looking to improve their fraud prevention practices.

articleTitle: Assessment of Lead Contaminant in Ground Water using Image Processing and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Water is a precious gift from the nature which is very essential for every living being on the earth. However this valuable source is polluted by various activities of human which adversely affects the eco system. Hence monitoring the quality of the water is necessary in global scenario. The assessment of water quality is done through laboratory procedure which is time consuming and requires expertise. Hence this study attempts to develop simplistic methodology for the assessment of water quality. As an initial phase, the research focuses on assessing the toxicity level of the ground water particularly Lead. To estimate the metal contamination, Araceae species such as Lemna Minor which has phytoremediation property is grown in the synthetically prepared water sample of various concentrations of Lead. The growth of the plant is analyzed using image processing techniques and the toxicity level is classified using k-NN, SVM and Logistic regression algorithms. The contamination is classified in to two - low and high level. The classification accuracy achieved with these methodologies is 90 % for all the classifiers.

articleTitle: Efficiency And Reliability Enhancement in HVDC-VSC Power Transmission Network with Control And Planning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The significant roles, technical advantages, and high efficiency of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems have led to their global application. In most cases, the HVDC network improves the utilization of HVAC systems by connecting two distinct but complementary technical features. A regulated converter circuit serves as the join point system for connecting HVAC lines to HVDC. There are detrimental impacts on the electrical power quality of the systems linked on either end of the HVDC network, despite the use's significance and the link's considerable advantages. Both conventional and alternative approaches have been considered and implemented to improve the electrical grid's subpar performance. On the other hand, the system typically has to synthesise the assumption of load circumstances in order to make the improvement. This study introduces a novel approach that makes use of a real-time control mechanism. With the help of the EMTDC model, the controller is utilized, and its capacity to monitor setpoints associated with active power, reactive power, and other variables that are appropriate is evaluated. Considering the effectiveness of the suggested superior outcomes are achieved by the controller proposed in the work, which had a greater margin of stability and a shorter time having optimized response for the system.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Weather Prediction in India
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Weather prediction is crucial in India due to its diverse geographical and climatic conditions. Over the recent years, machine learning has demonstrated remarkable advancements in enhancing the reliability and accuracy of weather forecasting. However, India's geographical and climatic diversity necessitates the identification of algorithms capable of providing accurate forecasts across various regions and seasons. To address this, a comprehensive comparative study was conducted, delving into the effectiveness of different machine learning algorithms for weather prediction across India. This study examines how these algorithms perform across the intricate landscape of the country, considering factors like temperature, humidity, air pressure and precipitation. By evaluating their performance under different conditions, this research aims to identify the most suitable algorithms for accurate and reliable weather forecasting across India, making it easier for researchers to analyze data source sensitivity and algorithm suitability for different types of weather parameters and the associated datasets.

articleTitle: Land Surface Temperature Dynamics and Flood Mapping Insights across Andhra Pradesh using Google Earth Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper focuses on environmental monitoring in Andhra Pradesh, India, utilizing remote sensing methodologies This consists of flood detection using satellite radar imagery and analysis of land surface temperature (LST) with satellite thermal data. The flood detection algorithm identifies flooded areas, employing radar data processing techniques to discern inundated regions. Concurrently, the LST analysis tracks temperature variations across the region. By converting temperature data to Celsius and visualizing trends over time, the project facilitates insights into environmental changes. The collective analysis offers a comprehensive understanding of environmental dynamics in Andhra Pradesh, crucial for informed decision-making. Applications include disaster management, where flood detection aids in emergency response efforts, and agriculture, where temperature analysis supports crop monitoring and planning. Furthermore, the insights provided contribute to climate monitoring initiatives, aiding in the assessment of long-term environmental trends and facilitating proactive measures for sustainability and resilience.

articleTitle: Watermarking Three-Dimensional NOC Architecture to Detect Malicious Intellectual Property
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study offers a novel 3D representation for network-on-chip (NOC) routering in contrast to traditional 2D models. The goal is to increase data transfer acceleration, productivity, reliability, and cost- effectiveness, particularly by lessening the impact of Trojan-infected files. By utilizing a three-dimensional routing architecture, the suggested NOC design enhances communication channels and interconnection, lowering latency and increasing data transfer speeds. The 3D NOC router exhibits enhanced resilience against Trojan attacks by integrating fault- tolerant techniques and innovative routing algorithms, all while preserving reduced power use and area overhead. Building system-on-chips with intellectual property from third parties has become a global trend, raising serious concerns about security vulnerabilities. In this work, we suggest a low-tech alternative defense strategy based on digital watermarking. Realistic SOC models and experiments in a range of applications demonstrate that our solution can considerably. Based on analytical results, the designed routing algorithm reduces total pin count by 58%, total logic element count by 2%, total memory bit count by 1%, reduces latency by 15%, reduces power consumption by 13.5%, and reduces area overhead by 65%.Hence this works is applicable in data security in wireless communication and wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Matrix Factorization vs. Deep Learning Autoencoders: A Performance Analysis in E-commerce Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The development of sophisticated recommendation algorithms has taken place due to the evolution of online shopping platforms that aim to offer personalized content to users to improve their engagement and satisfaction. This research paper examines the efficacy of two prominent collaborative filtering techniques: traditional matrix factorization and different types of deep learning-based autoencoders are being discussed within the aspect of the e-commerce recommendation system. The comparative approach of this research shall help evaluate the efficiency of each approach toward problem resolutions such as data scarcity, scalability, and popularity fluctuation. The demonstrated value of the matrix factorization model (as the consequence of its broad use and the proven history of success with processing big datasets) makes it the initial functional model choice; the autoencoder model assumes a stand-in position to prove its capability to approximate complex, non-linear dependencies between data entries which other models may underline. The evaluation of the models was based on mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), and normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG) across an available e-commerce dataset divided into training and test sets that are open to the public. The result shows that the “deep learning-based autoencoder model” approach gets better scores than the “matrix factorization-based model” and achieves less MAE and RMSE scores and higher NDCG value which means that it has more ability to make exact and relevant recommendations than others. According to the results, the autoencoders can emphatically increase the dimensions of the quality of the recommendations, delivering to the users a highly customized fulfillment during their shopping. This study not only gives some indication of the practical implications of advanced machine learning techniques that can be successfully used in improving the recommendation systems but also suggests lines for future research, e.g. the optimizations and tunings of the deep learning models in eclectic contexts.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning And Machine Learning Analysis For Kidney Tumor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to lower death risks, provide the most effective course of treatment, and improve community healthcare, the majority of recent research has concentrated on examining prevalent illnesses in the population. One of the prevalent ailments that has impacted our society is kidney disease. Around the world, kidney tumors (KT) rank tenth in terms of frequency in both men and women. The organization of cancer is a problem that is attracting increasing attention in the domains of bioinformatics and computational biology. This study presents a comparative analysis of the latest developments in deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML). While several methods have been proposed to tackle the cancer classification challenge, new research indicates that supervised and deep learning-based methods are the most effective. Healthcare has advanced as a result of the creation of numerous machine learning techniques for awareness evaluation in cancer categorization. It seems that there is a high requirement for the ongoing development of efficient categorization algorithms in order to handle the growth in healthcare applications. The comparative analysis of the proposed classification shows the accuracy as 0.92%.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of an Efficient 2D Median Finding Algorithm for Non Linear Image Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient architecture of two dimensional (2-D) Modified shear sorting architecture which produces median output based on pixels given in a window of M X N. The Architecture is built using an 8 bit data comparator. The Data comparator is implemented using a De-multiplexer based full subtractor. The Architecture is synthesized using Vivado 2023.2. The Implementation results show that the proposed architecture operates at power of 0.142 W in Spartan 7 FPGA device in comparison with the architectures reported. The delay of the architecture is 20.665 ns with a look up table (LUT) count of 235. Placing and routing layouts has been done using the Vivado tool.

articleTitle: Active Synchronous Rectifier based Parallel Interleaved Converter for EV Battery Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) uses rechargeable battery packs to store electrical energy, necessitating periodic recharging for continued operation. The efficiency and speed of EV battery charging are crucial factors in their practicality for daily use. Charging methods vary, from slow household outlet charging to rapid charging at public stations. Technological advancements have spurred the development of sophisticated charging systems, aiming to enhance efficiency, shorten charging durations, and extend battery lifespan. This paper proposes an interleaved high-frequency inverter-based isolated EV charger. It entails designing a single-phase high-frequency inverter utilizing Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) control circuitry, which simplifies the generation of sinusoidal pulses for transistor switches. A synchronous rectifier designed for renewable energy applications, together with a power factor correction (PFC) Single Ended Primary Inductor Converter (SEPIC), are included in the implementation. This control strategy significantly broadens the adjustable output voltage range while ensuring smooth voltage delivery. An isolation transformer adds a layer of protection through electrical separation, while the interleaved parallel topology-based synchronous rectifier minimizes high-frequency rectification losses. Additionally, a capacitive filter reduces ripple voltage in the output. Performance analysis of this technique is conducted in the MATLAB/Simulink environment, providing insights into its effectiveness and feasibility. The proposed converter shows an efficiency of 93.47% and voltage gain of 1:9.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Esophageal Cancer Diagnosis: Vgg-16 Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Esophageal cancer stands as the sixth-leading cause of cancer-related fatalities globally. Less than 20% of malignancies survive, and most show symptoms later and at an advanced stage. In the medical domain, deep learning (DL) holds great significance since it facilitates sophisticated pattern identification and analysis of intricate medical data, leading to precise disease diagnosis and customized treatment regimens. The efficiency and accuracy of medical decision-making have greatly increased as a result of its capacity to extract valuable insights from massive databases, including patient information and medical pictures. In order to detect esophageal cancer, the suggested study used pretrained convolutional neural networks (CNN) that were specifically designed for image identification and tweaked VGG16. The evaluation makes use of a dataset made up of 100 HD-WLE pictures of the lower esophagus from the Endoscopic Vision Challenge, MICCAI 2015. Next, using the normal image data and the esophageal cancer image, the pretrained CNN was trained. The study used Grad-CAM, a technique for creating visual explanations, to successfully identify the reasoning behind the diagnosis of esophageal cancer. The accuracy, precision, sensitivity, and specificity of the system were 83.1%, 83.10, 81.7%, and 83.21%, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis and Performance Evaluation of various Artificial Intelligence techniques for Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The framework of the proposed system utilizes AI, machine learning procedures and data handling methodologies to analyze, gather data and reports from clinics or patient facilities, and prognosticate reports that assist the outcomes used to foresee various kinds of infection and disease. The most recurrently occurring disease and its infection is the dominant source for the human’s death. Clinical endlessly reports from different documents have been taken out to analyze and diagnose breast malignant growth or cancer, coronary or heart illness, and diabetes which are very frequent in present day people, and their wellbeing is significant in the finding.
