We have brought this sort of framework into our application, which can give positive and negative outcomes to make individuals' lives simpler to anticipate the sickness by bringing explicit data into their reports, and backing the theory of the infection with the choice of looking for exhortation good clinics and great specialists close to clients or guardians in our future enactments.

articleTitle: Deep Learning PNN Based Fault Monitoring System for Three Phase Industrial Drive System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Asynchronous motors are widely used in a variety of sectors. Even though induction motors are strong and dependable, they are susceptible to a variety of problems. Faults in induction motors can result in horrible events such as operator injuries, manufacturing disruption, and raw material loss. As a result, defect identification has become more crucial in induction motor management. Among the different problems that can occur in the motor, bearing failure is a severe issue that can cause catastrophic damage to the machine if not detected at an early stage of the fault. As consequently, the functioning of bushings in induction machinery must be checked on a regular basis. This research proposes a novel method for analyzing speed using discrete wavelet transform (DWT) and identifying bearing difficulties using Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) optimized by improved salp swarm algorithm. The stator electricity is examined and classified when an induction motor is operating under varied loading conditions with good and troublesome bearings. Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) is a feature extraction method that condenses visual content into a set of points that may be used to find similar patterns in other images. The proposed PNN classifier can classify different types of bearing faults, and the empirical findings validate the created approach. PNN-based motor bearing recognizing defects and diagnosis outperforms SVM and ANN classifiers in this regard. The Shortest path accuracy of the PNN Classifier is 98.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Precise Lung Disease Classification Through Bagging Ensemble Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Lung disease pose a significant global health challenge, with their prevalence and impact on public well-being necessitating advanced diagnostic methods for timely and accurate identification. As a vital organ for respiratory function, lungs are susceptible to an infinite number of conditions, ranging from infectious diseases like pneumonia and tuberculosis to chronic ailments such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and lung cancer. The study proposes an innovative approach for accurate lung disease classification utilizing a Bagging ensemble technique (Bootstrap Aggregating). Three pre-trained models, namely Modified VGG-16, VGG-19, and MobileNet V2, are individually trained on a common computed tomography (CT) image dataset. The fine-tuned models predict class probabilities and the bagging ensemble technique amalgamates their predictions by calculating the average probability score. The input images are correctly classified into five distinct groups by the ensemble model such as Normal, Covid-19, Viral Pneumonia, Bacterial Pneumonia, and Tuberculosis with an impressive accuracy of 97.99%, aiming to alleviate individual model biases, enhance overall predictive accuracy and provide a stable architecture for the precise classification of various lung diseases.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Hotel Reviews Using ANFIS and Natural Language Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The wide spread of fake reviews presents a considerable threat to the correctness of online review systems which tends to undermining both business reputations and consumer trust. This research introduces an innovative method for identifying fraud hotel reviews through the use of an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System integrated with supervised learning algorithms. By integrating ANFIS with Random Forest, Support Vector Machines and Logistic Regression classifiers, we trained our model on a well-annotated dataset of hotel reviews. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that the ANFIS-based models significantly outperform traditional classifiers in terms of accuracy, recall, precision, F1 score and ROC-AUC metrics. It is observed that the ANFIS-SVM model achieved 92.5% accuracy, 91.8% precision. It also gives 93.2% recall, 92.5% F1 score and an ROC-AUC value of 0.95. These findings underscore the superior performance of our approach in categorizing authentic reviews from fake ones. Also the results show the impact of ANFIS-based models to improve the reliability of online review platforms, ultimately benefiting both businesses and consumers by enhancing the trustworthiness of user-generated content.

articleTitle: Exploring the Optimized Hyperparameter Values Based on Mathematical Models for PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent years, numerous swarm intelligence optimization algorithms have emerged for tackling diverse optimization problems. However, the determination of several hyperparameters remains a critical challenge. Take Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) as an example: while it has demonstrated superior optimization performance in various applications, setting the weights for inertial velocity, the particle's best-known position, and the swarm's best-known position poses a significant hurdle. Hence, this study introduces an analytical framework aimed at examining the optimized mean fitness function value through mathematical models encompassing a range of fitness functions. Moreover, this framework facilitates the determination of optimized hyperparameter values associated with lower mean fitness function values. Experimental findings indicate that employing the proposed method for hyperparameter determination leads to enhanced convergence efficiency and decreased mean fitness function values.

articleTitle: Ensuring Safety Drive through a Smart Helmet design using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The smart helmet is a kind of protection gear that improves the rider's safety while operating a bike. The primary motive is to keep the motorcyclist safe. The attributes including alcohol detection, global positioning system, accelerometer, and fall detection can be employed to achieve this. As a consequence, it acts as a smart helmet. The first condition needs to be fulfilled for the bike to ignite, is that the person should have not consumed alcohol, followed by that the eye blink sensor detects the motion of eyeballs and if the driver falls is tired and closes eye for a period of time, then the sensor alerts the driver and when the accelerometer detects the change in motion, it alerts the GPS and GSM and it posts message to their nearby hospital and relatives. The advancement in our projects includes the temperature sensor which alerts during long hours of wearing helmet. Smart helmets can also help prevent head injuries. Some smart helmets can provide real-time information about the force, frequency and severity of head impacts.

articleTitle: Empowering Liver Disease Diagnosis with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Hepatic diseases are responsible for 4% of total deaths, which accounts to roughly two million deaths per year, of which two-thirds are liver related deaths that occur in men. Liver inflammation can lead to Hepatitis condition that results in an infection, this causes scarring of liver a condition known as Liver Cirrhosis. In our work a commonly used Noninvasive scan, Ultrasound was used to acquire 152 images across Healthy, Fatty, Fibrosis and Cirrhosis Liver. The primary purpose of this paper is to use the convolution neural net models that demonstrate high sensitivity and accuracy in classifying liver disease stages. Best CNN model resulted in a sensitivity of 90% for normal and 85.71% for abnormal ultrasound liver images, this would help the clinician to reduce the observational bias and make faster decisions in diagnosing the patients with liver diseases.

articleTitle: Securing Signal Integrity: Innovative Approaches to EMI Reduction in Converter Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Power converters are constantly confronted with the challenge of electromagnetic interference, which can compromise system reliability and cause disruptions to signal integrity. Electromagnetic interference is a phenomenon that occurs when voltages and currents fluctuate quickly. It travels through circuits and disrupts adjacent electronic devices. Potentially disrupting the functioning of other electronic devices, these abrupt shifts cause voltage and current fluctuations in adjacent conductors. Crucial roles in the generation of electromagnetic interference are played by switching components like transistors and diodes, as well as by the circuit board layout and parasitic elements in the system. Controlling electromagnetic interference is crucial for adhering to regulatory requirements, in addition to guaranteeing that the converter operates dependably and avoiding interference with neighbouring electronic systems. This paper offers a thorough review of the distinct approaches used to reduce EMI in converters. EMI in converters can cause problems like voltage spikes, signal distortion, higher noise levels, and decreased efficiency, which can affect the system's overall dependability and functionality. Furthermore, in order to guarantee electromagnetic compatibility and avoid interference with other electronic devices, rigorous regulatory standards require the control of EMI emissions. Resolving EMI issues improves converter performance and dependability while also encouraging regulatory compliance, which eventually leads to safer and more dependable operation in a variety of applications, from industrial machinery to consumer electronics.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Management Integrating WECS with Intelligent Control Technique for Grid and HVDC Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The optimal use of electrical resources is crucial in an era characterized by rising energy needs and a pressing need for sustainability. Power quality and the integration of renewable energy sources are increasingly top priorities in modern grid systems. The integration of renewable energy sources, particularly Wind energy conversion systems (WECS), into the present power grid is transforming the energy landscape since we are consuming less traditional fossil fuel. Notwithstanding, there are certain obstacles associated with this shift, namely with regards to the grid's dependability and quality of power. The goal of this project is to maximize electricity generation and distribution from renewable sources by proposing a complete system of renewable energy integration. To enhance grid stability and energy efficiency, this system makes use of wind energy technologies. The outputs from various renewable energy sources converge and are coupled to the alternating current (AC) grid system at a coupling point. In order to maximize wind energy source performance and achieve grid synchronization, grid side inverter control techniques are applied through the use of ANN controllers, which provide smooth interaction with the grid. At this stage, grid integration and high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission are made easier with the introduction of a Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC). This increases the resilience and flexibility of the grid by enabling the system to function as both an HVDC system and a smart grid management system. This initiative opens the door for the wider adoption of clean and sustainable energy solutions while also advancing technology related to renewable energy. ANN Controller has a THD Value of 1.42% when the controllers are compared and overall efficiency of the paper is 92%.

articleTitle: ANFIS MPPT Assisted PV Fed DC-DC Switched Z Source Converter For Microgrid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) modules are crucial components of contemporary distribution networks, but they have historically been employed primarily to provide profitable, clean, and green energy. An Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) is described in this study as a technique for MPP prediction using information on solar interaction and ambient temperature. The proposed technique has the benefits of a quick reaction, overall harmonic distortion discount, more effective utilization of PV units, and straightforward ANFIS algorithm training. An innovative type of large step up DC to DC converter is produced by combining the switched-capacitor cells by a conventional Z-source impedance network. The recommended converter delivers a great voltage gain lacking the limited accountability sequence and does not necessitate an enormous quantity of modules while decreasing a voltage heaviness on the diodes and the control switch to fewer than partial the productivity power. The performance and application of the recommended converter are established by the simulation and experimental findings. The comparison of the controllers shows the superior MPPT effectiveness of ANFIS as 92.3%.

Author Keywords: DC to DC Switched Z source converter

articleTitle: Improving Road Maintenance and Safety through Weighted Ensemble of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks: Focus on Pothole Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Road surface irregularities influence an extensive range of aspects-from the general road condition, from the general safety of drivers and mechanical operation of the vehicles up to fuel consumption. If these anomalies exist, they will make driving dangerous, with accidents happening, more damage to your vehicle, and more fuel expenses because of ineffective driving conditions. All these issues have led to various approaches being developed for automatically monitoring the state of the road surface. These methods should help receive accurate data on the smoothness degree of the road and about the potholes' locations. One such unusual approach, which is part of crowdsensing, concerns road surface monitoring with accelerometers built into smartphones. It exploits the ever-growing use of smartphones by using the inbuilt sensors in them to collect data about road conditions as people travel and then analyse this same to provide maps of areas that have significant anomalies in road surfaces. It provides essential data for the attempts being made for maintaining and developing the road. Many advantages of the crowdsensing method are known by now. It is very cheap and, therefore, widely accessible. However, it suffers from false positives caused by structures created by humans, behaviors of drivers, and regular road surface elements that are not true anomalies. Throughout our study, we proposed an ensemble deep-learning approach for pothole discovery classification. Because the model proposed in the present study has an accuracy rate reaching 97.49%, our experimental results prove that this model is better than other currently used models.

articleTitle: IoT Interfaced Improved Smart P&O MPPT Assisted PV-Wind Based Smart Grid Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: As the world's energy needs rise and fossil fuels run out, scientists are searching for new sources of energy. When it comes to electricity generation, solar and wind energy are the most promising. Double fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind turbine and solar panel (PV) make up the recommended system. Improved Perturbation & Observation (P&O) Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) technique is used to maximize power, while Cuk converter is utilized to raise the DC voltage in solar PV. With a DFIG base, a wind turbine's AC output voltage is transformed to DC. The DC voltage is received by the three-phase Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) from the hybrid system, which then transforms it to AC voltage. The grid side voltage is stabilized by the use of a PI Controller. The obtained AC electricity is ultimately supplied to the grid for other purposes. The hybrid system's simulation model is made with MATLAB. The PV-Wind grid system's properties are tracked via the Internet of Things (IoT).

articleTitle: Innovative Grid Tied EV Charging using Hybrid Energy Source with Vehicle to Grid and Grid to Vehicle Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Global power shortages are forcing people to look for other sources of energy to combat the impending power crisis. One potential solution for this is to use grid-synchronized electric vehicles (EVs). When several EVs are linked to the grid, disparities in supply and demand, voltage, and frequency result. This impacts the electricity grid as a whole. To alleviate these concerns, we have combined wind and sun power. V2G technology is one of the advancements in smart grids that allows energy exchange between the electric car and the grid. This proposal proposes using a hybrid energy source to charge EVs. Here, power from the wind turbine, PV panel, and AC generator is used to charge the EV battery. The following household's linear and non-linear needs are subsequently met with any excess electricity. The photovoltaic (PV) panel's DC voltage is maximized using a proportional-integral (PI) controller, which is well-known for its reliability and independence from the real system model. The enhanced DC output of the Boost converter raises the DC voltage overall. In order to provide the grid with additional power, the system also includes an AC generator. The electricity from the PV panel is converted into AC power using a three-phase Voltage Source Inverter (VSI), which uses the enhanced output of the Boost conversion process. This AC electricity is sent into the grid after careful synchronization. An LC filter is used to rectify harmonic components found in the VSI output, ensuring grid compatibility and safe current injection. In this paper, the voltage for the EV battery is adjusted using a bidirectional converter. Electricity from EVs that are not in use sent back into the grid for further applications.

articleTitle: Smart Staircase Lift for Assisting Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This project focuses on the design and implementation of a staircase lift system aimed at enhancing accessibility for individuals with mobility impairments. The system integrates various components, including a 3-phase 0.5HP gear head squirrel cage induction motor, LT control switches, proximity sensors, raspberry pi and other essential stairlift components. The motor serves as the power source for the lift mechanism, providing the necessary torque to drive the lift along the rail system. LT control switches are utilized to regulate the lift's operation, allowing users to initiate forward, reverse, and stop commands with ease. Proximity sensors play a crucial role in enhancing safety by detecting obstacles or individuals in the lift's path and triggering appropriate responses to prevent collisions. Additionally, the project encompasses the design and fabrication of the rail system, platform/chair, and control systems, ensuring seamless integration and efficient operation of the staircase lift. Through meticulous design, testing, and validation, the project aims to develop a reliable and cost-effective solution that promotes independence and inclusivity for individuals with mobility challenges.

articleTitle: Swolemate: A Fitness Assistance Smartphone Application with Gym Search, Workout, Meal Plan, Physical, and Mental Status Checking Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Physical and mental health status both contribute to a person’s overall well-being. A person’s physical well-being can be satisfied by engaging in adequate fitness training, eating healthy foods, getting enough sleep, and maintaining a disease-free body. Existing research on fitness assistance systems did not disclose a modern ICT technology-based online solution for examining a person’s physical and mental health status by examining their fitness score, exercise, body mass index (BMI), behaviors, and disease-related data. The existing articles did not exhibit online solutions for calorie and BMI score examination, client prevalence-based GYM search, workout planning, calorie-based meal planning, daily task scheduling, health specialist search, and client fitness-related inquiry assistance. To unravel the previous challenges, this article dispatches a fitness assistance smartphone application that issues client priority-based GYM search, physical and mental health status checking, calorie-based meal planning, workout progress tracking, BMI and calorie consumption tracking, daily task scheduling, law enforcement assistance, health specialist search, and fitness-related inquiry assistance features. The client satisfaction and app impact analysis result displayed that more than 54% of clients are gratified with the proposed fitness assistance application features.

articleTitle: Exam Invigilation Scheduler
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The process of room allocation for faculty during examinations has been a traditionally manual process, but now, we are embarking on the journey of developing an application centered on room allocation for faculty online. The current manual method involves significant time and complexity in assigning classes without any confusion. Additionally, a considerable amount of paperwork is required for manual allocation, demanding substantial efforts. To counter these challenges, we are presenting the creation of a web application known as the Exam Invigilation Scheduler. In this web application, the admin holds the key to managing all data. Through this application, the admin can efficiently schedule invigilation by allocating tables based on the provided data. Preparation for the invigilation schedule entails storing various details in the system database, including information regarding branches, faculty members, number of rooms, faculty email addresses, and other necessary information. To utilize this application, the admin must log in and, if desiring to arrange exam invigilation schedules, provide details such as the examination date, the number of branches involved in the exam, the faculty availability on the examination day, and the available number of classrooms. Based on the admin’s input, the system will construct the exam invigilation timetable. Once the invigilation table is prepared, emails will be dispatched to the respective faculty members, specifying their allocated room number, date, time, and examination details. The final invigilation table serves as a critical tool for conducting examinations. Through this web application, automatic class allocation during examinations is achieved without manual intervention, effectively reducing paperwork, saving time, and preventing confusion among faculty members during exam invigilation.

articleTitle: A Frame Work For The Tuberculosis Detection Through CXR Using Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the causative agent of tuberculosis (TB), continues to be a serious worldwide health concern, killing about 1.3 million people in 2022, predominantly in low- and middle-income countries. The urgent need for automation in healthcare has spurred the development of supplementary tools. We have created a method for detecting TB in chest X-rays using advanced techniques such as pre-processing, picture segmentation, augmenting the data, along with Deep Learning model for classification. Our approach involves segmenting the lung region from X-rays using a U-Net model, followed by classification with a convolutional neural network (CNN). This optimized design enhances accuracy and efficiency, making it suitable for mobile deployment and providing a practical solution for TB detection in resource-limited settings.

articleTitle: AI-Improved Battery-Powered Automobile Battery Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The charging and discharging functions of electric car batteries make them the most significant component of these vehicles. They provide the power that turns the engine of the vehicle. Without batteries, an electric car would not be able to move. If the batteries aren't working correctly, the car won't go smoothly. The battery system is impacted by changes in current and voltage. Therefore, we are unable to forecast the precise measurement of voltage and current. This paper's overarching goal is to monitor and enhance BEMS (battery energy management system) efficiency through the application of IoT and AI. The paper also intends to look into ways to manage electric car batteries better. The technology makes use of lithium-ion batteries, which have a higher energy density than more traditional battery types. Battery State of Health (SOH) and State of Charge (SOC) predictions can be much improved with the help of AI-Powered Cloud Services, as electric car batteries are quite expensive. The goal of this upgrade is to make it more long-lasting and economical. Adapting to changing battery health conditions caused by operational situations is possible with an AI-driven system located on the cloud. The battery management system is then able to make better management decisions over time thanks to the updated information it receives from it.

articleTitle: Validating ML algorithms for efficient Breast Cancer Prediction using K-fold
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Breast cancer has always been a disease that affects a lot of people. There is vast range of factors that may lead to breast cancer and this makes it more difficult to detect at an early stage. The tissues called benign or malignant present in the breast profile are so identical that it makes detecting cancer very complex for the doctors. Performing various tests like uniformity of cell shape and thickness of tissues may result in no valuable insights. This gives rise to machine learning and artificial intelligence that can be used in the prognosis of breast cancer. Here we attempt at correlating diverse machine learning algorithms to effectively predict breast cancer over a dataset. The five diverse machine learning algorithms employed are Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree, Neural Networks (Multilayer Perceptron), SVM and K-nearest Neighbour. An effective comparative study has been done to filter out the best Algorithm based on their Performance.

articleTitle: CARDIOBLINK - A Secure Web-Based Platform for ECG Analysis and Cardiac Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper introduces the CARDIOLINK — a safe online foundation for convenient ECG analysis and heart diseases diagnosis. Security of access is the prime concern in this system hence only administrators are allowed to login. When an admin logs in, they are directed to a page which permits them to upload files that contain ECG data. The formats acceptable on this site include three; .dat file (data file), .hea file (header file) and .atr file (attribute file). Once the upload is done, it verifies if the uploaded files have been corrupted or not before giving feedback. Users can make this analysis start by pressing "Analyze" button after uploading the files. CARDIOLINK then displays two sets of patient’s ECG waveforms captured at different time intervals for comparison purposes to analyze them comparatively with each other. Upon reviewing both electrocardiograms, potential heart diseases suffered by a patient are indicated on results page viewable by user. Also, platform provides other details such as common symptoms; names of recommended drugs; factors of risks attached to identified disease and preventive measures. According to the research, done up to now, random forest algorithm is used beneath for the sake of disease foretelling because it robustly survives noise and gives high accuracy rate on large dataset like those produced by electrocardiogram machine.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Recognition for Patient Monitoring in the Medical Field: A Deep Convolution Neural Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Gesture recognition enables computers to understand the language communicated through human body movements. Hand Gesture Recognition (HGR) has emerged as a technology with substantial potential for diverse applications. Hand gestures hold significant value in computer interaction, given their primary role as expressive forms of human communication. This paper aims to demonstrate the viability of HGR systems in the medical domain, specifically for patient monitoring purposes. The work aims to create a monitoring system that utilizes patients’ hand gestures to send urgent messages to an application, ensuring prompt notification of doctors about the patient’s condition. To achieve Hand Gesture Recognition, the researchers utilize a trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model within the MediaPipe framework, coupled with the open cv library, for detecting and identifying hand gestures captured by the camera. The processed data is then relayed to the application via a Raspberry Pi, enabling the transmission of appropriate messages based on the recognized hand gesture. The MQTT (Message Queueing Telemetry Transport) protocol is adopted as the means of communication over the internet, ensuring efficient message exchange between the monitoring system and the application. The obtained results are meticulously analyzed, enabling the calculation of system accuracy. The primary objective of this research is to verify the practicality and effectiveness of incorporating Hand Gesture Recognition (HGR) systems into medical settings, with the overarching goal of improving patient monitoring and care standards.

articleTitle: CT Scans Reimagined: Early Intracranial Hemorrhage Detection with AI
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Several research projects have been centred on computer-aided diagnosis techniques. They operate on the presumption that photographs of various human body components may be processed and assessed to provide an immediate and precise diagnosis. Brain haemorrhage is a kind of stroke. An artery in the brain rupture, causing nearby tissues to bleed selectively. Brain tissue is destroyed by this hemorrhage. Brain hemorrhage requires an immediate diagnosis and rapid treatment to improve patient outcomes. Clinicians must be able to recognize and categorise brain haemorrhage in order to successfully treat it. CT (Computed Tomography) scans are used to detect internal bleeding and fractures. Due to their better accessibility, reduced price, and sensitivity to early hemorrhages, CT scans have several advantages over Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images. Deep learning is being employed in this situation. In this study, a machine learning method is proposed by using medical imaging to identify brain hemorrhages.

articleTitle: Stalwart: An Advanced Mobile Application with Beggar Detection, Rehabilitation, Job Apply, Report Authority, Counseling, and Beggar Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Begging is considered a social problem in many countries around the world because it highlights the country’s poverty issue and causes distress. Because of a lack of proper supervision systems, beggars engage in a variety of crimes, including trafficking, drug addiction, cheating, and theft. Existing research works did not convey a suitable beggar assistance mobile application with beggar detection facilities by checking their activity, physical/mental status, appearance, rehabilitation, counselling features for beggars based on user needs, location, and rating preferences, and security force reporting features. To eradicate these problems, this article brings an advanced mobile application with beggar detection features based on their characteristics, rehabilitation center search, job application assistance, skill training course admission, counselling doctor reservation, helpline number search, query submission, immediate help, and a donor search feature for beggars. The performance evaluation results attested that more than 62% of reviewers dispatched amazing remarks regarding the serviceability and effectiveness of the proposed beggar assistance application.

articleTitle: Artificial Narrow Intelligence Inspired Neuromorphic Computing for Logic Operations in Healthcare Appliances
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the integration of Artificial Narrow Intelligence (ANI) principles into neuromorphic computing patterns to enhance logic operations in healthcare appliances. By drawing inspiration from the human brain's capability and adaptability, we propose a novel approach to embed ANI algorithms through neuromorphic hardware. Our study indicates how this fusion of technologies can significantly enhance the speed, accuracy, and adaptability of logic operations critical for healthcare appliances, such as patient monitoring and diagnostic systems. We present experimental results demonstrating the potential benefits of this approach, highlighting its prospective to revolutionize the landscape of healthcare technology, ultimately strengthening patient care and medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Tongue Driven Electric Wheelchair based on Magnetic Hall Effect Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of an innovative electric wheelchair which is controlled using Tongue Drive System (TDS) utilizing magnetic Hall Effect sensors. Traditional wheelchair control mechanisms pose challenges for individuals with limited mobility, necessitating alternative solutions. Leveraging the precision and versatility of tongue movements, the proposed system integrates magnetic Hall Effect sensors to detect subtle tongue gestures, translating them into wheelchair commands. The system offers a reliable and intuitive interface, enhancing mobility and independence for individuals with disabilities.

articleTitle: Implementation of various AI techniques for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A complex neurological disorder affecting behavior, communication, and social interactions is known as autism spectrum disorder (ASD). For people with ASD, improving outcomes requires primordial detection and intervention. The diagnosis of ASD has been transformed by the combination of AI and ML, particularly in young children. In order to create reliable autism screening tools, researchers have explored a variety of machine learning algorithms, including Decision Trees, XGBClassifier, Random Forest, AdaBoost Classifier, CatBoost Classifier, KMeans to Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Artificial Neural Networks, energised by the intricacies of the human brain, stand out for their remarkable ability to decipher complex patterns within data, thus proving effective in ASD prediction tasks. Nonetheless, ANN models often necessitate substantial data and computational resources for training. It is imperative to undertake rigorous comparative analyses based on accurate and efficient results to determine the most suitable algorithm for ASD prediction. Furthermore, continuous refinement and validation of these varied algorithms along with the representative and comprehensive datasets are vital to ensure their factuality and applicability in real world problems.

articleTitle: From Bean to Bar: Using CNNs for Automated White and Black Chocolate Variety Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Within the contemporary chocolate industry, the categorization and distinction of different chocolate varieties—especially white and dark chocolate—are essential for evaluating product quality, differentiating offerings, and satisfying customer needs. This research uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to offer an automated method for categorizing white and dark chocolate variations. The suggested technique examines photos of chocolate samples and correctly classifies them into their appropriate classes by utilising CNNs' potent feature extraction capabilities. The first step in the procedure is gathering a large dataset of high-resolution photos of samples of dark and white chocolate from various sources. To ensure uniformity throughout the collection, these photos have undergone preprocessing to improve their quality and normalize their characteristics. The gathered dataset is then used to develop and train a CNN architecture, with the necessary modifications made to maximize its performance for chocolate classification tasks. In the chocolate sector, the automated classification of white and dark chocolate variations using CNNs presents a viable approach for improving consumer experiences, manufacturing workflow optimization, and quality control procedures. The results of this study show how deep learning techniques have the potential to transform the production and marketing of chocolate while also advancing computer vision techniques for food classification.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive and debilitating neurodegenerative disorder that poses a significant public health challenge worldwide. Early detection and prediction of Alzheimer's disease are critical for effective treatment and care. This research paper presents a novel approach for predicting Alzheimer's disease using machine learning methodologies. Our study leverages a diverse dataset that includes clinical, genetic, and neuroimaging data from individuals at various stages of the disease. Through rigorous preprocessing and feature selection processes, we extract relevant features and apply advanced machine learning algorithms. Our results demonstrate the efficacy of this approach in accurately predicting the onset and progression of Alzheimer's disease. The model's high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity suggest its potential as a valuable tool for clinicians and researchers. Furthermore, our study highlights key factors contributing to the prediction and offers insights into the underlying biological processes of the disease. This research holds promise for early intervention and personalized patient care, ultimately contributing to improved management of Alzheimer's disease and enhancing the quality of life for affected individuals and their families.

articleTitle: Medicus: Health care Enhancing Accessibility using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Health care and medical endeavors are evolving day by day in tandem with technology. In this study, a novel prototype model is discussed regarding an IoT-based innovative medicine dispenser. This ensures the ease of access to vital pharmaceuticals and the offering of medical advice in the remotest places. The unique architecture of the proposed system integrates IoT and machine learning technologies, forming the dispenser. Patient-friendly control makes the medication management easy. The proposed approach will assist the patient in taking medications on time, swiftly, and above all, without the possibility of missing tablets, as well as eliminating the random chance of overdosing or underdosing, hence minimizing health issues to a greater extent. This paper takes care of exploring the methodology and system architecture of the project, along with promising outcomes to lay a firm road for scalable and impactful healthcare interventions in the rural environment.

articleTitle: New Era in Fracture Diagnosis using Deep Learning's Role in Precision Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The critical problem of using advanced image analysis techniques to diagnose and classify bone fractures is the main topic of this work. Bone fractures are common and have a significant effect on patient outcomes, hence timely diagnosis is essential for proper treatment. Identification done quickly is essential to reducing issues and maximising general recovery. A dataset of 4906 X-ray images classified as either broken or not is used in the study. One model it uses is a Sequential Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). With 4099 images for training, 401 images for testing, and 406 images for validation, the CNN model classifies fractures with an astounding 98% accuracy. The method shows how deep learning in medical imaging may be used to diagnose fractures accurately and quickly, therefore enhancing healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Channel Estimation using Artificial Neural Networks in MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) is a wireless technology that consist of multiple transmitter and multiple receiver to transmit the multiple data within a time period. The signals have some noise and distortion when it reaches the destination, to eliminate the noise and distortion and to characteristics the channel, the Channel Estimation is used. This study uses the Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for improved network forecasting for MIMO system. The multiple bit streams are given to the transmitting terminal. In the transmitting terminal the Channel encoding is used to reduce the noise and bit error and the modulation process is carried out. The transmitted signal is passed through the Rayleigh fading which assumes the many random components with the same phase and amplitude. In the Receiving terminal, Detection and Decoding is carried out using the ANN and thereby the output bit stream obtained without noise channel. The suggested approaches perform better than the current ones and are robust and efficient, according to simulation data.

Author Keywords: Buss gang based Minimum Mean Square Error

articleTitle: Cluster-Based Risk Analysis For Big Data Security Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Nowadays, ensuring data security has become paramount as organizations leverage vast datasets for insights and decision-making. Traditional security measures struggle to address the unique challenges posed by big data's scale, velocity, and diversity. Despite the emergence of various tools and techniques, a singular solution remains elusive. This study explores the intersection of big data and security, emphasizing the need for layered security technologies and prioritized systems. It proposes a novel security model integrating advanced risk analysis and prioritization techniques, enabling organizations to tailor security measures effectively. By categorizing data based on sensitivity and criticality, this model provides a comprehensive framework for safeguarding data throughout its lifecycle. By embracing innovative methodologies, organizations can mitigate risks and protect their data assets in today's interconnected world.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Potato Crop Health Using Advanced Image Analysis with Efficient Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: accurate detection of diseases is crucial for enhancing and increasing crop production in precision agriculture. The work is centered on developing a method that allows a CNN to learn to determine features in crop disease image snippets that can be said to be significant. Moreover, an efficient classification algorithm is also used in the proposed work to classify specific diseases more quickly and with greater confidence. The training process included applying the back propagation technique to update the weights of the generator network in order to increase the quality of generated images in a way that minimizes the probability of producing fake identities. The images that are related to the crop disease have been collected from the Village Potato Plant dataset for this purpose. The experiments were also done using the CNN which was trained at 15, 30 & 45 epochs for the Adam optimizer. Furthermore, it was evident that an increase in the number of training epochs in general resulted in the increase in confidence score. Combining both the CNN and the classification algorithm helps the system find an optimal balance between model confidence and processing speed that makes it perfect to be used in real-time crop disease classification.

articleTitle: High Speed Neural Network MPPT Algorithm For DFIG Based Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: For the generation of electrical energy, breeze energy is a trustworthy and talented renewable vitality basis. An innovative proposal with many scientific and economic benefits is using wind source technology to charge electric vehicles. Worldwide, the market for Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) has been expanding significantly. High-quality output power is commonly produced when wind energy demand grows. WECS has significant modelling, control, and grid integration issues as a result of the intermittent nature of wind energy. A proper controller mechanism has to be created in order to significantly improve WECS. An innovative method for maximizing the power of wind energy founded on Radial Basis Function Neural Networks (RBFNN) is proposed in this study to increase the power of Double Fed Induction Generators (DFIG). DFIG based wind turbine, and to provide outstanding dynamic performance in response to breeze rapidity fluctuations. MPPT is a strong algorithm that operates around an ideal rotating speed by utilizing RBFNN for mechanical speed control. We evaluated the performance of DFIG founded WECS with MATLAB/Simulink. The RBFNN efficiency is 91% when comparing MPPT controllers.

articleTitle: Detection of Tongue-Based Myeloid Sarcoma Using Novel Cat Swarm Optimization and Comparison with Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: the exact scope of this research work is to compare novel cat swarm optimisation to particle swarm optimisation for tongue-based Myeloid Sarcoma detection. To perform the detection of tumor and leukemia, ten sample tongue datasets were subjected to novel Cat Swarm Optimisation and Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO) methods, and the fiducial interval remaining at 95%. According to the simulation's performance metrics, Novel Cat Swarm Optimisation outperforms PSO (79%) in terms of accuracy, with a significant level of p = 0.001 (p0.05) in SPSS statistical analysis. From this study, the accuracy of detection of tumor and leukemia using Novel Cat Swarm Optimization showed better results than the PSO algorithm for the considered sample images.

articleTitle: Experimental Tribological Investigation on EN39B In Aerospace Application
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In aerospace applications, it is imperative for materials to possess outstanding mechanical and tribological characteristics. The Aero Industry employs carburized steel of grade EN39B for manufacturing gears, particularly those utilized in transmission systems. These gears are thermal resistant, and while composites a recurrently used extensively in aeronautics due to their superior mechanical and tribological properties compared to alloys, there is an increasing interest in developing composites based on EN39B as the base matrix material. Therefore, understanding these properties is crucial. Our research aims to investigate the tribological properties of EN39B steel. Using a pin/ball on Disc tribometer, we can determine the wear rate and coefficient of friction of carburized EN39B steel. Initially, the specimens will undergo testing for tribological properties under ambient conditions. Subsequently, the specimens will be reevaluated to discern tribological properties in relation to increased speed. The speed will be gradually raised to 1600 rpm, and the corresponding tribological properties will be assessed.

articleTitle: Voice Based Navigation Assistance for the Blind
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper outlines the creation of a blind assistance application that detects path in real-time and aids the visually challenged people to navigate their surroundings safely. The web application uses flask framework to communicate between the client and the server. The main part of the application is YOLO object detection model capable of identifying objects in real time from a live image stream. Upon capturing and processing the images from client’s webcam, the webapp sends directional instructions to client and the client’s browser process these instructions to play appropriate audio files which are loaded from the server. The web applications integration of image processing, audio feed backs and web-based interaction offers an accessible solution for the visually challenged people in their daily lives.

articleTitle: Probing Aberrant Heart Rhythms Utilizing CNN Autoencoders for Enhanced ECG Anomaly Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: An application of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Autoencoders for anomaly identification in electrocardiogram (ECG) data is investigated in this study using the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database. Heartbeats affected by cardiac abnormalities and normal heartbeats make up the two groups of 14,552 samples in all. Transposed convolution has been used to greatly enhance model performance. This work highlights the need of early cardiac issue detection and introduces a CNN Autoencoder model specifically made to effectively encode and decode ECG data, therefore allowing for the identification of abnormal patterns. Construction of a strong Autoencoder with trained encoder and decoder components to lower reconstruction errors is the process. The astonishing F1 score (65.40%), recall (89.81%), precision (55.23%), and accuracy (76.93%) of the model are demonstrated by the assessment measures. This paper emphasises the importance of early anomaly identification in ECG data using deep learning methods. Higher diagnostic skills and improved patient outcomes are very much possible with this approach.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Security in DDoS: A Holistic Approach Leveraging Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Industrial application development, distribution, and deployment are impacted by the cloud computing industry's explosive growth. The majority of enterprises appear to be shifting in the last few days toward adopting cloud environments and different cloud-based services. Ensuring a secure and reliable environmental solution throughout cloud space is crucial for protecting and safeguarding the transactions conducted by enterprises. Static verification of cloud user behavior using methods like support vector machines and linear regression have been tried to discover pre-defined dangers and advance cyber- security in the market. These security solutions have limited functionality because they are static. Making decisions about access control entails executing a block or permit action. Additionally, the prior approaches have issues with data security for endpoints that are not cloud-managed. Furthermore, distributed denial-of- service (DDoS) and data privacy assaults are the most prevalent types of Cloud security attacks, with 16% and 14% of users, respectively. In order to address the aforementioned problems, this research focuses on creating a novel security solution for effective DDoS attack detection utilizing machine learning (ML) approaches. The primary goal is to influence the direction of cloud security in the future by utilizing machine learning algorithms, which can offer automated and adaptable methods for improving security in cloud environments. ML can provide solutions that go beyond focusing only on pattern recognition and analysis in sensitive data, to include full algorithms for securing enterprise data across all cloud apps. The more accurate model is trained with 99.6% accuracy by the random forest (RF) classifier, according to experimental results. The suggested machine learning algorithms are put to the test, the outcomes are confirmed, and the algorithm's effectiveness is assessed by contrasting it with other currently used techniques.

articleTitle: Empowering Farmers with AI: Risk Mitigation Through Machine Learning in Smart Irrigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The advent of IoT-enabled smart irrigation systems in the domain of precision agriculture has revolutionized farming practices, significantly enhancing crop yield and resource management. However, this technological transformation has exposed farmers to novel challenges, particularly in the realms of security, privacy, and risk management. This research investigates the vital utilization of machine learning (ML) for intrusion detection in the case of smart farming, particularly in utilizing IoT technology to enhance and automate irrigation processes is a hallmark of modern precision agriculture, with the aim of mitigating risks. Farmers today face an array of risks, from crop-specific threats such as pests and diseases to broader environmental factors like weather fluctuations. The effective prediction of these risks is essential for sustainable agriculture. Employing ML techniques, this research endeavors to develop an advanced intrusion detection system that not only safeguards smart irrigation infrastructure but also predicts and mitigates risks associated with crop health and water resource management. This holistic approach leverages data from various IoT sensors, including soil-moisture sensors, weather stations, and drone-based imagery, to provide immediate response into potential risks. While benefits in this technology are immense, it also brings security and privacy challenges, as the data generated and transmitted by these systems can be susceptible to unauthorized access and malicious manipulation. Our important aims are to equip farmers with an integrated solution that not only detects and prevents intrusions into their smart irrigation systems but also provides predictive insights into potential agricultural risks.

articleTitle: Hybrid Logic Style CMOS Full Adder Using 10-T XOR & XNOR Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The hybrid CMOS full adder (FA) architecture is described in the paper and detailed working principles based on hybrid logic structure of 10 transistors XOR and XNOR circuit. The XOR and XNOR circuitry provide active outputs. Where, CMOS full adder (FA) circuit entire working stage depends on XOR and XNOR outputs. The technology used for this proposed methodology is 0.45nm CMOS technique to simulate output through GPDK "Cadence virtuoso Tool". In this proposed research the overall full adder propagation delay, Power consumption and switching Energy significantly reduced.

articleTitle: PSO Optimized RBFNN Classifier For Lung Cancer Identification System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Lung cancer is the maximum collective cause of mortality in the world, with a greater fatality rate than other cancer types because of its late stage of development and difficulties in diagnosing symptoms. Therefore, early lung cancer identification improves the chances of a favourable outcome and is essential for diagnosis. It is the trickiest method to increase a patient's odds of surviving. This paper presents the construction of an adaptive structure for lung cancer estimation based on a combination of architectural evolution with weight learning using neural networks and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) optimized and Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) classification methods. This approach offered various versions and hybridized it with an optimization approach to boost its efficiency. It employs global searching of PSO and local searching capabilities of neural network to calculate lung cancer as cancerous or non-cancerous. The organization is completed, and the results are compared to the performance of other algorithms. The parameters derived from the feature extraction Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) technique are used to build the architecture of the RBFNN model. Based on the patient's state, the forecasting system helps physicians make appropriate judgments. The RBFNN has an accuracy of 93.5%.

Author Keywords: CAD-Computer Aided Diagnosis and SC LC-Small Cell Lung Cancer

articleTitle: Hybrid Adhoc Routing Protocol Implementation in Mobile Adhoc Network Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The corporate 5G demos are important in today's rapidly advancing technological environment. In most areas of information and communications, energy conservation is increasingly a need. New wireless network designs are greatly influenced by this demand. Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) are the most emerging area of study as a result of this. High-performance, energy-efficient, and fundamentally flexible routing protocols are possible. Routing protocols are therefore the most crucial component of the MANET. Node mobility disruption is one of the main problems with routing in MANETs; end nodes and intermediate nodes in the network move around a lot, causing frequent path breaks. Thus, this study presents using the Firefly algorithm to construct a hybrid ad hoc routing protocol in mobile ad hoc networks. Link-state and distance-vector routing methods are employed in hybrid routing protocols. In data networks, a Distance-Vector Routing Protocol (DVRP) chooses the optimal path for data packets depending on distance. A routing protocol called Link-State Routing Protocol (LSRP) enables routers in a computer network to share routing data. The Firefly algorithm (shows best accuracy 92.7% and specificity 91.4%), which is integrated into hybrid AODV, is utilized in this study to solve the routing path problem and choose the best path based on the most recent data. This initiative offers data transfer pathways that are more effective. In addition, it provides scalability, load balancing, faster convergence, and effective bandwidth utilization and NS2 software is used for executing this work.

articleTitle: Multichain Blockchain Solutions for Ensuring Trust and Transparency in IoT Healthcare Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The use of Internet of Things (IoT) technology inside healthcare systems has the potential for significant breakthroughs in the treatment and monitoring of patients. Nevertheless, this convergence also gives rise to noteworthy security apprehensions, namely about safeguarding confidential medical information and ensuring the reliability of networked equipment. This article suggests using Multichain blockchain technology as a strong approach to improve security in IoT healthcare contexts, to address these concerns. Multichain blockchain provides a distributed, unchangeable, and resistant-to-tampering method of storing data, guaranteeing the privacy, accuracy, and accessibility of patient information while reducing the dangers linked to centralized data repositories. Using a Multichain blockchain architecture in IoT healthcare systems enables the establishment of trust among many stakeholders, mitigates the risk of illegal access, and enhances the security of data exchange across diverse devices and platforms. This presents a comprehensive summary of the suggested methodology and its possible ramifications for augmenting security in healthcare environments provided by the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Advanced ANN-Controlled System with Hybrid Energy Sources Enabling Vehicle-to-Grid and Gridto-Vehicle Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Global power shortages are forcing people to look for other sources of energy to combat the impending power crisis. Grid-synchronized electric vehicles (EVs) are one possible way to do this. Inequalities in supply and demand, voltage, and frequency are brought about when different EVs are connected to the grid. This affects the overall power system. In order to allay these worries, we have integrated solar and wind energy. Energy exchange between the electric vehicle and the grid is made possible by vehicle to grid (V2G) technology, one of the developments in smart grids. The hybrid energy source with intelligent controller for EV charging is proposed in this proposal. Here, the EV battery is charged using electricity from the PV panel, wind turbine, and AC generator. Any extra power is then used to power the next household's linear and non-linear demands. Reducing the number of panels further reduces the system's size and cost through the use of a high gain Single ended primary inductor (SEPIC) converter. In this study, the voltage for the EV battery is adjusted using a bidirectional converter. For efficient power conversion, this bidirectional converter is controlled by an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) control unit. Electricity from EVs that are not in use may be sent back into the grid for additional purposes. Simulink and MATLAB 2021a are used to simulate and evaluate the proposed method. With a voltage gain of 1:8, and an efficiency of 92%, the proposed SEPIC converter is quite effective.

articleTitle: Integrated Renewable Energy System with ANN-Based MPPT for Efficient Power Generation, Wireless Transmission, and Energy Storage in EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The increasing global energy demand and the urgent need to transition to sustainable practices have made the integration of renewable energy sources (RESs) into distribution power networks imperative. This paper main objective is to implement rooftop photovoltaic (PV) systems as an essential part of low-voltage (LV) DC networks’ building-integrated centralized generation. By ensuring maximum power extraction from photovoltaic (PV) panels, a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) approach based on Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) is utilized to enhance power generation efficiency, particularly in partially shaded scenarios. After that, the PV system’s generated power is sent to a Luo converter, which effectively tracks and optimizes the power production. The Luo converter’s output is then fed into a high-frequency converter to enable wireless power transfer. This wireless power transmission improves the system’s flexibility and scalability by facilitating energy transfer without the requirement for physical connections. An isolation transformer is attached to the high-frequency converter’s output to guarantee the system’s dependability and safety. The high-frequency converter is isolated from the downstream components by the isolation transformer, which also offers protection against electrical risks. Lastly, the transformer’s isolated output is connected to DC loads as well as a battery intended for use in electric vehicle (EV) applications. Lastly, we will use the MATLAB 2021a / Simulink program to do a number of numerical simulations in order to validate the proposed controls. The efficiency achieved with the Luo converter is 93.5% and tracing efficiency of the ANN based MPPT is 92%.

articleTitle: Intelligent MPPT Controller for PV Fed Grid-Tied EV Charging with Power Quality Improvement using Neural Network Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Global power demand is driving the need to find an alternative source of energy to address the growing power issue. The integration of electric vehicles (EVs) into the power grid significantly affects the entire power system, introducing challenges such as supply-demand imbalances and fluctuations in voltage and frequency. Addressing these issues, vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technology emerges as a promising solution, facilitating seamless energy exchange between EVs and the grid. This paper is proposed to enhance the interaction between EVs and the grid by employing a converter alongside the Artificial Neural Network Maximum Power Point Tracking (ANN-MPPT) method. Through this approach, uninterrupted EV charging is ensured while alleviating strain on the grid caused by voltage and current irregularities. The system uses a Relift-Luo converter to harness solar energy, with the ANN-MPPT technique optimizing power extraction from solar panels. Furthermore, the integration of a battery system with a bidirectional battery converter enables effective energy management within the system. RNN controller is presented to manage the three phase VSI’s functioning, which is connected to the three phase grid. Through the use of a MATLAB simulation, the entire system is verified (2021a). The proposed converter has an efficiency rate of 93.47% and that the accuracy of the ANN controller is 89.38%.

articleTitle: A Classification based approach for early stage Prediction and Multi-dimensional analysis of Alzheimer’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) presents significant challenges to global healthcare systems due to their rising incidence rates and profound impact on individuals and societies. Early prediction and intervention strategies are urgently needed to address thiue cognitive decline associated with AD, especially with an aging population. This research paper explores the integration of machine learning (ML) techniques to predict AD in its early stages. Various ML algorithms including Decision Trees, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, Gradient Boosting, and Voting classifiers were employed and optimized using the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) dataset. Our models demonstrated commendable performance in AD prediction, achieving high Precision, Recall, Accuracy, and F1-score metrics. Beyond prediction, our research extended to disease progression forecasting, drug discovery, and image analysis, leveraging ML to unravel intricate disease dynamics and enhance diagnosis precision and treatment efficacy. The comprehensive framework outlined in this research facilitates accurate AD prediction and analysis, empowering clinicians to intervene earlier and mitigate the severe social, financial, and economic implications of AD. Adoption of our multifaceted classification scheme could transform healthcare, leading to more efficient disease management, improved patient outcomes, and reduced societal burdens associated with neurodegenerative diseases.

Author Keywords: Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS)

articleTitle: Enhanced Reversible Data Hiding Scheme Based on DCT Coefficients in JPEG Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Data hiding approaches in Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) compression that use discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients are gaining popularity due to their capacity to integrate more data into JPEG pictures while producing perceptible aesthetic deterioration. Reversible data concealing is critical for safe data transport and secrecy. This study presents a novel reversible information concealing strategy based on DCT coefficients in the overall setting of compressed JPEG data. The procedure starts with the intake of hosting pictures and the image meant for hiding. Using DCT's time domain evaluation, the host picture is examined to discover suitable spots for integrating binary data. A binary threshold is used to choose appropriate brightness ranges for DCT coefficients for smooth and undetectable data implantation. To improve the embedding process, a binary scale operation is performed on the picture intended for data concealment. This scaling not only maximizes the use of available embedding space but also reduces potential visual distortion, resulting in an overall enhancement in the scheme's resilience and profitability. In addition, equalizing the histogram is used to equalize the pixel intensities of the background and concealed pictures, increasing consistency and improving the overall optical level of the assembled image. Chaotic encryption is used throughout the procedure to certify the protection of the embedded informations. The contained binary data may be precisely recovered from the changed DCT values, enabling a complete recuperation of the original host picture as well as the hidden information. The findings show that the approach can accomplish bidirectional data hiding inside JPEG compression, with encrypted pictures visualizing the effective incorporation of hidden data. This project is powered by MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Skillify: Enhanced Learning Management System Using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Traditionally, students faced challenges in acquiring knowledge from textbooks due to difficulties in access and the high cost associated with them. Online learning aims to overcome these hurdles by providing a digital alternative that is accessible to everyone. Students can overcome geographical obstacles by using online platforms, gaining access to a wealth of instructional resources. This digital paradigm shift seeks to democratize education by making it more equitable and inclusive. However, the accessibility of online learning remains a significant challenge, especially for those who are visually impaired. Additionally, the vast number of courses offered on online platforms can make it challenging for learners to select the right course that can advance their careers. Learners often struggle to identify the best courses to improve their skills. To overcome accessibility challenges for the visually impaired, our platform incorporates a text-to-speech feature, which converts written text into spoken words. To address the problem of choosing the right course, we are implementing a course recommendation system to enable learners to acquire new skills that are beneficial to their advancement. Our platform encompasses three distinct modules: user, professor, and admin. Each module serves a specific role within our system. This project exemplifies the potential of artificial intelligence in revolutionizing education through enhanced learning experiences. Our proposed model aims to improve the efficiency of existing models by implementing text-to-speech and course recommendation features.

articleTitle: Z Source Integrated Sepic Converter With Fuzzy Control For Grid Connected PV System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to improve the Single Ended Primary Inductor Converter's (SEPIC) voltage gain and performance, the integration approach is examined in this study. Since the present energy landscape emphasizes utilizing photovoltaic (PV) systems to their full potential in order to support carbon emissions that are as low as possible. An efficient DC-DC converter design plays a crucial part in each of these applications where they operate as power regulators. Although a large number of high-gain converter topologies have been published thus far, their structures are frequently enormous, unwieldy, and complex. Therefore, by adding a Z-source converter to SEPIC, this study offers a low-cost converter architecture that can achieve a considerable voltage gain. With their wide voltage converting range, low in-rush current, and reduced ripple current, Z-source converters are incredibly reliable. The advantages of the SEPIC converter, on the other hand, include constant input current, non-inverted output voltage polarity, and input-output isolation. The paper also includes different types of operation, voltage stress, and mathematical modeling of the proposed converter design. Furthermore, this study uses the Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC), which is efficient in providing timely and precise error compensation, to maintain the constant converter output. This proposed work has a THD Value of 1.34% when the controllers are compared and the Efficiency obtained using Z-Source SEPIC converter is 93%.

articleTitle: An Effective Approach in Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using CRF
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A technical advancement in the medical sector, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) generates high-quality images the fact that is used to identify and categorize disorders that affect a patient's internal organs. A brain tumor is a particular disorder that is capable of being recognized by examining an MRI image. Medical professionals improve using MRI technology in the early detection of brain tumor disease. The important method for carrying out various tasks like obtaining, pre-processing, extracting useful features, choosing, and classifying MRI images is magnetic resonance imaging analysis. The substance of extraction is a technique for representing an image using its raw data by processing it to extract valuable information that assists with decision-making processes like pattern categorization. Conditional random fields (CRFs) are techniques that are frequently utilized for structured prediction and pattern recognition. MATLAB is used to simulate the suggested system accuracy 90.2%, sensitivity 89.6%, specificity 88%, and produce effective results.

articleTitle: A Symphony of Sentiments using Log-Melspectrogram Techniques for Emotional Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the topic of audio emotion categorization via a novel approach involving log-Mel spectrogram with augmentation. Though it is much lower than MFCC, the research reveals a reasonable accuracy rate of 63%. It also draws attention to the great room for improvement, though. The work uses a complex model, a 2D CNN with VGG19 architectural resemblance. The audio properties are handled in this paradigm as a 30x216 pixel image. Many features are extracted by specialised methods utilising datasets like TESS, CREMA-D, SAVEE, and RAVDESS. It is stressed how crucial it is to quickly detect emotions via audio clues. The results of the 2D CNN model are promising and can outperform traditional methods. Faster interpretation is made possible by using a specific class to hold result properties. This work closes the gap between image-based and audio-based techniques in emotion analysis by improving the growing field of audio emotion classification and providing chances for accurate and efficient identification.

articleTitle: FIFA Dataset Analysis and Match Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The world of football, with its vast player database and intricate gameplay, has been a subject of fascination for enthusiasts and analysts alike. The FIFA video game series, developed by EA Sports, provides an opportunity to delve into this world from a data science perspective. In this research, we embark on a comprehensive analysis of FIFA player data using Python to uncover insights and patterns that can enhance our understanding of the virtual football world. Findings: Data visualization is the process of representing data using common graphics, like charts, plots, infographics, and even animations, prediction of overall rating of football players using Linear Regression and Win prediction of EPL teams using Random Forest classifier.

articleTitle: Smart Solar PV Charge Controller System for Off Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper describes the execution of a smart solar PV charge controller that exploits the operational capacity of the Raspberry Pi. Modern solar panel technology, boost and buck converters, battery storage and a DC motor load are all included in the system. The Raspberry Pi serves as the central component, facilitating simple control and information sharing amongst the various components. To optimise energy flow to the battery, a buck converter regulates voltage, a boost converter efficiently extracts power from the solar panel, and advanced algorithms are used in the charge controller. Real-time monitoring of the battery’s level of charge ensures maximum performance and durability by preventing overcharging or deep draining.
