In addition, the charge controller regulates the power delivered to the DC motor load, providing a stable and consistent power source. By using the intelligence of the Raspberry Pi, the system enhances the efficiency of solar energy collection and utilisation in off-grid scenarios, thereby contributing to sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Hyperparameter Based on Mathematics for Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Gradient descent algorithms are widely considered the primary choice for optimizing deep learning models. However, they often require adjusting various hyperparameters, like the learning rate, among others. These hyperparameters significantly impact both the speed of convergence and the accuracy of the solution. Thus, this study introduces an analytical framework that uses mathematical models to assess the mean error of each objective function concerning gradient descent algorithms. Additionally, this framework aims to identify the most effective hyperparameter values by minimizing the mean error. By analyzing optimization models, generalized principles have been established for setting hyperparameter values. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior convergence efficiency and reduced errors compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Aquarium Control System using Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Detecting and monitoring common infectious diseases in intensive aquaculture settings is crucial for implementing effective scientific strategies to mitigate fish mortality and economic losses. However, challenges arise due to poor quality underwater images and difficulty in identifying targets, posing significant obstacles to diseased fish detection. To address these issues, this study proposes a model for diseased fish detection in aquaculture using the YOLOv5 network. Given the extensive utilization of underwater cameras in marine ecology applications, there is a pressing need for automated tools to process the vast amount of generated data by detecting and recognizing species captured in natural environments. The classification of fish species from videos and images in such settings is particularly challenging due to noise, illumination variations, and diverse habitats. In this paper, we introduce a two-step deep learning approach for detecting and classifying temperate fishes without pre-filtering. The first step involves detecting individual fish in images using the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection technique, irrespective of species or sex. Subsequently, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture, namely Fish4Knowledge, is employed for classification purposes. Both the object detection and classification models are trained and updated with data specific to temperate fishes of interest, enhancing their applicability and performance in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 4x4 bit various Multiplier Using Look-up table and implementation in FIR Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the comparison of 4 x 4 multiplier according to time, area, and speed, Look-Up Tables (LUTs) are used to meet high speed and low power requirements, which are essential in VLSI. In the implementation of Wallace tree, Booth, array multipliers, to identify the most efficient one considering all VLSI aspects. Wallace tree multipliers and Booth multipliers are more effective than array multipliers in terms of delay and power consumption, which makes them more appropriate in area while sacrificing in speed.. But the Wallace tree multiplier is more suitable for FIR filters than other filters. The Xilinx ISE tool is used to implement Verilog code for generating schematic views of the multipliers, highlighting time, speed, and area characteristics.The FIR filter is implemented using MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Improving Transient Stability in Integrated AC-DC Power Systems with SVC through Transmission Line Reactance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study aims to assess the efficacy of enhancing transient stability in concurrent AC-DC power systems through the utilization of Static VAR Compensator (SVC) while optimizing transmission line reactance. Seven samples obtained from MATLAB simulations are analyzed. Implementation of the SVC method leads to notable improvements in transient stability. Results indicate that the static VAR compensation technique enhances transient stability by approximately 94.3%. This enhancement underscores the effectiveness of SVC in mitigating transient instability, showcasing its potential to significantly bolster the stability of integrated AC-DC power systems.

articleTitle: Design & Simulation of Fuel cell/Battery Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This work presents the design and simulation of a Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) integrating a fuel cell with a battery, managed by bidirectional DC-DC converters. The proposed system aims to capitalise on the complementary characteristics of each energy storage element; the fuel cell provides a stable power supply, the battery offers high energy density for extended use, and handles peak loads with its high-power density and rapid charging/discharging capabilities. Utilising a sophisticated control strategy, the system dynamically manages energy flows to meet varying load demands efficiently, thereby enhancing the overall performance and extending the lifespan of the storage components. The design underscores the potential of HESS in applications requiring a reliable and continuous power supply, such as renewable energy systems, electric vehicles, and grid stabilisation. Simulation results demonstrate the system’s adeptness at offering a balanced energy solution, which is both resilient and adaptable to fluctuating power requirements, highlighting the feasibility of such a system for advanced energy management applications.

articleTitle: Scrap Craft AI Hub: Where Innovation Meets Creativity
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The saying "One person’s garbage is another person’s gold" highlights the diversity of individual preferences and needs, implying that what appears worthless to one person can be valuable to another. This project focuses on tackling waste challenges by turning recycled materials into things that people want to buy. This program merges traditional craftsmanship with revolutionary technology, like web development and artificial intelligence, to produce original and distinctive abstract artworks. The project involves creating, designing, and adding features to websites using different web tools like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, various backend programming languages, database systems, frontend frameworks, and web servers. The Scrap Craft Hub platform comprises two sections: Scrap Swap: A marketplace for individuals and businesses to exchange scrap items, facilitated by a user-friendly interface and advanced search options. Users can buy, sell, and rate products securely, promoting transparency and trust. Additionally, AI technology provides price recommendations for vendors. Crafter’s Corner: An area for artists to exhibit their creations crafted from scrap materials. EcoMarket serves as a dedicated platform for artistic expression, emphasizing sustainability and upcycling. Artists can engage with their audience through features like comments, likes, shares, and subscription options. The project wants to bring a fresh approach to eco-friendly art by combining imagination, new technology, and innovative ideas. It aims to bring order to disorder by reusing neglected materials and discovering new possibilities.

articleTitle: SI-LERT (Assistive Device For Hearing Impaired Drivers)
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The"SI-LERT"(Assistive Device for Hearing Impaired Drivers), represents an innovative solution aimed at enhancing the safety and accessibility of individuals with hearing impairments while driving, particularly in detecting emergency vehicles. Combining a Raspberry Pi 4 and USB microphone for siren recognition, this device transmits signals to an ESP32 microcontroller integrated into driving glove via WiFi. Upon detection, the microcontroller activates micro-vibrators embedded in the glove, providing tactile feedback, and simultaneously displays an image of the approaching emergency vehicle on an OLED display. This innovative approach not only empowers drivers with hearing impairments to respond effectively to emergencies but also marks a significant advancement in assistive technology, offering a comprehensive solution that combines tactile and visual feedback to enhance road safety and driver independence. While the device shows potential, it needs more work and testing to fix problems like limited number of datasets.

articleTitle: DDSRF Theory for Power Quality in UPFC Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The electrical method's power quality is critical for businesses, factories, and residential applications. Users and utilities have been more concerned about the quality of power as the demand for high-quality electrical power has increased, as has the number of distortion loads. In this paper proposed the Decoupled Double Synchronous Reference Frame (DDSRF) model for the power quality in unified power flow controller (UPFC) applications also the FACTs parts that controls the communication line's active and reactive power flow. This article attempted to improve power superiority by using a fuzzy logic controller (FLC) and boost converter with solar system founded UPFC to regulator both active and reactive supremacy movement, adjust power issue, control line power, and increase passing steadiness. The DDSRF generates an annular harmonic that is diametrically opposed to the load harmonic. The frequency is then injected into electricity systems, reducing the influence of harmonics. The THD value comparison has the value of 2.2% using DDSRF theory.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of PLL Controlled Bidirectional V2G and G2V Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)

authors.preferredName: Mary Synthia Regis Prabha D M

abstract: In response to the challenges posed by climate change, stemming from the escalating levels of pollution and its detrimental impact on human health, the future trajectory of electricity generation must utilize clean vehicle technologies and incorporating renewable energy. This initiative devise and implement power converter capable of facilitating bi-directional power flow in both Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) and Grid-to-Vehicle (G2V) technologies. These configurations are designed to support both the existing grid and vehicle traction, accommodating additional auxiliary loads. Efficiently managing bidirectional charge flow of batteries enhances its suitability for integration with renewable energy sources, creating a more sustainable solution where the battery system contributes as an integral part of the energy source. By adopting such an approach, notable improvements can be achieved in the efficiency, reliability, stability, and generation dispatch of the supply grid. This becomes particularly significant in the context of a smart grid, where careful consideration and effective management of critical issues, such as potential disruptions caused by a growing count of Electric Vehicles (EVs) attached to the energy grid, are essential. The proposed project aims to offer a comprehensive technical evaluation, encompassing Phase Locked Loop (PLL), as well as modeling and control strategies. These considerations will be tailored to address challenges related to harmonics and dynamic response.

articleTitle: Enhancing Plant Leaf Disease Detection: Integrating Mobilenet With Local Binary Pattern And Visualizing Insights With Grad-Cam
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Plant leaf disease detection plays a crucial role in agricultural management; this work presents a methodology for precise identification of plant leaf diseases, crucial for effective agricultural management and timely intervention. The proposed approach combines the efficiency of MobileNet, a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN), with the discriminative power of Local Binary Pattern (LBP) to enhance feature extraction for accurate disease detection. The integration of LBP augments the network's capability to capture essential textural information. Additionally, for improved interpretability, Grad-CAM (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping) is utilized for visualization, highlighting significant regions in input images that influence the model's predictions. This not only aids researchers in validating decisions but also provides transparent insights for farmers and practitioners in plant health monitoring. Evaluation on a comprehensive dataset demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach, achieving impressive results with 96% accuracy, 90% precision, 89% recall, and 89% F1 score. The combination of MobileNet with LBP, along with Grad-CAM, emerges as a robust tool for real-world applications in precision agriculture, fostering trust and informed decision-making in plant disease management.

articleTitle: Effective Lung Cancer Detection Framework Employing Adaptive Histogram Equalization and Deep CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents a fast image segmentation technique in medical imaging to reduce the time consumed by doctors in analyzing CT scans. The manual analysis of modern medical imaging is hardly possible because of the very huge size and picture' complexity. The accuracy and convergence time are two critical parameters that affect the performance of the segmentation algorithms. Because of the existing challenges in medical image segmentation, the need to study and apply new evolutionary techniques is an imperative. Lung carcinoma is the most frequently occurring cancer in men worldwide and, therefore, calls for early detective measures to enable time-critical, life-saving therapies. Among the numerous medical imaging techniques, CT has shown very high efficiency in detecting lung cancer. This paper evaluates five optimization algorithms' performance in extracting tumors from lung CT images using a deep convolutional neural network for picture classification. Comparatively, the strategies of median, adaptive-median, and average filters have been evaluated; therefore, the adaptive median filter has been selected as the best possible enhancement methodology for medical CT images. Moreover, adaptive histogram equalization is used to enhance the contrast of images. The improved images pass through four different algorithms before being displayed. The research validates results in Python on a dataset of 20 lung images. In this study, it is noteworthy that during validation, the GCPSO algorithm hit the maximum accuracy of 98.78%.

articleTitle: ANN based Harmonic Extraction in DFIG Fed DSTATCOM System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The evolution of the renewable energy is the best solution for environment to reduce the pollution. Due to the fastest development of the Wind power penetration in the power system many countries offer the stable operations of power system. The most widely installed machine in the wind farm is Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG).The operation of a wind energy conversion system (WECS) is based on a DFIG which is Sensitive to unbalanced non-linear load. In the proposed system the AC source is given to the non-linear load, to reduce the fluctuation the control function Distribution Static Synchronous Compensator (DSTATCOM) is used where the Input power is fed to the DFIG, it converts the AC voltage to DC and fed to Voltage Source Invertor (VSI). The reference and actual current get combined and passes to the Proportional Integral (PI) controller which is used to adjust reference and actual values and then fed to the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) generator. The source voltage and source current are given to the DQ theory which produce the reference current and then fed to Artificial Neural Network (ANN) classifier which is used to reduce the harmonics. The PWM generator which improve the power quality and generate pulses which is applied to VSI and thereby, the generation of an opposing current is injected to the Point of Common Coupling (PCC). The design process is accessed by the MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer Based Vision Enhancement for Visually Impaired Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The goal of visual implants is to create artificial vision that can partially restore function. It can enhance the quality of life for visually challenged individuals by allowing them to feel light, even after years of darkness, by the use of 60 microelectrodes implanted in the retina. The artificial vision that is made possible by current visual system stimulators has very poor resolution because of their small number of microelectrodes. Numerous researchers have sought to enhance artificial vision produced by low-resolution implants through the application of machine learning and image processing techniques. Because phosphine pictures have low resolution, users report unhappiness with the Retinal Prosthesis System. This underscores the important need for targeted research aimed at improving visual clarity and user pleasure in general. This research proposes simulating artificial vision in which the visually impaired user receives information synthesized by the system through a low-resolution photo courtesy of a visual implant. Through the use of Vision Transformer, the technique gathers useful data about people in the immediate vicinity of the visually impaired person, including their number, familiarity, gender, approximated ages, facial emotions, nearby items, and approximate distances. The information obtained from the user's glasses' camera frames is used to create signals that are then sent into a visual stimulator, offering a potentially effective way to improve the visual experience for those who are visually impaired. In order to facilitate economical real-time implementations in an independent portable system, an algorithm that best suits each feature is chosen based on its accuracy and time complexity. The proposed approach uses audio to provide crucial information about those in close proximity to a visually impaired person, enabling them to converse with others more comfortably. This paper can thus be taken into consideration for some next-generation visual implant systems. The accuracy of the CNN is 93% and Specificity comparison of CNN is 92% respectively.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Sleep Apnea: Smart Health Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A common sleep ailment that affects millions of people worldwide is sleep apnea. It is typified by frequent shallow or paused breathing while you're asleep, which can cause sleep disorders and can have detrimental effects on one’s health. The condition may significantly affect a person's quality of life, general health, and ability to carry out daily tasks. The quality of life for those with sleep apnea can be considerably improved by early identification of the illness and prompt intervention and therapy. Early treatment of sleep apnea can improve a person's quality of sleep, reduce daytime sleepiness, improve cognitive performance, and increase general wellbeing. The laboratory-based polysomnography (PSG), conventional sleep study diagnostic method is time consuming. Since the development of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), studying sleep disorders have become increasingly interested in automatic detection since it affects both therapeutic and diagnostic choices. The study literature on sleep apnea that has been published over few years back has been reviewed, with a focus on the many screening techniques used to detect the condition and the software development expertise provided by numerous contributors. This study offers a thorough analysis of hybrid, machine learning, deep learning (DL) methods. Additionally, the study assesses several datasets that have been used in numerous investigations. This study is helpful in shedding light on how various machine learning and deep learning algorithms do in terms of detecting sleep apnea.

articleTitle: Vacant Parking Slot Availability Detection Using Yolov8 and OpenCV - Integration with payment functionalities
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Mitigating urban traffic and parking challenges is pivotal for residents’ well-being, conserving time, energy, and patience. Employing computer vision techniques, the focus is on optimizing parking space management by evaluating slot occupancy. Instant cameras capture comprehensive parking lot data, system employing YOLOv8 and OpenCV enhances real-time parking management. It accurately identifies available and occupied parking spaces, streamlines video preprocessing, facilitates payment processes, and generates alerts, ultimately optimizing parking operations and resource utilization efficiently. This endeavor underscores a commitment to tackling genuine urban issues, reducing the time spent searching for parking and enhancing the overall driving experience. Supported by an extensive literature review on smart parking, it outlines methodologies and ecosystems to effectively address contemporary parking dilemmas. Smart parking solutions are imperative amidst escalating urbanization and traffic congestion, offering benefits not only in research but also in bolstering economic vitality.

articleTitle: ChatGPT: Unraveling User Challenges & Proposing Targeted Improvements
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the multifaceted challenges users encounter with chatbots, focusing specifically on the widely adopted Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) models. Despite GPT's commendable proficiency in natural language understanding, issues arise, notably in the realm of mathematical calculations. A comprehensive literature review outlines the strengths and limitations of GPT across diverse user queries. Additionally, the paper sheds light on user-reported concerns, including GPT's neutral responses that may not address queries adequately, occasional unreliability, and security vulnerabilities. The study meticulously assesses GPT's performance in mathematical problem-solving, uncovering instances of inaccuracies and user dissatisfaction. The discussion delves into potential contributing factors, such as model architecture and training data, while proposing enhancements to mitigate these challenges. Moreover, the research acknowledges broader concerns, such as the delivery of excessively long answers and the lack of artistic touch and creativity in responses. Noteworthy is the observation that identical questions often yield remarkably similar responses, indicating a potential limitation in the model's diversity and adaptability. The paper concludes by underscoring the importance of addressing these challenges for an enhanced user experience and recommends future research directions for refining the ability of language models like GPT.

articleTitle: FOPID Controlled Indirect Matrix Converter for Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The execution of a predictive control strategy for an Indirect Matrix Converter (IMC) is presented in this study. The monitoring technique chooses a transition state that reduces reactive power and inaccuracy in output currents based on its basis values. Owing to the benefits over other designs, double fed induction generator (DFIG) wind turbines are now often employed in wind farms. As a result, system evaluation utilizing this type is now essential. Due to its significant features, Double Fed Induction Generators (DFIG) are effective in wind turbine uses. In this paper, a fractional-order PID (FOPID) controller for DFIG-based wind energy conversion system (WECS) is constructed. The FOPID controller was selected to increase the dynamic responsiveness of a standard PID controller with fixed gains by combining the conspicuous characteristics of fractional-order calculus and fuzzy logic functions. The simulation results from several case studies are thoroughly examined, demonstrating the advantage of the developed FOPID controller over the standard PID control strategy in following the output. The planned control strategy ensures seamless regulation of the WECS's actual and reactive power injecting into the grid while maintaining acceptable intermittent responsiveness. MATLAB/Simulink was used to calculate simulation results. In this paper the comparison graph shows the FO-PID controller efficiency level and THD values are 90.1% and 2.83% respectively.

articleTitle: Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization Based Shortest Path Routing in VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The present study examines the Vehicle Ad hoc Networks (VANETs) exhibit unexpected behavior due to their high mobility and random network structure. Including ad hoc networks, a variety of problems, including repeated connected breakdowns, flexibility, multi-hop transmission of information, and information loss, impact Transmission Control Protocols (TCP). To overcome this problem, this paper suggests employing zone-based routing in VANETs while taking mobility into account. The routing technique is implemented with a hybrid optimization strategy. The most significant swarm intelligence (SI) algorithm for solving optimization issues is the chaotic particle swarm optimization (CPSO) algorithm. Due to its simplicity, which involves just a few parameters, CPSO has grown to be considered one of the most frequently used optimization techniques. When resolving challenging optimization problems, the routing algorithms experience high overhead or incompatibilities. A CPSO based shortest path routing method is presented for VANET that offers a high-quality path for connection among nodes, improving the distribution of packets percentage and preventing end-to-end delay, in order to enhanced routing effectiveness and throughput in prevailing approaches. These achievements show that CPSO performs adequately and is experiencing significant progress.

Author Keywords: Vehicle Ad hoc Networks Transmission Control Protocols

articleTitle: Advanced Glaucoma Detection by Integrating ANFIS with CNN Models for Enhanced Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Glaucoma is a retinal disease affecting millions of people round the globe. It can lead to irreversible blindness unless detected early. In this research we differentiate glaucomatous eyes from normal eyes using a novel glaucoma detection framework that employs Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System classifier, VGG-19 and ResNet50 models. The proposed method concatenates the classification results from ANFIS, VGG-19 and ResNet50 models using post processing decision block that provides the final classified output. This approach overcomes the limitations encountered in existing techniques which significantly enhance diagnostic accuracy and robustness by incorporating the merits of the aforesaid three models. We precisely develop the framework through ensemble modelling which results an accuracy of 95.40%, a precision rate of 99.40%, a recall rate of 88.30% and an F1-score of 93.50%. Our research findings highlight the significance of integrating conventional optic disc measurements methods with image shape-derived features in machine learning models. This enables the early and accurate glaucoma diagnosis.

articleTitle: Systematic Review of Emerging Deep Learning approaches for Crop Diseases detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Deep learning, a branch of artificial intelligence, has drawn interest from the academic and corporate realms, especially in areas like speech and image analysis, video processing, and natural language processing. Its use in agricultural plant protection has expanded to include the diagnosis and evaluation of pests and plant diseases. In this situation, there are several benefits to using deep learning. It removes the biases related to manually chosen pathogen properties, improves objectivity when determining disease characteristics, and hastens the advancement of contemporary technology. In order to diagnose agricultural leaf illnesses, this study explores the most recent developments in deep learning methods, including CNN, DENSNET, InceptionV3, VGG16, Resnet50, and MobileNet, in addition to a variety of sensors. This project aims to aid scientists in the field by tackling challenges in merging deep learning and cutting-edge imaging tools to enhance illness identification. It addresses current trends and barriers, shedding light on unresolved issues and paving the way for further research. By clarifying persistent problems and posing new questions, it fosters progress and innovation in the field of medical imaging and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Precise Trap Handler for a Pipelined 32-Bit Processor for Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, we present the design of a trap handler designed for in-house developed 32-bit pipelined processor. The trap handler can handle both interrupts and exceptions precisely and is compliant to IEEE 1754 std. The exceptions are handled such that the instruction which raises the exception and the subsequent instructions in the pipeline do not change the state of the processor. In the case of interrupts, the instructions in the different pipeline stages complete their execution before the interrupt controller is called upon. The context of the processor is saved correctly so that the processor can resume the program flow correctly after servicing the trap.

articleTitle: Analysis of 8x8 Bit Various Multiplier Using Look-Up Table and Implementation in Fir Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In VLSI, the usage of multiplier in hardware for designing and implementing it in an application. In this paper the comparison of various 8x8 bit multipliers, including the Booth, Wallace tree, and binary multipliers, using look-up tables, or luts, in order to satisfy requirements related to performance and power usage. These elements are essential for determining which VLSI design is the most efficient. We have looked at the propagation delay and power dissipation. The propagation delay and power dissipation of our developed clock logics are minimal, according to the simulation results. When it comes to filters, the wallace tree multiplier works better with FIR filters. To generate schematic representations of the multipliers and obtain time, speed, and area characteristics, verilog code is implemented using the Xilinx ISE tool. MATLAB software is then employed to implement the FIR filter.

articleTitle: Towards Sustainable Seas Utilizing VGG19 Empowered Coral Health Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The application of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transfer Learning to coral reef conservation is examined in this article. In order to achieve this, a collection of 923 images categorising corals as either bleached or healthy is introduced. This article presents an automated photo classification approach based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to address the labor-intensive task of manually recognising coral reefs. This is especially significant because of the problems coral bleaching and other critical functions of coral reefs. The method makes use of training, validation, and testing datasets together with the pre-trained CNN model VGG19. Callbacks are used in model monitoring implementation. Batch size, epochs, and input form are among the model's explicitly stated hyperparameters. In machine learning, common assessment metrics include classification report, confusion matrix, and accuracy. The paper demonstrates how the proposed paradigm has benefits in terms of scalability, efficiency, and real-time monitoring. Encouraged results are shown by the 74% accuracy, which shows that CNNs can quickly detect and monitor coral reef health. Making educated judgements and starting conservation projects need this.

articleTitle: Advanced Weather Monitoring and Disaster Mitigation System with Interactive Weather Visualizations, Flood Zone Detection, Unplanned Drainage Identification, and Emergency Shelter Mapping including Optional Drought Intensity Prediction Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Advanced Weather Monitoring and Disaster Mitigation System is an essential resource for enhanced preparedness and response to unexpected events. It applies modern methods to show us dynamic weather images, detect regions susceptible to flooding, and present us with interactive weather maps. It is able of forecasting the intensity of an impending drought. These stupendous pictures and weather forecasts can assist everyone, including the public and authorities, make educated decisions and get ready for bad weather. In the case of flooding, the technology can detect high-risk areas, allowing officials to prepare ahead of time and safely evacuate citizens. It also looks for drainage problems before they cause disastrous flooding. By providing up-to-date information on local shelters, the system helps people find safe havens throughout emergencies. The alternative drought forecast may help farmers and water managers plan more effectively during dry spells. All of these components work together to protect us and lowered the effects of natural disasters.

articleTitle: Design of CMOS Based Lc-Voltage Control Oscillator Using Substrate Bias Effect and Low-Voltage Folded-Cascade Current Mirror Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper Proposed to design a CMOS Based LC-Voltage Control Oscillator Using Substrate Bias Effect and Low-Voltage Folded-Cascade Current Mirror Circuit using an LC tank circuit at 2.5GHz oscillation Frequency. The paper delves into the substrate-biasing technique, which adjusts the threshold voltage of a CMOS transistor, and the low-voltage folded-cascade current mirror circuit that utilizes CMOS technology to improve the performance of the current mirror circuit. The folded-cascade current mirror circuit comprises of a cascade structure in the input stage and a folded structure in the output stage, which is used to increase the output impedance and provide a more stable output current. The paper concludes that the folded-cascade current mirror circuit is a powerful tool in CMOS circuit design, offering improved performance and accuracy over the traditional current mirror circuit. In this simulation is carried out through cadence virtuoso generic process design kit (GPDK) with 90nm technology. The simulation results exhibits phase noise of -154.92 dBc/Hz @ 1MHz, low power consumption of 4.8mW and the Figure of Merit -216.09 dBc/Hz at 2.5GHz oscillation frequency

articleTitle: Advancing the Unveiled Target Detection Using Masked Non-Harmonic Point Process Analysis Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: When the task of target detection implies the use of denoising methods, it is regarded as one of the most important in the field of image processing. Although, technological advancements have made it easier for objects to be tracked in space, it is currently among the most popular things. An identification of a multiframe marked point process model for the automatic abstraction of target system from sequences of images and the means employed in observing the movements of images has been provided. The other method employed in the frequency assessment is the normal non-harmonic analysis which aids in the improvement of noise reduction. The observed image data and different prior physical interactive requirements between the target occur under the subsequent frame are also taken into the consideration successfully. It handles scatterer scintillations as well as high noise from speckle for the final target sequence in the iterative optimization. It proposes a lengthy Mask Non-harmonic Analysis of point sequence to evaluate non-uniform regions of segmentation-related shapes. Lastly, after excluding scatterer in the image scenarios, evaluation is carried out for sequences of aircraft targets in images with various time differences and the scenes build up to the intended destination area.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Automated Face Mask Detection: Enhancing Public Health Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has emphasized the critical importance of face masks in mitigating the transmission of respiratory infections. In this research paper, we explore the role of deep learning in automated face mask detection systems, aiming to enhance public health measures and safety protocols. Through a comprehensive literature survey, we review advancements in AI technology, particularly in the context of detecting mask-wearing individuals. Our methodology involves dataset preparation and training of convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures for binary classification tasks. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of deep learning models in accurately identifying individuals wearing face masks, with deeper architectures showcasing superior performance in terms of loss reduction and accuracy. We conclude that automated face mask detection systems offer invaluable support in enforcing mask-wearing regulations, especially in densely crowded regions and large gatherings. Furthermore, these systems provide valuable data for informing public health policies and resource allocation. This study highlights the transformative potential of deep learning in addressing current and future public health crises, emphasizing the centrality of technology in safeguarding community health and well-being.

articleTitle: Eva: Python-based Desktop Virtual Assistant for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Virtual assistants have become essential resources in the digital age, providing users with a wide range of functionalities to expedite work and increase productivity. In this research, we provide a complete examination of Eva, a virtual assistant created using Python, and compare it to other virtual assistants such as Cortana and Copilot. Through a meticulous examination of Eva’s features, we demonstrate its superiority in versatility and effectiveness. By embracing Eva’s strengths and capitalizing on its competitive advantages, we push for a future in which digital experiences are inclusive and empowering for all users.

articleTitle: Smart Milk Grading System for Quality Assessment and Adulteration Detection using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Ensuring the consumption of high-quality milk is particularly crucial for infants, especially in environments plagued by pollution. This paper introduces the Smart Milk Grading System (SMGS), an innovative IoT-based approach employing machine learning algorithms to accurately assess milk quality and tackle adulteration issues. The system incorporates an advanced liquid quality analyzer powered by Arduino, which effectively detects milk adulteration by monitoring key parameters such as pH, temperature, humidity, total dissolved solids (TDS), and gas levels. The collected data is then analyzed using six different machine learning classification algorithms. Notably, the Random Forest Classifier demonstrates exceptional accuracy in identifying milk adulteration, making it the most effective among the algorithms tested.

articleTitle: A Human Activity Determination Predicting Abnormality Using SVM Approach for Mining Field Workers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents a human activity determination system for predicting abnormalities in mining field workers employing a Support Vector Machine (SVM) approach. This system integrates various sensors including an oxidation sheet sensor, temperature sensor and pulse oximeter sensor to capture the data related to worker activities. The collected data is processed by an ESP32 controller programmed with a classifier, which is capable of learning patterns and predicting the occurrence of abnormal activities based on the sensor readings. The predicted results are then transmitted to a LoRa transceiver for wireless communication. The LoRa receiver receives the transmitted information and relays it to a NodeMCU, which serves as a bridge between the receiver and the mobile application. The mobile application is designed to display the oxidation data, heart rate data, and temperature data obtained from the sensors in real-time. By analysing the sensor data and utilizing the SVM classifier, the system aims to detect and alert mining field workers to potential abnormal activities, thus enhancing safety measures and minimizing the risk of accidents in mining environments. The proposed SVM classifier has a specificity of 89.47%, sensitivity of 89.47 and accuracy of 92.64%.

articleTitle: Gastric Cancer Unveiled: Navigating The Terrain Of Diagnosis And Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Gastric cancer (GC), commonly referred to as stomach cancer, is a perilous and potentially life-threatening form of cancer that impacts the digestive system. It significantly raises the risk of cancer related mortality. The timely identification and diagnosis of GC can significantly enhance the prospects of effective treatment and increased survival rates. As a result, it is important to know the causes and symptoms of stomach cancer and to get medical attention if anything changes. Detecting GC at an early stage is crucial for both successful treatment and improved long-term outlook for patients. As a result, developing effective approaches for early identification of this condition is critical. In this regard, new technologies for the accurate and reliable detection of GC have been created. These methods are capable of identifying alterations in the tissue composition of the stomach that suggest the presence of malignancy. They can also detect biomarkers linked to the disease, allowing for earlier identification. Using these tools, clinicians can diagnose GC in its early stages, resulting in improved outcomes for patients. This paper discusses some of the specific approaches used to detect stomach cancer.

articleTitle: Multiclass Breast Cancer prediction from Mammogram using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The breast cancer is a greatest threat among women across the globe. In the modern era of medical image analysis, the accurate identification of breast cancer from mammogram images is a critical task. This article proposes a methodology for developing a multiclass breast cancer classifier using deep learning architecture. The proposed methodology uses a sequential model architecture comprising Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, Dropout and Dense layers. All these layers serve a specific role in feature extraction and classification. The model extracts appropriate features from mammogram images and progressively learns and discriminates representations to enhance classification accuracy. The incorporation of regularization techniques such as Dropout layers overcomes overfitting, improving the acquisition of robust features. ROC curve analysis is used in the compilation and training phases to evaluate the model performance. This article provides a systematic approach to the development and evaluation of a deep learning model for breast cancer identification. This also offers insights into its architectural framework, training process and performance assessment techniques. The proposed method has achieved classification accuracy of 98%.

articleTitle: VLSI Secure communication: Advancements in Blowfish Algorithm for Secure Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving field of Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) systems, securing communication channels is of paramount importance due to the increasing prevalence of cyber threats. This paper presents Modified Blowfish (MBF) algorithm employed for secured communication in VLSI systems. While the traditional Blowfish algorithm delivers a superior balance between security and performance, the improved version focuses on further improving encoding speed, reducing power consumption and reducing hardware footprint, which are important factors for VLSI implementations. The novel modifications are introduced in key expansion and encryption processes to increase the throughput and efficiency of the algorithm when implemented in hardware. The MBF algorithm leverages parallel processing capabilities and optimized data paths to achieve higher performance metrics compared to the traditional Blowfish implementation. Extensive simulations and hardware synthesis results demonstrate that the improved algorithm outperforms existing encryption standards in terms of speed and energy efficiency, making it ideal for real-time secure communications in resource-constrained VLSI environments.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Speckle Noise Reduction in Ultrasound Images using Multistage Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The image quality and diagnostic accuracy of medical ultrasound imaging is greatly disrupted by speckle noise from various sources. Here, effective multi-stage filtering approach is introduced to eliminate maximum speckle noise from ultrasound images. In this method, the ultrasound image corrupted by speckle noise is initially subjected to homomorphic filtering to improve contrast. Afterwards, wavelet decomposition is applied to the image using a DAUB-32 wavelet to split it into approximation and detail sub-bands. In the next stage, bilateral filtering is performed on the approximation sub-band, while Bayes filtering is performed on the horizontal and vertical detail sub-bands, and Susan filtering on the diagonal details. Finally, inverse of the homomorphic filtering and wavelet transform are performed to obtain the despeckled image. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in significantly reducing speckle noise while preserving important image features thereby enhancing diagnostic quality over other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: SDN-Enabled Networks: A Deeper Learning-Based Echo State Neural Network for Cyber Threat Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Modern networks are becoming more intricate and interconnected, which has increased the demand for robust and effective methods of identifying cyberthreats. SDN, or software-defined networking, is one possible method for enhancing network control and administration. This paper introduces a new method for cyber threat detection in SDN-enabled networks using an Echo State Neural Network (ESN) that is based on deep learning. Echo State Networks are ideally suited for network traffic pattern analysis because of their remarkable capacity to capture the temporal fluctuations found in time-series data. Using cutting-edge deep learning techniques, the proposed Deep Learning-based Echo State Network (ESN) automatically extracts hierarchical features from unprocessed network data. This makes it possible for the model to identify intricate and nuanced patterns that point to potential cyberthreats. The main goal of this work is to integrate Deep Learning methods with the conventional Echo State Network architecture. The model can adapt to the complex properties of SDN settings with effectiveness thanks to this integration. Through training on historical network data, the model learns to discern normal behavior and then recognizes anomalies that may point to possible cyberthreats. The suggested method seeks to decrease the frequency of false positives while increasing the efficacy and precision of cyber threat identification. To demonstrate the Deep Learning-based ESN's effectiveness in identifying a variety of cyberthreats, it is tested on an actual SDN-enabled network dataset. The findings demonstrate how the suggested model outperforms traditional approaches in terms of reaction time and accuracy of detection.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based Proposed System for Malnutrition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In many nations, malnutrition is the primary cause of death for children under five. An inventive way to handle the problem of hunger in a non-invasive and effective way is through the use of deep learning in image processing for malnutrition diagnosis. The system trains a deep learning model, such as a convolutional neural network, on a huge dataset of photographs of people with various degrees of malnutrition in order to find patterns and features in the photos that indicate malnutritionFor ease of usage by medical practitioners, the trained model is then made available on a web-based platform or mobile device. The suggested system may supplement current practices and offer more data for a thorough evaluation, especially in environments with limited resources.

articleTitle: Enhanced approach to detect disease in the Respiratory System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Respiratory diseases pose significant health challenges worldwide, necessitating accurate and timely diagnosis for effective management. This paper proposes an approach for automated respiratory condition detection using X-ray images, leveraging ensemble learning techniques that integrate multiple models to enhance classification performance. The system is evaluated on a diverse dataset comprising images representing various respiratory conditions, including pneumonia, tuberculosis, normal lung, and coronavirus. The experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the ensemble model in accurately identifying different respiratory conditions, showcasing particular strengths. Furthermore, this research compares the ensemble model to individual models like VGGNet and ResNet, underscoring the superiority of the ensemble approach and elucidating its distinct advantages over traditional transfer learning models. The results indicate that combining different models through ensemble learning significantly improves diagnostic accuracy, aiding better decision-making and patient care.

articleTitle: Advancing Human Action Recognition: A Hybrid Approach Employing Autoencoder and Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Interest in human action recognition has grown over the past years within the academic community due to practical applications and prospective influence. The research in this area focuses on an analysis and understanding human behavior, mainly body language and gestures. Such behaviors pose an enormous challenge for deep neural networks due to their intrinsic intricality. The complexity comes from the complexity and diversity of the human movements that should be identified and interpreted. Successes in deep learning have changed associated domains, such as image analysis, object recognition, and speech recognition. A massive diffusion of these technologies followed. However, the activity recognition processes that purport to recognize human activities involve more than just detecting body movements. They require understanding the context of a situation and the intention behind those actions. Gesture can thus be defined as any overt body movement used by individuals to communicate information. It is a natural and intuitive way of communicating. This use of gestures as a mode of human-computer interaction portrays a smooth and user-friendly interface, most beneficial to speech and deaf individuals to interact with different categories of people. Our paper proposes a new model of human action recognition that foots the ground between the autoencoder and transfer learning approaches. In this model, an autoencoder as a feature extractor would be used to obtain some basic properties from the input data. These extracted features are finally fed into a pre-trained VGGNet, one of the well-known deep learning architectures, for classification. Our approach considerably enhances accuracy and performance in human action recognition compared to previous models from the results we obtained from our experimentation. Its effectiveness indicates that our proposed model can drive the industry forward, providing practical, real-world applications.

articleTitle: Listening to the Environment: Applying Deep Learning Techniques for Robust Environmental Sound Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Classification of environmental sounds plays an important role in various usages beginning from evaluating the city plans to materializing the ecological monitoring systems. Conventional soundscape separation methods using audio processing frequently typecast them as monotonous and not connected due to overlapping soundscapes from different sources. This research presents a deep model that takes into account the advantages of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and recurrent neural networks (RNN) to make more accurate environment sound classification tasks. The model is capable of such by representing the audio inputs that are being converted to spectrogram forms which convey both the spectral and the temporal features needed for quality sound classification. The validation of the model had to be done, using the metrics which complemented Accuracy, Precision recall, F1-score, and others. These three indices: Sensitivity, Specificity, and Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC) were used for evaluating the model’s capabilities. The results reflect the average sensitivity (over 86 % for all categories) and specificity (over 95% for all categories) with an AUC-ROC value of more than.93 across the different sound classes of environmental sound, showing the model's high discriminative skill. The parameter reveals that the model is capable of successfully identifying the composition of sound signals by categorization amidst other acoustic elements and interference. Contrastively, when we compared to traditional approaches like Support Vector Machines (SVM), the deep learning model outperformed in tissue type recognition and AUC-ROC matrix both in terms of being more sensitive and accurate enough to conclude that advanced neural networks are suitable for such kind of the tasks. Not only does the study add to the knowledge about acoustic phenomena, but also it is the next step toward the creation of a more dependable on-the-spot monitoring apparatus for environmental and urban planning.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Decentralized Trust Management and Secure Voting system
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the era of digital transformation, trust and security are paramount in ensuring the integrity of various online transactions and processes, including voting systems. Traditional centralized trust management and voting systems have faced challenges related to security, transparency, and accountability. To address these issues, this research introduces a novel Blockchain-Enabled Decentralized Trust Management and Secure Voting System . It leverages blockchain technology, a decentralized and immutable ledger, to enhance trust, transparency, and security in trust management and voting processes. This system combines several key components, including smart contracts, cryptographic techniques, and distributed ledger technology, to create a robust and tamper-resistant infrastructure. In the trust management aspect, the proposed system employs a decentralized reputation system where individuals and entities can build trust through transparent and verifiable interactions. Smart contracts automate trust-building processes and provide a reliable mechanism for dispute resolution. This system allows for trust to be quantified and established in a trustless environment. The secure voting component introduces a tamper-proof and transparent voting system. Through the use of cryptographic keys and digital signatures, voters can securely cast their votes while ensuring anonymity and integrity. All voting transactions are recorded on the blockchain, providing a permanent and auditable record of the election process. Verification of election results becomes accessible to all stakeholders, enhancing transparency and trust in the electoral process. The Blockchain-Enabled Decentralized Trust Management and Secure Voting System represents a significant step towards enhancing trust and security in critical online processes, such as voting. By combining blockchain technology, cryptography, and decentralized trust mechanisms, it offers a promising solution to address the challenges associated with centralized trust management and voting systems. This research paves the way for a more transparent, secure, and accountable future in the realm of digital trust and elections.

articleTitle: Real-time Threat Monitoring: Utilizing IoT Data for Intrusion Detection in Smart Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The ubiquitous adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has resulted in interconnected environments offering levels of convenience and efficiency. However, the complex nature and interconnectivity of these environments also pose cybersecurity challenges, such, as detecting access and monitoring potential risks. This research delves into the concept of real-time tracking of threats. Detecting intrusions in environments by leveraging the vast data streams generated by IoT devices. The paper explores the characteristics of data including its speed, variety, and scale which present both opportunities and challenges for effective Network infrastructure implementing intrusion detection systems. It also investigates the techniques and approaches used to leverage data for threat surveillance, including anomaly detection machine learning algorithms, and data integration methods. Moreover, it underscores the importance of scalable detection technologies that can adeptly address the evolving dynamics of smart environments. Through an analysis of academic studies and empirical research, we uncover prevalent trends, hurdles, and promising avenues in utilizing IoT data for intrusion detection, in smart environments. The main goal of this article is to offer suggestions and insights, for creating intrusion detection systems that are robust efficient tailored to the requirements of interconnected IoT settings.

articleTitle: Smart Wearable Devices for Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques: Depth Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The emergence of the COVID-19 epidemic has emphasized the continuous need for innovative and discreet methods to monitor and evaluate the progression of the disease. Wearable technology, equipped with an array of sensors and powered by advanced machine learning algorithms, presents a highly promising solution. These devices make use of sensors like heart rate monitors, pulse oximeters, temperature sensors, and accelerometers to continuously gather real-time data. This research explores how wearables, including fitness trackers and smartwatches, can be used to continuously monitor the COVID-19 disease and capture the data. It also explores applications in assessing COVID-19 severity through the utilization of machine learning techniques. Machine learning techniques including decision trees, support vector machines, and deep neural networks are used to process this data. This includes the early detection of warning signs, evaluating disease progression, and distinguishing between mild, moderate, and severe cases. The integration of patient-reported symptoms with wearable data further enhances the precision of assessing COVID-19 severity.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Review of High-Performance DC-DC Converters for Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In order to provide high power, inexpensive, and dependable charging options for the EV battery, power electronic converter study and creation is required due to the widespread acceptance and anticipated expansion of electric vehicles (EVs). However, in order to drastically minimize the volume and weight of an EV, off-board chargers must be used for dc fast and ultra-quick charging. In this paper we concentrate on technical information, current progress, and problems while discussing the topology and control strategies of dc-dc converters. Furthermore, the majority of current multiport EV chargers that combine grid integration, EV, PV, and energy storage are showcased. Furthermore, in order to provide guidance for future studies in EV charging remedies, a comparison of the structures and control strategies of dc-dc converters, and multiport conversion devices has been conducted. This analysis covers design, power and voltage levels, effectiveness, bidirectionality, control factors, benefits and drawbacks.

articleTitle: Solar-Powered Unit with Novel Reversible Inversion for Sustainable Electrocoagulation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper focuses on electrocoagulation with a significant and environmentally conscious effort aimed at tackling the escalating issue of wastewater pollution. Utilizing electrocoagulation, an electrochemical process, this initiative effectively eliminates a diverse range of contaminants and impurities present in both industrial and municipal wastewater streams. By inducing controlled electrical reactions, metal ions are produced within the wastewater, serving as coagulants that facilitate the aggregation and precipitation of pollutants. This innovative approach excels particularly in the removal of challenging substances such as heavy metals, suspended solids, and organic compounds. The core objectives of this project revolve around enhancing water quality, mitigating the environmental repercussions of wastewater discharge, and fostering sustainable water management practices. Electrocoagulation presents a cost-efficient and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional wastewater treatment methods, minimizing reliance on chemical additives and mitigating the release of harmful substances into natural water ecosystems. This endeavour holds immense promise for a broad spectrum of industries, municipalities, and water treatment facilities seeking adaptable and efficient solutions for wastewater treatment. Through the adoption of electrocoagulation, our aim is to elevate water quality standards, bolster the environmental resilience of our communities, and advocate for sustainable approaches to wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Music Recommendation and Generation Based on Face Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: To pioneer a personalized and emotionally resonant music recommendation platform, this study proposes a groundbreaking approach that integrates emotion detection and Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) for music generation. The system harnesses sophisticated emotion detection algorithms to analyze user emotions in real-time, extracting insights from textual inputs, speech tones, and facial expressions. Subsequently, leveraging a combination of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), music tailored to the identified emotional state is generated through an LSTM music production model. This real-time synthesis culminates in a customized playlist finely attuned to the user's emotional landscape. Continual refinement of recommendations is facilitated through user feedback, ensuring a fluid and adaptive music recommendation experience. The project's innovation lies in its fusion of LSTM-driven music creation with emotion detection, enhancing user satisfaction by delivering music that not only aligns with their emotional state but also resonates with their musical preferences. The efficacy of this approach in providing emotionally appropriate musical recommendations is underscored through rigorous user studies and comparisons with conventional recommendation systems. By leveraging cutting-edge technology in emotion recognition and LSTM-based music generation, this initiative aims to redefine music recommendation systems, offering users a more personalized and immersive experience within music streaming platforms.

articleTitle: A Study on Integrating Machine Learning Techniques for Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The current study focuses on how various Machine Learning (ML) algorithms can be used in waste management and emphasizes the significance of intelligent technologies in addressing contemporary issues. By leading a broad writing survey, the paper features the meaning of incorporating these advances into waste management practices. The system segment subtleties the information assortment, preprocessing, model determination, and assessment measurements utilized in the review. The accuracy and performance metrics of various classifiers, including K Nearest Neighbors, Linear Support Vector Classifier, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Multi-Layer Perceptron, and Random Forest, are demonstrated by the results of experiments with them. Especially noteworthy is the MLP classifier's 91.81% accuracy. The discoveries highlight the viability of ML approaches in ssmart waste management. In addition, a comparison table that summarizes the classifiers' accuracy scores provides insight into their suitability for applications in waste management.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease: The Data Mining AI Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: chronic kidney disease or CKD is a major universal medical issue, which impacts infinite number of individuals worldwide. Early diagnosis and treatment of CKD are essential for stopping disease progression and lowering the risk of consequences. Data mining (DM) methods have been applied recently to find people who might be at risk of getting CKD. In order to identify early-stage CKD using electronic health records, this study suggests hybrid approaches that include various data mining approaches, such as association rule mining, decision trees (DT), and logistic regression (LR). The outcomes show the potential of data mining and machine learning algorithms to enhance early CKD detection and offer prompt therapies to slow or reverse the disease's progression. The proposed hybrid method can be utilized as an additional tool to help healthcare professionals find patients who are at risk and enhance patient outcomes. The efficacy of this strategy in various patient populations and healthcare settings needs to be further investigated.

articleTitle: Effective Cognitive State Monitoring Using FBNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The integrated Electroencephalogram (EEG) signal processing and deep learning for robust cognitive state classification is the idea behind this paper. The EEG data that are received are first preprocessed. To preserve the accuracy of the data, noise artifacts from the raw EEG signals are removed during the preprocessing stage. The decomposed signals are subjected to statistically feature extraction in order to extract pertinent properties and produce an accessible summary of the data. By exposing the frequency domain data, spectral estimating improves the analysis even more and makes it possible to identify certain patterns linked to different cognitive states. Using deep learning methods for cognitive state classification is the last stage of the recommended methodology. Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs) are used because they are able to identify spatial connections in the data, while, Feed Forward Back Propagation Neural Networks (FFBNNs) have an architecture that is flexible enough to understand intricate temporal interactions. Mat lab software is utilized in the implementation of this paper. The comparison diagram between the algorithms as find for accuracy, sensitivity and specificity. The accuracy level of the obtained CNN and FFBNN at signal 120 is 91.7% and 92.8% individually.

Author Keywords: (FFBNN) Feed Forward Back Propagation Neural Networks

articleTitle: Career Compass : Navigate your Career journey with confidence
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The "Career Compass" system employs smart technology to assist users in finding their next job. Users provide preferences such as skills and desired salary, and the system utilizes advanced algorithms to recommend suitable job opportunities. By analyzing diverse job information including titles, required skills, and salary expectations, "Career Compass" generates a curated list of jobs that align with the user’s preferences. Whether users are uncertain about their next career move or seeking tailored recommendations, "Career Compass" serves as a personalized career coach, offering guidance at their fingertips.

articleTitle: Innovative Hybrid Renewable Energy System for Stable Active Distribution Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Active Distribution Networks (ADNs) have been developed to strengthen the diversification of the energy structure and compensate for the deficiencies in the development of traditional distribution networks. This work proposes advanced control techniques with a unique Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES) to assure the effective and sustainable operation of ADNs. The system is composed of a Photovoltaic (PV) array with a Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) based Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS). The Zeta converter is utilized to improve the voltage of the PV system and the Moth Flame Optimization-based PI (MOS-PI) controller maintains the stable power supply. Furthermore, the DC microgrid is connected to a battery converter and battery storage system, offers energy storage capacity to reduce variability and intermittency in the availability of renewable resources. The overall performance is improved by using the proposed system. The results are obtained by using the MATLAB software to check the performance of the proposed system.

Author Keywords: Moth Flame Optimization based PI controller(MOS-PI)

articleTitle: Mixing and Filling Operationas using PLC, SCADA and IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, an automated liquid mixing and filling that imitates a real system is developed, utilizing Delta Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) DVP14SS2 as the Master controller programmed by using WPLSoft 2.51 software However, the programming language motivated by international standard IEC 61131-3. System monitored using DOPSoft 4.00.16-Supervisor software As the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System. IOT Module ESP8266EX is used for system start & stop remotely. The software provides a user friendly Human Machine Interface (HMI) to monitor and control this system. Ladder diagrams are used to design the system's operating sequence. The components used in this work are programmable logic controller (PLC), Electromagnetic relays in PLC, proximity sensor, push buttons for start & emergency stop, level switches, solenoid valves, and DC Motor, which consists of three sections such as the conveyor section, filling section and mixing section. This work will be useful in paint industries, concrete industries, Beverage processing industry and Food processing technology.

articleTitle: Unifying Segmentation and Classification in Skin Disease Diagnosis: U-Net & CNN Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Skin-related conditions are a common global health concern. Depression and physical health issues are both brought on by the hidden risks of infections. Furthermore, in extreme circumstances, Skin cancer could arise from it. Thus, one of the most difficult challenges in medical image processing is identifying skin disorders from clinical photographs. Furthermore, Medical practitioners' physical diagnosis of dermatological problems is laborious and subjective, Because of this, Patients and dermatologists alike need autonomous skin disease prognosis since it expedites the treatment approach. We describe here a morphological filtering-based digitized hair removal technique that makes use of the Black-Hat transformation and the inpainting algorithm. After that, the images are processed using a denoising convolutional neural network in order to remove noise. Furthermore, To improve skin lesion segmentation accuracy, we utilize the U-Net model. Then, using the attributes that were collected, we apply the computationally efficient deep learning technique Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to effectively identify the skin photos as Actinic keratosis, Benign keratosis, Eczema, and Melonocytic Nevi. Our U-Net model gives a accuracy of 92% and CNN gives a accuracy of 70%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Agriculture Using Data Science and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The research aims to optimize agriculture using data science techniques. Agriculture is a critical sector for sustaining life on earth, and optimizing it can enhance food security and increase the profitability of farmers. Data science techniques such as machine learning, data analysis, and modeling to analyze agricultural data and derive insights are the key areas in this work. The project will focus on enhancing crop productivity, reducing wastage, and improving resource utilization. The findings of the project can help policymakers, farmers, and stakeholders to make informed decisions and take appropriate actions. The project aims to support the sustainable agriculture practices and promote the efficient use of resources for the benefit of both farmers and consumers.

articleTitle: Efficient Power Extraction in Off-Grid Photovoltaic Systems with Landsman Converter: An Adaptive Fuzzy Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: An innovative approach for enhancing power extraction efficiency in off-grid photovoltaic (PV) systems through the use of Landsman Converter is proposed. This method tackles the difficult task of optimizing power extraction efficiency in off-grid situations when energy management and storage are essential. An Adaptive Fuzzy Control (AFC) method is proposed to improve its performance even more. AFC uses the adaptability and flexibility of fuzzy logic-based control systems to dynamically modify the Landsman Converter's functioning in response to external factors, load demands, and system parameters. Through constant observation of relevant variables including temperature, load demand, and solar irradiation, the AFC algorithm cleverly modifies the converter's operational parameters in real-time to optimize power extraction efficiency and guarantee peak system performance. Overall, by presenting a novel control strategy that improves power extraction efficiency and encourages the sustainable deployment of solar energy technologies in remote and off-grid areas, this study advances the state-of-the-art in off-grid PV system optimization. To evaluate the efficacy and practicability of the proposed strategy, simulation research and experimental validation are carried out. The comparison chart shows the proposed converter's efficiency of 92.3% and an AFC settling time of 0.23s.

articleTitle: Innovative Roadguard: Yolov8-Powered Road Damage Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Road damage poses a significant threat to public safety and infrastructure integrity. The proposed project enhances road maintenance by employing YOLOv8, a state-of- the-art deep learning model, for accurate and efficient identification of various types of road damage.
