Existing methods for road damage detection predominantly rely on traditional computer vision approaches or earlier versions of YOLO that often struggle with real-world challenges, such as variations in lighting conditions, diverse road surfaces, and the presence of complex patterns. The innovation in this project involves the integration of advanced pre-processing techniques, data augmentation strategies, and fine-tuning procedures specific to road damage scenarios. Its single pass detection provides speed and accuracy to enhance the model's real time detection capabilities. The proposed method enhances accuracy for precise road damage identification, aiding effective resource allocation. Sufficiently high mAP values indicate the robustness of the model under varied environmental conditions. There is also a comparison done using the yolov5 model on the same dataset and exact some conditions to prove the efficiency of yolov8 in practical situations.

articleTitle: Solar Based Smart EV Charging Station with Smart Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This abstract highlights the significant progress made in combining solar energy, smart technology, and efficient energy management for EV charging infrastructure, representing a crucial stride toward sustainable transportation. The project focuses on creating solar-powered smart EV charging stations equipped with an intelligent battery management system (BMS) employing Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) technology. These stations aim to maximize the capture and utilization of solar energy, ensuring optimal performance of the solar panels in diverse environmental conditions. Furthermore, the integration of smart features enables remote management, monitoring, and control, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and effectiveness. The smart BMS effectively manages energy storage and distribution, optimizing charging and discharging cycles to extend battery life. Its intelligent features allow for remote monitoring and control, enabling real-time adjustments based on energy needs, user preferences, and grid availability. This integration promotes cleaner transportation and enhances energy resilience. With connectivity and data analytics, operators can optimize charging schedules, predict maintenance needs, and contribute to grid stability by supplying stored renewable energy during peak demand. Overall, the integration of solar-based smart EV charging stations with a smart BMS employing MPPT technology represents a significant advancement in sustainable transportation infrastructure, fostering cleaner mobility and a smarter energy ecosystem.

articleTitle: RIS and UAV Aided Spatial Modulation for 6G Telecommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A paradigm shift in wireless communication is expected with the advent of 6G communications networks, which would need the development of innovative technologies for ultra-reliable, low-latency communication to support massive device connection. This study presents a novel method for 6G communication networks, which integrates the use of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) with the Spatial Modulation (SM) architecture. The ultimate goal of the proposed 6G system's RIS and UAV-Aided spatial modulation is to increase communication's bit error rate (BER) and spectrum efficiency. In order to optimize signal propagation in UAVs acting as mobile communication nodes, RIS is positioned strategically in this strategy. Data bits are modulated into spatial symbols to activate certain RIS elements and UAV configurations. The study looks at how real-world issues like erroneous channel estimates affect RIS and UAV communication lines. Through thorough simulations and theoretical validation, the proposed system is assessed in terms of its BER and spectrum efficiency, indicating its superiority over traditional communication systems. The results show that RIS and UAV integration may enhance 6G communication systems' capabilities.

articleTitle: Ternary SRAM Cell Designs for Next-Generation: A Comprehensive Investigation of 6T, 8T, and 10T Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Ternary logic is popular where it uses logic levels of 0, 1 and 2 instead of using the old binary logic structure. Due to this, it has grown to be very popular method in many applications. It is used in applications which focuses on high density data processing and also to obtain lower power consumption. The design of this SRAMs poses lot of challenges and there is a high demand for robust and optimized memory units. This work concentrates on overcoming the problems of higher power consumption that is found in traditional SRAM cells. It focusses on the comprehensive study if 6T, 8T and 10T SRAM cells. Through this study, the performance metrics are analyzed for power consumption and R/W efficiency. The results obtained shows the lower consumption of power and improved R/W efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Machine Learning Modelling for Soil Analysis and pH Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Traditional laboratory testing for soil samples from various sites is frequently expensive and time-consuming. This study suggests replacing traditional lab testing with quick, precise answers using new technologies like the Internet of Things (IoT), sensors, and machine learning. The study specifically investigates the use of a portable Internet of Things device with sensors to examine soil samples in various areas of Haldwani in the Uttarakhand region. To categorize and forecast soil pH levels, this paper provides a foundation for an artificial neural network (ANN). The ANN model's outcomes demonstrate an astounding level of accuracy, coming in at 91%. This study demonstrates the potential of IoT-based strategies and machine-learning techniques for effective soil analysis and recommends practical ways to integrate them into existing soil testing procedures.

articleTitle: Lung Tumor Detection Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In simple terms, lung cancer is a significant challenge that the fields of science and medicine are working hard to overcome, which gives the highest mortality rate, besides being one of the smallest survival rates after diagnosis. Thereby, early detection is essential for diagnosis and treatment. All people in this universe require a proper diagnosis of the tumor. Diagnosis need to be in maximizing the payoff. Increasing the payoff is much important mainly in medical diagnosis. Machines need to do an intelligent task in diagnosis of tumor and in this case the lung tumor. Here, the investigation is done with different solvers. Deep learning with a Convolutional Neural Network compatible with the analysis of Computer tomography scans with tumors, the level of accuracy in predictions sees a tremendous enhancement. Classification of tumors by Convolutional Neural Network as malignant or benign with good accuracy is obtained.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Software Defect Prediction Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study aims to revolutionize software defect prediction by leveraging deep learning (DL) techniques, specifically focusing on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Stack Sparse Autoencoders (SSAE). The research involves training these models on datasets from the NASA Metrics Data Program, using metrics such as accuracy, precision, detection rate, and True Negative Rate (TNR) to evaluate their performance. The proposed methodology includes normalization of data, application of neural network architectures, and extensive experimentation with varying parameters. Results demonstrate that CNN outperforms SSAE, achieving a higher accuracy range of 0.84 to 0.93 compared to SSAE’s 0.80 to 0.90, particularly excelling on the PC1 dataset with an accuracy of 0.93. Both models, however, show strong capabilities in predicting software defects, with CNN consistently delivering better performance across diverse datasets. The study concludes that DL models, especially CNN, significantly enhance the efficiency and accuracy of software defect prediction, suggesting future research to explore additional DL techniques and larger datasets for further advancements in software quality assessment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human-Computer Interaction with a Low-Cost Air Mouse and Sign Language Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the development of assistive technologies that are designed to empower people with disabilities by increasing their level of freedom and accessibility. Voice assistants, air mice, and software that recognizes sign language are some of the topics that are specifically covered in this. Those who have impaired fine motor skills can benefit from using air mice since they allow controls to be made by hand gestures. Using machine learning algorithms, sign language recognition software is able to decipher signs with an accuracy rate of over 90 percent, making it easier for people who are deaf or hard of hearing to communicate themselves. By relying solely on vocal instructions, voice assistants like Alexa make it possible to control devices without using your hands. Not only do these technologies have the potential to be revolutionary, but they also confront obstacles in terms of improving identification accuracy and integrating them into common gadgets. In this study, the development and impact of voice assistants, sign language software, and air mice are discussed. More specifically, the paper highlights the potential for these technologies to help millions of people with disabilities all over the world. Additionally, it examines potential enhancements that could be made to these technologies in the future in order to further improve accessibility and inclusivity. This research integrates computer vision and machine learning to create a multimodal system blending air mouse functionality with real-time sign language translation. Achieving 95% accuracy in gesture recognition for air mouse control and 98% accuracy in sign language letter classification using a basic webcam, the system promotes accessible interaction without specialized hardware. Despite limitations in vocabulary and lighting sensitivity, future efforts aim to broaden data training and explore mobile deployment. These advancements hold promise for enhancing natural human-computer interaction, particularly for users with disabilities, by enabling intuitive, hands-free control and communication.

articleTitle: Smart Fetes Monitoring System Using Healthcare IoT For Pregnant Women
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed healthcare by enabling the creation of advanced systems to monitor and support various aspects of well-being. A key focus area is the health of pregnant women and their fetuses. The proposed IoT system offers a novel approach to enhance the overall health and safety of pregnant women and their developing fetuses by utilizing IoT technology. Temperature sensors, heartbeat sensors, and glucose level sensors are essential in tracking vital signs and delivering valuable information to healthcare professionals. These sensors are used to monitor the health of pregnant women and the fetus's heartbeat. By integrating these sensors into a pregnancy care app, a comprehensive and convenient solution can be provided for monitoring the health of both the mother and the fetus.

articleTitle: An Efficient Shortest Path Optimized Algorithm For Vehicle Adhoc Networks System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: VANET (Vehicular ad-hoc network) is a network of advanced automobiles designed to solve the problem of mobility and, as a result, reduce the number of accidents. Because VANET is a type of MANET (mobile ad hoc network) surrounded by human-driven nodes, the social concept can be used to explain VANET routing decisions. This motivates academics to look into the possibilities of using Social Network Analysis (SNA) to create routing strategies. The most critical problem in any system is parcel drop. Social characteristics-based architectures encounter comparable challenges, resulting in inefficient message delivery. In this research, the dragonfly method is used to the shortest path methodology for fixed line VANET with the purpose of reducing package drop and increasing network reliability. This is made achievable by sculpted system of values centralization analysis, which improves the decision via dragonfly optimization methodology. The behavior of the using nodes capability then be determined by the importance computation. In this study, the sustainability of the optimized shortest path system is measured in terms of End to End delay, Energy Consumption, Packet Loss, and Throughput. The dragonfly algorithm’s throughput evaluation is 650 kbps as compared to the traditional way.

articleTitle: Edge Computing and IoT-Driven Renewable Energy Integration for Decentralized Smart Grid Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The increasing global need for energy and environmental concerns have led to a rise in the usage of Renewable Energy Sources (RESs), such as Photovoltaic (PV) systems and Wind Energy Conversion Systems (WECS). The efficiency and performance of RES systems may be significantly increased by combining edge computing and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. In this paper, the edge computing-enabled IoT technology for renewable energy sources (RESs) such as solar panels, wind turbines, and storage energy converters is given. The paper discusses the main benefits of this approach, which include improved real-time monitoring, proactive maintenance, load balancing, and energy management. It also examines the underlying technologies, including edge devices, communication protocols, and data analytics techniques. In addition, the study discusses issues including security, scalability, and interoperability while outlining future research objectives and problems in this quickly developing subject. This study presents the economic benefits and technological viability of the proposed decentralized smart grid paradigm through extensive simulation findings. The results demonstrate how edge computing and the Internet of Things play a critical role in reshaping power systems based on renewable energy and opening the door to a more robust, sustainable, and customer-focused electrical grid.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity with Machine Learning: Evaluating the Efficacy of Isolation Forests and Autoencoders in Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The growing intensity of cyber threats requires security systems with high intellectual capabilities that are dynamically adapting to new challenges. This study explores the utilization of Isolation Forests and Autoencoders in machine learning for anomaly detection. It is for their contribution to cybersecurity to boost it. In this research, an extensive dataset of network traffic that manifests both normal and malicious instances is used to examine the efficacy of these models in detecting anomalous events that may constitute cyber threats. The approach applied involves data collection, preprocessing, the thorough evaluation of the models against metrics such as Anomaly Detection Rate (ADR), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), False Alarm Rate (FAR), and Detection Consistency (DC) Output shown that applying Isolation Forest has found 85% anomalous record, with a time to detect of 2 seconds and a consistency of 90%, while Autoencoder got slightly lower detecting rate but beats off false alarm by finding only 4%. Unlike traditional methods done by Support Vector Machines and Decision Trees where this model not only was successful but in some cases performed better, it validated their implementation ability and usefulness in the cybersecurity real world. The research presents a major activity of applying Isolation Forests and Autoencoders to cybersecurity systems which elevate their anomaly detection potency. This also explains the importance of combining it with other machine learning models within the existing security systems, for the ability to boost the accuracy in detection and decrease response time to threats. Therefore, this study is one of the crucial pieces in the building of systems that are adaptable and resilient to attacks that continue to be more unpredictable.

articleTitle: Exploring Efficiency: Comparative Study of Microcontroller Energy Consumption and Performance Optimization Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study presents a comparative analysis of energy consumption and performance characteristics across varying operating scenarios of prominent microcontrollers. Specifically, the impact of processor clock frequency and sampling frequency on energy efficiency and system performance in embedded applications is explored. Findings reveal insights into the trade-offs between energy consumption, average power usage, and processing time associated with different frequencies. Higher frequencies generally lead to reduced execution time and energy consumption, with variations among the microcontrollers. These insights inform decision-making processes for optimizing power usage and system design, highlighting the importance of selecting appropriate frequencies to achieve desired performance metrics while maintaining energy efficiency. Additionally, the study examines the impact of time intervals (tcycle) on energy consumption behavior, revealing distinct patterns among microcontrollers. Comparisons of voltage range, frequency range, and energy consumption figures underscore the significance of these specifications in selecting microcontrollers tailored to specific application requirements, aiding in the development of energy-efficient embedded systems and IoT devices.

articleTitle: Multiport DC to AC Inverter with Intelligent Controller Integration for PV-Based Grid Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Modern power management solutions are desperately needed, as demonstrated by the exponential growth of photovoltaic (PV) systems for grid applications. The innovative multiport DC to AC inverter technology introduced in this project is specifically designed for PV-based grid configurations as a response. With four DC ports and one AC port, this project presents a multiport DC to AC inverter system intended for grid applications based on PV technology. Battery banks, PV arrays, supercapacitors (SC), and electric vehicle (EV) batteries may all be connected more easily thanks to the DC ports. Three power switches with PWM rectifiers running at fundamental frequency are used to link the EV port (EV) of a three-phase inverter to the switching nodes. A PI controller integrates a Luo converter that is managed by a solar panel. Bidirectional converters inside the DC connection link supercapacitors and batteries, enabling operation at times when solar panels are not in use and recharging when solar power is available. An Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller synchronizes the three power sources, which are combined into a three-phase inverter for grid integration and DC to AC conversion. Comprehensive power control across the several DC ports is made possible by this integrated MPC inverter, which also makes communication with the electrical grid easier. With a voltage gain of 1:8, and an efficiency of 92%, the proposed Luo converter is quite effective.

articleTitle: Segmentation And Classification Of Brain Tumor Using CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Segmentation and classification of brain tumors using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is a critical advancement in medical imaging, offering precise and automated analysis of brain scans. This study presents a CNN-based framework designed to accurately segment and classify brain tumors from MRI images. The proposed method leverages the deep learning capabilities of CNNs to discern tumor boundaries and classify tumor types, ensuring high accuracy and efficiency. Through extensive training on annotated datasets, the CNN model learns to identify complex patterns and features unique to various tumor types. The results demonstrate significant improvements in both segmentation and classification performance, underscoring the potential of CNNs in enhancing diagnostic processes and aiding in clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Multiclass Brain Tumor Detection using EfficientNet B3 Model with Magnetic Resonance Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumour diseases identification have grown in importance for accurate and efficient medical imaging diagnosis. In this study, the EfficientNetB3 architecture used, a cutting-edge convolutional neural network (CNN) noted for its efficiency and performance, to create a multiclass brain tumour detection system. The goal is to categorise brain MRI scans into four types: no tumour, glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumour. The effective use of EfficientNetB3 for brain tumour diagnosis demonstrates the utility of advanced deep learning architectures in medical picture processing. EfficientNetB3 can help healthcare practitioners diagnose and treat brain tumours, allowing for more timely treatments and personalised patient care. this study illustrates the revolutionary influence of deep learning in neuro-oncology and paves the door for improved diagnostic capabilities in brain tumour detection.

articleTitle: Innovative Waste Management: The Efficiency of IoT-Enabled Smart Bins
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study is focused on understanding the operation of IoT-based smart bins under a waste management framework that is used in urban setups. The forefront is the objective of tackling the ubiquitous challenge of space garbage and increasing cost inefficiency in highly urbanized areas. This project seeks to assess the capacity of the smart container to enhance the trash pickup efficiency, diminish the environmental impact, and satisfy the community’s required service in a municipal setting by incorporating important features like real-time monitoring and the tracking of the dustbin level. This way implies forming smart bins equipped with ultrasonic, temperature, weight and tilt detectors. These bins, as well as the system architecture that is programmed to receive, transmit and store data, come with a computer software application that is equipped to assemble, encode and decipher data. While a pilot project was carried out in the city within six months, the researcher collected empirical data about garbage buildup patterns, detection accuracy of sensors, reliability system, and the way of optimizing collection routes. The experimental results give the 50% improvement in collection efficiency worth mentioning since now the collection time decreases to two hours against the previous 8 hours. The operational cost decreased by 25%. However, the instances of overspill decreasing by 83.3% indicate the system’s utility in urban waste management. However, a carbon emission impact assessment indicates a significant reduction in carbon emissions that may be directly linked to the optimization of routes for transporting the collections. One of the most important things that had a major effect was the fact that satisfaction ratings among the citizens rose by 1.5 and reached the level of 8.5 on a scale of 10. Indeed, the figures imply that the residents of the city saw an improvement of 30.7% in the way their waste is managed as a result of this program.

articleTitle: Optimizing Water Resources: An IoT Smart Management System Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Contributes to a comprehensive review of IoT technologies and their application and effectiveness of water resources in agricultural, urban, and industrial sectors. Finally, with the help of a number of practical cases, the author focuses on IoT systems that include sensors as well as active elements, such as actuators. Such systems are systemically applied to control and manage water usage and hence have yielded a lot of achievement in this field of efficiency and sustainability. According to the findings of the present research, this technology of IoT has reduced water usage by twenty per cent and has worked effectively to improve water leak identification and reaction time. Particularly, the actual time required for identification and stoppage of leaks has decreased 12 times from 90+ mins to 25+25 mins in various contexts. The value for the tests that support this is the p-value lower than 0, which shows that statistically, in the form of a t-test, these benefits can be regarded as important and valued by the users. 01, and this proves that the observed increases may, in fact, result directly from IoT technology. It also shows the drawbacks of the IoT, namely, high initial costs for its perception and high requirements for the protection of information. These insights show that it is important for policies to adapt to the inclusion of IoT and for industries to get involved with the management of water. It also underscores how IoT is capable of making significant success in attaining international sustainability goals. The findings of this study show increased optimism about the importance of IoT in managing water resources. It formulates a foundation that serves as a roadmap for future trends and policies in this sector.

articleTitle: Utilizing Spectrograms and Deep Learning Techniques for Improved Music Genre Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the modern world, music occupies a major and possibly even vital position in our day-to-day behaviors. The variety of musical genres is extraordinarily extensive, and each genre possesses its own set of traits that are unique to itself. Individuals are able to acquire their own distinct musical preferences and styles as a result of this variation. Accordingly, it has become a relevant and contemporary problem to accurately categorize music as well as propose new tracks to consumers on music streaming services and purposes. This is because of the fact that music is always evolving. In order to effectively solve this difficulty, one of the most successful techniques is to categorize music according to the genre it belongs to. This method not only helps in organizing the vast selection of music that is available, but it also improves the user experience by delivering customized suggestions based on the user's interests regarding the genres of music. In this investigation, we attempt to solve the problem of automatically categorizing different types of music by recasting it as a query using pattern recognition. Generation of spectrograms from the sound waves was the method that we utilized in order to approach the content analysis of musical compositions through the visual domain. Through the use of these spectrograms, which serve as graphical representations of the audio information, the subtle patterns that are present within the music are captured. We utilized a wide range of machine learning and deep learning methods in order to successfully recognize and categorize these patterns. For the purpose of representation learning, we specifically utilized convolutional neural networks (CNNs), support vector machines (SVMs), ResNet-50, and AlexNet. The selection of these algorithms was based on their capacity to effectively manage complicated data and to derive relevant characteristics from spectrograms. For the purpose of our research, we made use of the GTZAN database, which is a dataset that is internationally recognized in the discipline of music genre classification. With regard to the various algorithms that were utilized, AlexNet was able to attain the maximum level of accuracy in the classification of the music genres, so demonstrating its efficiency in this endeavor.

articleTitle: Hybrid Scheme of Post-Quantum Cryptography and Elliptic-Curve Cryptography for Certificates ─ A Case Study of Security Credential Management System in Vehicle-to-Everything Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to the use of elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) for the current Security Credential Management System (SCMS) in the IEEE 1609.2.1 standard, the SCMS is vulnerable to attacks from quantum computing, as ECC could be cracked by quantum algorithms. However, although the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has already selected post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms as standards, the current PQC algorithms may have issues such as larger public key lengths, larger signature lengths, or lower efficiency for generating signatures and verifying signatures, which may not fully meet the requirements of SCMS in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communications. Considering the challenges in packet length, signature and verification efficiency, security level, and vehicle privacy in V2X communications, this study proposes a hybrid certificate scheme combining PQC and ECC to overcome these challenges. By using PQC to establish a security level resistant to quantum computing and utilizing ECC to establish anonymous certificates and reduce packet length to meet the transmission requirements of SCMS in V2X communications. In the practical experiments, this study utilizes the Chunghwa Telecom’s SCMS of Chunghwa Telecom and the Clientron’s on-board unit (OBU) for field testing in Danhai New Town in New Taipei City. The performance of various PQC algorithms (including Dilithium, Falcon, and SPHINCS+) and the hybrid certificate scheme with ECC are compared, providing a practical solution that can be implemented.

articleTitle: Enhanced Breast Cancer Diagnosis: Leveraging Customized Transfer Learning with Machine Learning and Attention Mechanisms for Histopathology Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Breast cancer diagnosis relies heavily on accurate histopathological image analysis, necessitating advanced methodologies. This study presents a comprehensive deep learning framework integrating preprocessing, feature extraction via customized VGG16 transfer learning model, hybridization with XGBoost, and incorporating attention mechanisms such as self-attention and convolutional block attention module (CBAM). The research aims to develop and assess deep learning models for precisely categorizing benign and malignant samples across various magnifications using the BreaKHis dataset, comprising of breast tumor histopathology images. Various preprocessing techniques, including color normalization, data augmentation, and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), are deployed to address challenges like class imbalance and enhance model robustness. Results exhibit significant enhancements in classification performance and interpretability, with accuracy levels ranging from 90% to 99% across all magnifications. VGG16, incorporating a convolutional block attention module, demonstrates exceptional performance, underscoring substantial advancements in breast cancer histopathology image classification and model interpretability. These findings position attention mechanisms like CBAM as critical contributors to enhanced diagnostic accuracy and performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Dijkstra Algorithm for Enhancing QoS in SDN through Balanced Routing
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study provides a detailed examination of network routing algorithms by comparing the effectiveness of the Time to Live (TTL) algorithm against both Single-objective and Multi-objective Dijkstra algorithms under varying network conditions. The focus of this research centers on assessing and optimizing key network performance indicators including average latency, packet delivery ratio, and bandwidth utilization through the application of different weight configurations within the Multi-objective Dijkstra framework. In conducting a series of comprehensive simulations, the study highlights that the Dijkstra-based algorithms considerably surpass the performance of the TTL algorithm. Notably, the Multi-objective Dijkstra algorithm demonstrates exceptional results, achieving a 100% packet delivery rate across all tested configurations. Furthermore, it manages to strike the most effective balance between latency and bandwidth utilization, confirming the critical role of carefully calibrated algorithm parameters in optimizing network operations. The results distinctly showcase how strategic adjustments to the algorithmic weights can significantly impact the efficiency and effectiveness of network routing, especially in complex and dynamically changing environments. This tailored approach ensures that the algorithms are not only reactive but also proactive in managing network demands efficiently.The paper also discusses potential future research directions that could further refine these findings. One promising area involves the integration of machine learning techniques to facilitate real-time routing decisions, potentially enhancing responsiveness and adaptability in network management. Additionally, applying these advanced routing algorithms to emerging network technologies like 5G and the Internet of Things (IoT) could lead to substantial improvements in data handling and transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Secure Data Deduplication for Efficient Cloud Storage Using Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Secure data deduplication for efficient cloud storage using blockchain technologies addresses the challenge of reducing storage costs and improving data management in cloud environments. By leveraging blockchain technology, this approach ensures data integrity and security during deduplication processes. The system eliminates redundant data blocks while maintaining a secure authentication mechanism to verify the integrity of stored data. Blockchain's decentralized and tamper-resistant nature enhances the trustworthiness and transparency of the deduplication process. Through the utilization of cryptographic techniques and smart contracts, the system guarantees secure data handling, ensuring that only authorized users can access and modify deduplicated data. By incorporating blockchain technology, the proposed solution enhances the efficiency and security of cloud storage operations, making it a promising approach for organizations seeking to optimize storage resources and protect sensitive information.

articleTitle: Autonomous Navigation Through Gmapping-Based SLAM: A Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Autonomous navigation via GMapping-based SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) enables robots to both navigate and map their surrounding environment. This paper conducts a comprehensive evaluation of the performance of the GMapping-based SLAM algorithm within the realm of autonomous robotic navigation. A two-wheel robot equipped with GMapping-based SLAM undergoes testing in dynamic conditions to assess its real-world performance. The focus lies on enhancing our understanding of the algorithm's reaction to dynamic conditions, investigating its response to fast-moving objects, its adaptation to sudden environmental changes, and its mapping efficiency. Through a meticulously designed series of experiments, the GMapping algorithm is scrutinized under diverse conditions to gauge its robustness and adaptability. During the experiments, the robot encounters fast-moving obstacles at varying speeds, observing its mapping and path-planning capabilities. Specifically, a fast-moving obstacle is simulated using a remotely operable TurtleBot with speeds ranging from 0.2 to 0.6 m/s. The assessment process involves metrics such as velocity, speed, and distance to the fast-moving obstacle as primary indicators. The findings from these experiments offer insights into how GMapping SLAM performs in sudden environmental conditions. This research acts as a foundation for advancing GMapping's capabilities and facilitating the evolution of intelligent robotic platforms in complex real-world environments.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Financial Management Optimizing Investment Portfolios through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Financial management has generally focused on static and rule-based solutions to optimize investment portfolios, which can lead to inefficiencies and increased risk exposure in volatile markets. To address these issues, the study provides an AI-powered financial management system that uses advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques for portfolio optimization. The system uses real-time data evaluation and predictive modeling to dynamically change investment allocations and risk profiles in response to market conditions. The proposed system collects and preprocesses large amounts of financial data, trains ML models to detect trends and investment possibilities, and includes a robust portfolio rebalancing mechanism. Compared to traditional techniques, the AI-powered technique seeks to optimize returns while limiting risk through rapid and data-driven decision-making. According to the results of the overall performance evaluation, the proposed system outperforms existing systems in terms of common annual ROI (12.5%), Sharpe Ratio (1.2), and maximum drawdown (-5.2%). It displays superior overall performance throughout a variety of market circumstances, including bull, bear, and stagnant markets.

articleTitle: Recent Developments in MIMO Antenna Architectures and their Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output technology has been instrumental in the way we communicate wirelessly. It is a key factor in the overwhelming growth of modern communication systems, providing higher data transfer and improved performance. MIMO technology utilizes multiple antennas at the transmitting and receiving ends to increase the capacity of wireless communication networks and improve signal quality. This allows for faster data transfer speeds, more reliable connections, and better overall coverage. With its ability to transmit multiple data streams simultaneously, MIMO technology is rapidly becoming a key enabler for next-generation wireless communication systems. With regards to the multi-functionality in wireless communications and providing a high data rate MIMO technology is very vital. It reduces multipath fading and consumes less power. Apart from the challenges of Isolation, antenna miniaturization must be the game changer. Designing Antennas concerning multiband and wideband performance requirements is simultaneously being proposed by many researchers. At 5G network establishments, MIMO Antennas are inevitable and it provides impeccably better results compared to the conventional Antennas. This paper addressed the recent developments in MIMO technology in a brief manner.

articleTitle: Identification of Epileptic Seizures using Recurrent Neural Networks and Time Series Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent years epileptic seizures have become a major impact on large number of people worldwide. Over 60 million people have been affected globally due to this neurological condition. These seizures are caused by excessive discharge of electrical signals in the brain. To identify the excess discharge of signals, a device called electroencephalogram (EEG) is used. This device captures the signals by placing multiple sensors in scalp of the brain. However, the signals from the brain vary in time with different individuals thereby requiring more data. Also, differences are found in the signals between various stages of seizures. To overcome these issues and to detect the seizure automatically from EEG signal a novel Ensemble approach is proposed using Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Time Series Transformer (TST). Raw EEG signals are pre-processed to remove undesirable noises from the obtained signals for further processing. The TST model was utilized to extract characteristics from EEG recordings. Furthermore, a recurrent neural network incorporating a long input layer, fully connected layer, activation layer was constructed in parallel to train the features, classify the EEG data, and identify the seizures. The effectiveness of the network was further examined and compared using various activation channels. The findings demonstrated that the suggested network could achieve a reasonably accurate prediction using a mere 18 channels. Experiments were carried out on the CHBMIT and Bonn datasets. Proposed method achieved an accuracy of 94.31% with an F-Score of 91.93%. Furthermore, classification of seizures has been improved compared to state of art methods.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security and Vedic Scripture Approaches for Sustainable Consumption in Global Food Legislature Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the crossing point of artificial intelligence (AI) and cybersecurity within the setting of sustainable consumption. Sustainable consumption practices are crucial for tending to natural challenges and advancing a more sustainable future. In any case, the expanding dependence on computerized advances and interconnected frameworks in sustainable utilization presents unused cybersecurity dangers and dangers. This paper analyzes how AI can be utilized to improve cybersecurity measures and back sustainable utilization activities. It investigates AI-driven approaches such as information analytics, machine learning, and behavioral modeling to reinforce cybersecurity guards, ensure individual information, distinguish and avoid cyber dangers, and cultivate believe and certainty in advanced stages. The paper too examines the moral contemplations and challenges related with the utilize of AI in cybersecurity for sustainable utilization. Through an examination of existing inquire about and case thinks about, this paper gives experiences into the potential benefits and confinements of joining AI and cybersecurity in sustainable consumption and production. The discoveries contribute to the understanding of the part of AI in guaranteeing the security and flexibility of sustainable consumption frameworks and give proposals for future investigate and usage procedures. Eventually, the paper highlights the significance of grasping AI-driven cybersecurity approaches to back and progress sustainable consumption objectives whereas relieving cybersecurity risks.

articleTitle: LDHP: Experimental Evaluation Of A Secured Blockchain Based Data Management Framework Using Lightweight Document Handling Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: One of the most important technologies that will drive the shift from the Information Internet to the Value Internet is blockchain. How to utilize blockchain for data management is becoming a hot topic as more and more companies investigate block-chain’s potential industrial uses. Blockchain technology's intrinsic scalability issues become apparent, however, while dealing with an enormous amount of IoT devices as well as the vast volumes of data created by these networks. Consequently, to address these issues, this study employs a Lightweight Document Handling Principle (LDHP). To manage data from the Internet of Things (IoT), we provide a blockchain-based platform that can scale to accommodate many devices. The suggested scheme's efficacy is assessed by cross-validating this method with the traditional model known as Decentralized Data Security (DDS). The authors of this work presented a solid method for checking database consistency and tracking down errors. To do this, the suggested LDHP is used in a secondary consensus. This method greatly improves the reliability and accuracy of data management by solving the common problem of database mismatches and excelling in other critical areas including data security, verification of information, and error tracing. In order to facilitate future developments in safe and effective data handling, we provide a robust solution through. Modernizing data management using blockchain technology may boost efficiency, enhance data quality, and foster an atmosphere conducive to exchanging information.

articleTitle: Cross-Platform Multimodal Frogeye Leaf Spot Recognition and Classification: Advancing with Cutting-Edge CNN Technologies and Transfer Learning in Diverse Plant Species
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Frogeye Leaf Spot, a common agricultural disease, poses a significant threat to crop yields. Using multimodal data from different platforms successfully has been a hurdle for existing research in leaf spot detection. Using cutting-edge convolutional neural network (CNN) and transfer learning techniques, this research presents a Cross-Platform Multimodal Recognition system to solve this issue. With a recall of 0.88, F1-score of 0.90, accuracy of 0.91, and precision of 0.92, the suggested method demonstrates exceptional performance. Our accuracy is 6% higher, F1-score is 8% higher, and recall is 9% higher than the preceding state-of-the-art, according to comparisons with previous studies. Improved Frogeye Leaf Spot detection on many platforms is a direct result of our method's success in combining picture and sensor data. This study improves farmers' ability to identify diseases and provides a solid answer for precision agriculture. Our Cross-Platform Multimodal Recognition system has shown to be effective in enhancing agricultural disease recognition, and the shown advances highlight its potential influence on crop management tactics.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Employee Performance Evaluation Systems in HR Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Employee performance evaluation is essential in human resource management, but existing systems are typically subjective and inefficient, resulting in skewed results and employee dissatisfaction. The paper addresses these limitations by introducing an AI-powered employee performance rating system. The system uses data-driven insights and powerful algorithms to provide objective assessments, improving objectivity, fairness, and efficiency in the review process. The proposed system provides real-time feedback and insights by combining extensive data collection and integration, Machine learning (ML) model selection, NLP analysis, and explainable AI methodologies, allowing HR managers to make educated decisions and successfully support employee development. The results and analysis show that the AI-powered system outperforms conventional approaches, with accuracy values ranging from 0.78 to 0.85, precision values from 0.79 to 0.86, and recall values ranging from 0.76 to 0.84. These results demonstrate AI technology's potential to promote organizational success by improving performance evaluation systems, encouraging staff development, and gaining a competitive advantage in the marketplace.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Load Forecasting and Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Energy management plays a pivotal role in today’s world, driving sustainable practices and optimizing resource utilization for a brighter, more efficient future. Despite significant advancements, accurately forecasting residential energy consumption remains a challenge due to the complexity of usage patterns and the limitations of existing models. This study explores the application of advanced machine learning techniques for residential energy consumption forecasting through time series analysis. By applying machine learning models like Vector AutoRegression (VAR), XGBoost, LSTM ,and LightGBM models, the research aims to predict usage patterns with high precision. Our findings highlight LightGBM’s superior performance in capturing complex patterns compared to other models, addressing a significant gap in the current understanding of energy consumption forecasting. Specifically, LightGBM achieved a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 1.37%. The robustness and accuracy of LightGBM in this context underline its potential as a powerful tool for energy management. This proposed model contributes to the development of a user-centric platform for energy management, emphasizing sustainability and cost reduction. By providing detailed insights into consumption patterns, the system facilitates informed decision-making, promoting efficient resource allocation and enhancing grid stability. The work’s strengths lie in its comprehensive approach and the thorough evaluation of multiple models, ensuring the quality and completeness of the findings. These practical implications benefit both energy providers and consumers by optimizing energy consumption and ensuring grid stability, marking a significant step towards sustainable energy management. By effectively addressing the complexities of energy usage patterns and improving forecast accuracy, this study paves the way for more reliable and efficient energy management solutions, fostering a sustainable future for all stakeholders involved.

Author Keywords: Home Energy Management System,Vector Auto Regression, Light Gradient Boosting Machine, Extreme Gradient Boosting

articleTitle: Emphasis Interaction Based Industry 5.0 Smart city Digital Twin’s Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The proposed research endeavours to establish a symbiotic relationship between Interaction-Based Industry 5.0 and smart cities, emphasizing the transformative capabilities inherent in Digital Twin technology. Digital Twin, as a central focus, provides a virtual replica of physical entities, allowing for real-time monitoring and analysis of industrial processes and urban environments. By seamlessly integrating Digital Twin with Industry 5.0 principles, this paper aims to empower smart cities in effectively managing the voluminous data generated by Internet of Things (IoT) devices. The research emphasizes the pivotal role of cloud computing in harnessing and processing the extensive datasets, ensuring that smart cities can derive actionable insights for informed decision-making. A key aspect of the proposed approach is the development of a hybrid infrastructure, leveraging diverse resources to enhance both efficiency and reliability. The envisioned synergy between Interaction-Based Industry 5.0, Digital Twin, and cloud computing is poised to revolutionize urban planning, administration, and overall intelligence in smart cities. The anticipated outcomes of this research promise to shape a more resilient and technologically advanced future for urban landscapes

articleTitle: Indoor Navigation System Using Wi-Fi RSSI
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study is about formulating an indoor navigation framework with the help of Wi-Fi Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) fingerprinting technology which would suit a college campus. GNSS solutions are not found in indoors because there is signal loss and lack of vertical positioning that result from the same. Instead, our solution takes advantage of the pre-existing Wi-Fi infrastructure which means that we have an effective and low-cost indoor positioning system. We collected RSSI data from different Wi-Fi access points placed at various locations to create a fingerprint database that can uniquely identify signal signatures at different spots. This information helps us match real-time data with our database through a KNN algorithm, ensuring accurate user localization and turn-by-turn navigation. The mobile application, developed using Flutter, integrates several libraries including Wi-Fi Scan, Geo Locator, and Path for data collection, processing and visualization while also offering an attractive user interface through Material Design framework for Flutter. This project showcases the potential of Wi- Fi RSSI fingerprinting for indoor navigation, providing a scalable and practical solution for environments with existing Wi-Fi networks.

articleTitle: Classification and Prediction of Stroke Disease Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Using text mining tools and machine learning algorithms, the paper presents a prototype for classifying strokes. The significance of machine learning extends across various domains, including surveillance, medicine, and data management, where appropriately trained algorithms prove invaluable. The study incorporates data mining techniques, offering a comprehensive understanding of information tracking from both semantic and syntactic perspectives. By analyzing medical case sheets, the proposed approach extracts symptoms and trains the system based on that information. A total of 507 case sheets are collected at "Sugam Multispecialty Hospital" in "Kumbakonam", Tamil Nadu, India, during the data collection phase. A tagging and maximum entropy approach was used to mine these case sheets. Stroke classification relies heavily on the suggested stemmer for distinguishing between common and special features. To handle the data that has been processed, support vector machines, XG Boost algorithms, SGD algorithms, decision trees, and random forests were used as machine learning algorithms. Random Forest demonstrated the highest accuracy among stroke classification algorithms evaluated. This integration of text mining and machine learning offers a promising framework for enhancing stroke classification based on patients' symptoms extracted from medical case sheets. The synergy between these technologies provides a robust methodology that can contribute significantly to improving the efficiency and accuracy of stroke diagnosis and classification in a medical.

articleTitle: Deepfake Classification For Human Faces using Custom CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper emphasizes the urgent need for effective deepfake classification methods, particularly for human faces, due to the escalating threat of this technology. The research proposes a comprehensive approach using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model and two Transfer Learning models (ResNet-50 and EfficientNet B7) to address this challenge. It investigates the synthesis of realistic-looking facial manipulations and their societal impacts, highlighting the importance of accurate classification in mitigating these effects. The study evaluates and compares the proposed models' accuracy in detecting manipulated facial content, analyzing their strengths and limitations. Overall, the paper provides a timely exploration of deepfake classification, offering practical solutions to enhance digital security and trustworthiness.

articleTitle: Advanced Development On Real Time Monitoring Of Bridges Using Wireless Fidelity
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Wireless fidelity technology enables communication without the use of wires or connections between two or more people across large distances. Wireless technology encompasses communications that utilize both radio frequencies (RF) and infrared waves. The origin of wireless technology can be traced back to the invention of electromagnetic waves by the German physicist, geophysicist, and engineer, Heinrich Hertz. In the late nineteenth century, the commercial wireless telegraph service was established by the Italian entrepreneur Gugliello Marconi, more than half a century after the invention of the first commercially available wired telegraph in 1832. In the early twentieth century, Marconi was one of the pioneers of radio communications, transmitting radio signals to mobile receivers on ships. Wireless has always been more advanced than wired technology, and it's usually more expensive too, but it's also given us the added benefit of being able to move around and get and send information.In this project, we'll be using MATLAB software to design and test the full model. We'll also be looking at wireless bridge health monitoring systems. ZigBee acts as the wireless network for short-range IEEE 802.11 communication between sensors in the bridge.

articleTitle: Beyond the Table: A Federated Learning CNN’s Framework for Classifying Serve Shots in Table Tennis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The approach categorized serve shot motions into five distinct classes, enabling detailed performance analysis for players and coaches to rely on the Federated Averaging (FedAvg) method to achieve the aim of our endeavor. This allowed us to aggregate local data learning into a unified global model. This study indicates that the data, which is international and the utility of which is further improved by the inputs of clients from different locations, has achieved significant levels of recall, precision, and accuracy, respectively. Client bj_5 achieved outstanding levels of precision and recall, with both metrics reaching 88.86% and 89.07%, respectively. The precision-recall score reached 0.89, while the accuracy was 0.96. In contrast, bj_2 exhibited a minor delay, achieving precision and recall rates of 76.96% and 77.21%, respectively. In that respect, the system got an F1-Score of 77.01% and an accuracy of 91%. Additional macro, micro, and weighted averages examination highlighted the model's reliable performance across different serve shot motions. The highest value of the macro average (i.e., 77.06%) was observed in model bj-2, while the lowest was recorded in model bj-5 (i.e., only 83.35%). Micro averages of the model showed a more comprehensive range of model accuracy, which was only 76.99% in the model bj-2, and only the model's robustness was confirmed by observing weighted averages ranging from 76.94% (bj_2) to 88.94% (bj_5). Results reveal the intervention as an opportunity for the branch of sports statistical analysis to create accurate predictive models while at the same time safeguarding athlete privacy. Our work not only enhances the set of methods used for analyzing athlete performance but also offers a scalable approach that may be used in other fields, including processing and analyzing sensitive data.

articleTitle: Literature Survey on Face Recognition of Occluded Faces
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, a study of the recent advancements in occluded face recognition is made. Recently, this has become very relevant due to the outburst of corona virus. Because of the seriousness of the spread of the disease, every person wore a mask, and it became challenging for automated systems to identify the person. So, it became the need of the hour to find new techniques for occluded face detection. In the years 2021 to 2022, many papers have been published in this regard. Researchers all over the world have contributed significantly towards occluded face recognition. Also, the advancement of deep learning has helped researchers a lot in implementing innovative techniques to deal with the challenges in face recognition, especially occluded faces, which is considered one of the most difficult challenges to overcome. This paper intends to push the limits further and encourage researchers to find more innovative techniques for occlusion-independent face recognition. In this paper, the recent publications in this field are studied. This paper gives an insight into different algorithms which use Convolutional Neural Networks, Deep Learning, Attention mechanism, Dictionary representation, Simultaneous segmentation, Joint segmentation and identification, etc., for occluded face detection and recognition. Incorporating these strategies in face recognition has substantially improved the recognition rate, specifically for occluded face recognition. Additionally, the databases for training occluded face recognition algorithms lack adequate data. This paper also gives an insight into the recent databases available for training occluded face recognition algorithms. Also, different methods for obtaining synthesised occluded faces are discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Sensor Data Handling Controller for Modern Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a sensor controller, focusing on efficient data handling for integrated sensors utilized in robotic applications. In this study, we describe an extensive analysis of data collected with various sensors using multiple communication interfaces, such as USB Serial, I2C, and UART, which are used to transmit control commands and sensor data. A Teensy 4.1 microcontroller serves as the sensor controller in this system, enabling communication between the sensor controller and the system master controller. The study provides comprehensive environmental perception and control in robotics with the integration of ultrasonic sensors, current sensors, IMU, and hall sensors. To guarantee dependable sensor data acquisition and system functionality, the testing approach evaluates both manual and protocol-based communication for each sensor. This work demonstrates the simultaneous data reception made possible by the integration of several sensors with different protocols into a single microcontroller. The process of evaluating accuracy required contrasting human measurements with protocol-based communication for a range of sensors, including IMUs (orientation detection), current sensors (current flow measurement), and ultrasonic sensors (distance measurement). The integrated sensor system was put to the test using a variety of measuring techniques, including software-based and manual protocols, as part of the validation process. The precision of individual sensors is demonstrated by the results, which validate the correctness of the data acquired. The results of the experiment provide a detailed comparison between data provided by software and manual measurements, confirming the dependability and efficiency of the integrated sensor system. From the experiment results it is clear that the accuracy of the system is above 90%.

articleTitle: Interference Detection in IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In wireless communication, signal interference poses a significant challenge, particularly within the Internet of Things (IoT) environment where many devices communicate autonomously. This paper explores the application of deep learning algorithms to enhance interference detection, thereby improving the reliability of communication channels. The deep learning Bi-LSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) algorithm is used to analyze interference across four distinct wireless networks: Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Zigbee, and GPS.Our study conducts a comparative analysis of these networks, focusing on their capacity to transmit signals with minimal interference. The findings reveal that Wi-Fi and Zigbee networks exhibit a remarkable 100% accuracy in signal transmission, indicating their superior performance in interference mitigation. This high level of accuracy is attributed to the utilization of random signals during the evaluation process, which may vary when applied to real-time signals. The research presented herein lays the groundwork for future exploration into more sophisticated neural network topologies and the integration of machine learning in IoT for robust interference detection.

articleTitle: Simulation of Battery Driven Electric Vehicle with Regenerative Braking
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This work introduces a simulation framework aimed at evaluating the efficacy of regenerative braking systems in electric vehicles (EVs) utilizing brushless DC (BLDC) motors. Central to the simulation is the regenerative braking system, which efficiently captures energy during braking utilizing PID controllers to optimize performance while ensuring vehicle stability. Moreover, closed-loop control strategies are incorporated to adapt motor speed and torque in response to real-time inputs from the braking pedal, enhancing the overall responsiveness and efficiency of the system. With a focus on monitoring and visualization tools, this work facilitates the analysis of simulation results in real-time, offering valuable insights into optimal vehicle design, control strategies, and energy management techniques for sustainable electric mobility. By evaluating the performance of EVs under diverse driving scenarios and assessing the impact of regenerative braking on energy efficiency, this research contributes to the advancement of electric vehicle technology, paving the way for more environmentally friendly and efficient transportation solutions in the future.

articleTitle: Strengthening Healthcare Cybersecurity by Optimizing Adversarial Attack Defences in Deep Learning Models using GPU and Parallel Processing Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In healthcare, safeguarding patient data integrity is paramount, necessitating robust deep learning models. This research focuses on bolstering the cyber security defenses of these models, particularly against adversarial attacks, through the application of the Localized Adversarial Feature Attack (LAFEAT) technique. Leveraging Graphics Processing Units (GPU) and the TensorFlow framework, the study explores algorithmic enhancements like the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM) and Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML). These techniques perturb input data gradients or adapt model parameters, enhancing resilience against adversarial perturbations. Additionally, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), a metaheuristic optimization technique, is examined to fortify defense mechanisms further. Parallel processing techniques, utilizing parallel GPU or distributed clusters, are implemented to expedite the optimization process, reducing computational burdens and enhancing scalability. Despite advancements, gaps remain in understanding how these models can be optimized for real-world healthcare applications, particularly in terms of balancing computational efficiency and robustness. The research demonstrates tangible benefits, with a significant 10% increase in success rates against adversarial attacks compared to baseline methods. Moreover, parallel processing implementation results in a 30% reduction in optimization time, improving the efficiency of cyber security defenses for deep learning models in healthcare. These numerical enhancements underscore the research’s value in fortifying healthcare systems against adversarial threats, ensuring the security and integrity of patient data while addressing existing gaps in the optimization of adversarial defenses in healthcare applications. The strengths of this research lie in its robust adversarial attack optimization techniques, integration of parallel processing for efficiency, and application to critical healthcare tasks. Comprehensive empirical results validate the significant improvements achieved in both success rates and optimization efficiency, underscoring the practical impact of this work.

articleTitle: Student Dropout Analysis for School Education
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The "Student Dropout Analysis for School Education" initiative focuses on the study of dropout student data in schools. Dropping out of school refers to being absent from school for multiple days without a valid excuse. To address this obstacle, a detailed understanding of the underlying difficulties is required, as well as good intervention planning. In an effort to address the issue of early school departure, machine learning has garnered a lot of interest over the years. This is so that prompt intervention planning and the identification of kids who are at-risk can be facilitated by machine learning approaches. To gather, arrange, and synthesize the body of knowledge already known about machine learning to prevent dropouts, case studies, books, and scientific journals were reviewed. According to the survey, there have been various machine learning algorithms proposed in the literature. But the majority of these algorithms were created and evaluated in industrialized nations. Consequently, there is a dearth of research on applying machine learning to this issue in poor nations. Additionally, a lot of research uses student-level datasets to address college dropout. However, underdeveloped nations must incorporate datasets at the school level due to resource constraints. Thus, an overview of machine learning in education is given in this work, with a particular emphasis on dropout prediction methods.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review Analysis on Osteoarthritis Using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Technologies for Arthritis Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Osteoarthritis is a prevalent degenerative knee joint disease, causing considerable pain and mobility issues, thus impacting the independence and quality of life of millions. Deep learning and Machine Learning techniques have emerged as promising tools for enhancing the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of osteoarthritis (OA). These technologies allow for the extraction of valuable insights from medical images, clinical data, and genetic information, thereby improving patient care and management strategies. By employing advanced algorithms, healthcare professionals can improve early detection, and treatment plans, and accurately predict disease progression, ultimately leading to better outcomes for OA patients. This paper proposes a comprehensive review of various DL-based and ML-based methods for OA, spanning the years 2020 to 2024. It aims to provide valuable insights for researchers interested in exploring different models and potentially inspiring the development of integrated approaches for even more effective OA detection.

articleTitle: A Review on the Analysis of the Effectiveness of Permission Based Security Models in Android Apps
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: As the ubiquity of Android devices continues to grow, the importance of safeguarding user data and privacy within the Android app ecosystem becomes increasingly critical. Central to this security framework is the permission-based security model, which grants users control over the extent to which apps access sensitive device resources and personal information. This paper provides a thorough examination of the efficiency of permission-based security models in Android applications, furnishing valuable perspectives on the everchanging realm of security. At the core of Android’s security framework lies the permission-based security model, a system designed to regulate an app’s access to sensitive device resources such as the camera, microphone, location, contacts, and personal data. This model empowers users by granting them the authority to approve or deny these permissions when installing or using an app, ostensibly ensuring the privacy and security of their data. This review embarks on a comprehensive exploration of the effectiveness of permission-based security models in Android apps. In the context of the permission-based model, it explored potential security vulnerabilities and the real- world risks they pose to users devices and data. The performance of different malware detection systems associated with the permission based android apps and its limitations are also analyzed in this paper. By synthesizing existing research and empirical evidence, this paper provides valuable insights into the current state of permission-based security in Android apps and suggests directions for future research and development.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Strategic Fusion of IoT and AI for Enhanced HR Performance in Stocks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Organizations are constantly exploring new technological avenues to enhance their human resources operations. This study explores the potential advantages of incorporating the technologies of artificial intelligence with the Internet of things into HR operations. This paper aims to provide a thorough examination of prior research and case studies, shedding light on the benefits, drawbacks, and optimal approaches related to this merger. Companies are closely examining both their internal human resources (HR) processes and their external recruiting efforts. Utilizing empirical data and qualitative research, this paper adopts a mixed-methods approach to offer practical implementation recommendations. There are several benefits to consider, such as cost savings, improved recruitment, increased employee motivation, and more efficient performance evaluation. Addressing concerns such as data security, complex integration, and a lack of expertise is crucial. When it comes to HR productivity and efficiency, organizations can greatly benefit from the combination of IoT and AI. By adopting a strategic approach that emphasizes collaboration and careful planning, businesses can maximize their gains.

articleTitle: Optimizing Web-based Inventory Management system using QR code Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A pioneering web-based inventory management system, harnessing the power of QR code technology to revolutionize traditional inventory tracking methods. Built using PHP and JavaScript, the system facilitates seamless data retrieval, updates, and visualization, significantly enhancing operational efficiency. Case studies underscore the system's efficacy, showcasing remarkable improvements in retrieval speed of 25 seconds, also improving the efficiency to 81%, and reducing error rate of 4.5%. The integration of QR codes introduces an innovative approach to rapid data entry and reliable tracking, while dynamic QR code generation enhances adaptability across diverse industries and organizational scales. This forward-thinking solution offers organizations a robust, error-resistant system, poised to elevate productivity and streamline inventory management processes. With its user-centric design and cutting-edge technology, the proposed system represents a practical and scalable solution for modernizing inventory management practices.

articleTitle: AI Based Phishing Discrement for Immense E-Maildata
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cybersecurity assaults have become more commonplace in recent years. In the majority of these events, attackers successfully breached government agencies, renowned corporations, and the websites of social groups and politicians across numerous nations using numerous kinds of unsolicited emails as a kicker. Big email data analysis for the purpose of spam detection has received widespread attention. However, spam mail's camouflage technology is becoming more and more sophisticated, and the current detection techniques are unable to keep up with the more sophisticated deception techniques and the increasing volume of email. In this, we suggested to build a brand-new effective method called Spam Spoiler for classifying large amounts of four categories for email data: typical, dishonest, harassing, and disbelieving emails. The phase of expanding the sample and the phase of testing with sufficient samples are two crucial steps of the new methodology. According to experimental findings, Spam Spoiler outperformed other machine learning methods and used an LSTM with recurrent gradient units to obtain a classification accuracy of 98%. Since various themes are covered in email content analysis. While preserving the robustness and dependability of the categorization process, Spam Spoiler efficiently outperforms current approaches.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urinary Tract Infections Using Machine Learning Based Prediction and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Infections of the urinary system are the most prevalent kind in humans. An infection of the urinary tract, encompassing the ureters, the bladder, kidneys, and urethra, is known as a UTI. The area of the urinary tract most commonly infected with a UTI is the lower part of the urinary tract, which includes the bladder and urethra.
