Although the bladder infection is inconvenient and uncomfortable, if it spreads to the kidneys, catastrophic consequences could result. Women are physiologically more susceptible to urine infection than males are. In this study, the causes and consequences of urinary tract infections data sets are examined and evaluated, as well as the efficacy of machine learning in predicting urinary disease. Additionally, the research recommended utilising machine learning to predict urine infections, predict the outcomes of planned therapies using real-time data, and test those predictions. To obtain high accuracy in predicting UTIs, this paper utilizes a confusion matrix, machine learning classification, and an artificial neural network (ANN) approach. Certain parameters were selected using an analysis of variance technique. A naive Bayes classifier, J48 decision tree algorithm, and ANN were employed to predict urine infections. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of approximately 85.6% for UTI prediction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Farming Practices through a Comprehensive Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In response to the pervasive challenges faced by farmers, including crop failure, insufficient knowledge, and crop damage, a holistic solution has been introduced. This comprehensive approach encompasses a Crop Recommendation System, Fertilizer Suggestions, and Crop Disease Detection Systems. To systematically address soil quality, a sophisticated examination system measures pH, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium levels. Leveraging advanced Machine Learning classification algorithms, the system analyzes soil data to provide tailored crop recommendations, factoring in regional nuances and climate variations. This data-driven decision-making process enhances the precision of recommendations, optimizing agricultural outcomes. The holistic approach not only prevents crop failure but also empowers farmers with valuable insights, fostering knowledge enhancement for sustainable farming practices. Additionally, timely disease management is ensured through the early detection capabilities of the system, minimizing the impact of crop damage. Overall, this integrated solution aims to revolutionize agriculture by mitigating risks, improving productivity, and promoting environmentally conscious farming practices. The project endeavors to create a user-friendly platform tailored for farmers, aiming to empower them with precise guidance on crop selection and soil improvement.

articleTitle: IoT Activity Symphony: Harmonizing DBSCAN Clustering and t-SNE Visualization for Enhanced Recognition.
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study introduces the IoT Activity Symphony Framework, a new algorithm that combines t-SNE with DBSCAN to cluster data from the Internet of Things. Using a variety of datasets obtained from Kaggle, the system outperforms previous research by a wide margin, earning a Silhouette Score of 0.72 and a Davies-Bouldin Index of 1.08. This model is a huge step forward for IoT analytics thanks to its flexibility, optimised hyperparameters, and strong clustering abilities. In particular, the results of our comparison demonstrate the framework's competence in dealing with real-world situations, yielding useful information for anomaly identification and predictive maintenance. The study backs up the suggested technique and presents the framework as a useful resource for academics and professionals working with data from the Internet of Things. With the introduction of a novel clustering technique, this study adds to the developing area and demonstrates the promising future of practical applications in many IoT fields. Additional clustering techniques, real-time capabilities, and assessments in a variety of IoT application scenarios are also potential directions for future study. An encouraging development is the IoT Activity Symphony Framework, which opens the door to better comprehension and use of complicated IoT statistics.

Author Keywords: Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise(DBSCAN)

articleTitle: Effective Utilization of Existing Solar System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Aiming to improve agricultural output by addressing energy inefficiencies, this review paper investigates the application of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) technology to optimize the transmission of solar energy from solar pumps to farmers' residences. To maximize power generation, MPPT continuously modifies the operating point of solar panels. The paper also covers photovoltaic (PV) technology, which uses semiconductor materials to convert solar energy into direct current power, and energy harvesting systems, which use ambient energy from artificial or natural sources to power wireless devices. The Simulated Annealing (SA) algorithm, which maximizes dynamic tracking performance without requiring temperature or irradiance sensors, is used in the research to offer a unique MPPT approach. The suggested system consists of a PV array that is connected to a DC load via a boost converter. The SA algorithm regulates the converter's switching to determine the best operating point. The SA method improves system efficiency in quickly changing settings by simulating the annealing process in materials, which involves gradually cooling to obtain the global optimum solution. The MATLAB simulation results show that the SA-MPPT approach achieves 95% efficiency compared to the previous MPPT methods, which is a considerable improvement in system efficiency. The suggested technique efficiently extracts the maximum amount of electricity from solar panels, offering a reliable and effective way to harvest solar energy for use in agricultural applications.

articleTitle: IGBT based Solid-state PETC for HVDC Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel approach is presented to HVDC tap changers using power electronics technology. The traditional tap changer, typically based on mechanical mechanisms, is prone to wear and tear, and it can result in limited control precision. This is compensated by using IGBT as the power electronic switch for the tap changer. The proposed Power Electronic Tap Changer (PETC) offers several advantages over conventional solutions, including faster response times, precise control, reduced maintenance requirements, and improved reliability. The PETC leverages high-power semiconductor devices, such as insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), and advanced control algorithms to efficiently adjust the transformer's turn’s ratio. It provides the ability to dynamically adapt to varying load conditions, ensuring optimal performance and power quality in the HVDC system.

articleTitle: Ensemble Machine Learning Models for Accurate Prediction of Acute Pancreatitis Risk
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Acute pancreatitis is a potentially life-threatening condition characterized by inflammation of the pancreas, often requiring prompt diagnosis and management. Early and accurate prediction of acute pancreatitis risk can significantly improve clinical outcomes and resource allocation. This research proposes the development of ensemble machine learning models for accurate prediction of acute pancreatitis risk. By leveraging a comprehensive dataset of electronic health records and clinical data, we employ a systematic feature engineering process to extract relevant predictive features. Subsequently, we design and evaluate various ensemble techniques, including random forests, gradient boosting, and stacking models, to combine the strengths of multiple base learners. Extensive experiments are conducted to assess the performance of the proposed models using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC. Furthermore, we analyse the feature importance and interpretability of the models to gain insights into the critical risk factors contributing to acute pancreatitis. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed ensemble approach in outperforming individual base learners and existing baseline methods for acute pancreatitis risk prediction, paving the way for improved clinical decision support and early intervention strategies.

articleTitle: LDA-OOBO Based Dimensionality Reduction and Classification Using Hybrid BiGRU-MLP for Web Based Cyber-Attack Prediction in Industrial System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cyberattacks have increased, posing significant threats to economies, enterprises, infrastructure and as well as to individual users. More than 430 million new, distinct malware components were found by Symantec. Since cyber-security threats are becoming more diverse and unexpected, traditional cyber-attack detection systems are facing several serious challenges as they process massive amounts of data. These challenges include inappropriate feature extraction and selection, lengthy prediction computation times, and erroneous classification models. In this paper, study of web-based cyberattack detection in industrial systems has been done. The proposed architecture gathers and compiles the website log files into a dataset. These gathered datasets are pre-processed using Generative Adversarial Imputation Net (GAIN) to impute the missing values in the raw dataset. Next, they are examined to choose characteristics from the dataset using the LDA with one-to-one based optimization technique. Anticipated the cyberattack by applying the Bilateral-Gated Recurrent Unit Network (BIGRU-MLP) approach. Evaluated Performance indicators like Accuracy, Error, Precision and recall values are 98.91%, 1.09%, 99.01% and 98.80%. The results clearly shows that the proposed BiGRU-MLP approach is one of the optimal approaches for Web-based cyberattack detection in industrial systems.

articleTitle: Modelling Of Fusion Artificial Neural Networks For Assessment Of Air Pollution In Smart City Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Escalating impact of human action, industrial development and urban expansion has given rise to critical global issue: air pollution. This pressing concern has significant menace in the welfare of individuals in numerous countries. Among the various contaminants of air, Particulate Matter having a width less than 2.5µm (PM2.5) stands out as particularly menacing hazard. PM2.5 is connected with severe health issues, including lung and cardiovascular diseases. Consequently, it has become imperative to develop precise predictive models for PM2.5 concentrations, allowing for early intervention to safeguard the population from the perilous consequences of contaminated air. The fluctuation of PM2.5 levels are affected by a multitude of factors, including meteorological conditions as well as concentrations of additional contaminants within the city region. Current research work has undertaken the task of forecasting hourly PM2.5 concentrations in New Delhi, India, utilizing a deep learning (DL) approach. Specifically, we have employed a CNN-LSTM model, which incorporates space-time features through combining past information about contaminants, climatic records as well as PM2.5 concentrations from neighboring monitoring stations. Our study also entails a comparative analysis of various DL algorithms, encompassing, a hybrid CNN-LSTM, Bi-GRU, Bi-LSTM, GRU, CNN, and LSTM model. The outcomes of these experiments unequivocally demonstrate the proposed technique, the "hybrid CNN-LSTM multivariate" model, consistently outperforms all the traditional models listed, delivering superior predictive accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Automated Depressive Disorder Classification using Optimized CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Due to a lack of early treatment options and resources for depression detection, millions of people suffer from mental illness. It is the primary cause of sleep disorders, bipolar illness, anxiety disorders, and occasionally, self-harm and suicide. Therefore, identifying those who are experiencing mental health illnesses and getting them treated as soon as feasible is an extremely difficult endeavour. An improved deep learning Architecture (ODLA) intended for the identification and categorization of major depressive disorders is presented in this paper. The Optimized Convolutional Neural Network—Long Short-Term Memory (O-CNN-LSTM) is the name of this suggested model. The suggested methodology is applied to merge textual and auditory aspects of patient replies. The DAIC-WoZ database is used to verify the behavioural characteristics of patients with depression. The classifier is used to train the features in the proposed model. With Fire Hawks Optimization (FHO), the hyper parameters of the classifier are chosen. The suggested approach is put into practice in MATLAB, and results are assessed. It is then contrasted with traditional methods.

articleTitle: OCR-Based Extraction of Expiry Dates and Batch Numbers in Medicine Packaging for Error-Free Data Entry
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: To guarantee patient safety and regulatory compliance, healthcare providers must accurately enter batch numbers and expiration dates from drug packaging. But manual entry is prone to mistakes, which could have unfavourable effects. This project suggests an automated method for extracting batch numbers and expiration dates from the back of pharmaceutical packaging by using optical character recognition (OCR) technology. In order to improve OCR accuracy, the research makes use of preprocessing techniques and a broad dataset of photos from medical packaging. The retrieved text is analysed to determine the batch number and expiration date, and data correctness is ensured by validation procedures. The end product solution reduces errors in healthcare data management by offering an intuitive user interface for effective data extraction. By means of thorough inspection and evaluation, The experiment shows how the OCR-based system can reliably and effectively extract important information from pharmaceutical packaging. Through the reduction of data entry errors and the facilitation of error-free information retrieval from drug packaging, this effort seeks to improve patient safety and streamline healthcare procedures.

articleTitle: Detection of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Using Clinical Data and Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a hormonal issue that occurs in women of adulthood. The World Health Organization (WHO) has identified PCOS as a prevalent endocrine illness that affects around 10% of women globally. It can result in various health complications, which includes infertility, metabolic complications such as insulin resistance, obesity, as well as cardiovascular problems, sleep apnea, endometrial cancer, and psychological disorders like anxiety and depression. Hence early diagnosis of PCOS is crucial. One of the diagnosis methods used for its detection is the Rotterdam criteria or Consensus. This diagnostic approach includes three criteria: Oligovulation or anovulation, presence of hyperandrogenism, and the identification of polycystic ovaries through ultrasound examination. Patients who meet two or more of these criteria can be diagnosed with PCOS. Cysts may indicate Polycystic Ovarian Disease (PCOD), a condition similar to PCOS. In PCOD, the ovaries release numerous immature or partially-mature eggs, which can develop into cysts over time. Among the numerous available techniques in the machine learning domain, only one criterion is typically assessed at a time, either clinical data or ultrasound, but not both simultaneously. The proposed system considers both and has two sections to aid in this process—one for detection through images and the other through clinical data. The dataset for the system includes 781 PCOS and 1143 Non-PCOS images, as well as clinical data from 541 patients, including 177 with PCOS and 43 features collected from open sources. Several models and techniques are used for the detection individually. A novel feature selection approach for CS-PCOS is employed, utilizing an optimized chi-squared mechanism. Additionally, overfitting is assessed using ten-fold cross-validation. Different pre-trained models are tried out for ultrasound images and the best is taken. Random forest is considered the best model for clinical data with an accuracy of 90.72% while Inception V3 is considered the best model with 99.64% for images. The both divisions yield high-accuracy results separately and can reduce false positives together. Both the outputs are compared and it is predicted whether the person has PCOS, has more likelihood for PCOS/PCOD or does not have PCOS. The system’s output can speed up diagnosis and aid in early detection of PCOS.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based Storage Solutions for Facial Recognition Attendance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Automated Attendance System Using Face Recognition presents a resolution for attendance supervision, by utilizing the power of facial recognition technology to automate the tracking process. This innovative system is proposed to improve attendance recording in diverse sectors such as education, corporate, and beyond, by automating the identification process with the best precision and efficiency. Through the integration of compact yet sophisticated algorithms, the system not only delivers seamless attendance tracking but also prioritizes the security and confidentiality of sensitive data, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations with the help of cloud storage. This comprehensive report delves into the development, functionality, implementation strategies, and prospects of the Face Attendance System, highlighting its potential to rewrite the traditional attendance management paradigms and improve organizational efficiency. Using machine learning and many other technologies it is made possible to take attendance using computer vision and related tools. The system provides a complete solution for proxy attendance.

articleTitle: The Future Charged: Optimizing Electric Vehicle Performance through Advanced Power Management Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: EVs have emerged as a viable way to tackle environmental issues and decrease reliance on fossil fuels in the transportation industry. This study examines the enhancement of EV performance by using sophisticated power management systems. Our objective was to improve energy efficiency, increase range, and boost overall performance by using predictive control algorithms, adaptive charging techniques, vehicle-to-grid integration, and hybrid energy storage systems. The simulation results showed notable progress in energy efficiency, as seen by a projected enhancement to 97%, an expansion of the range to 45 miles, and a decrease in charging time by 15% in comparison to the preceding years. The aforementioned results highlight the significant impact that sophisticated power management systems may have on the development of electric transportation, hence contributing to the establishment of a transportation system that is both sustainable and robust.

articleTitle: Unified Precision Farming: Advancing Crop Yield Prediction Using WSN and Edge Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Crop growth can be predicted based on rough estimation by farmers till now which results some time wrong calculations. Due to wrong prediction by their experiences and natural problems they could not succeed much in production. Several computer based solutions are available to predict crop stages from sowing to final harvesting. To give more accuracy in crop yield prediction scheme proposed a technology which comprises of WSN, UAV, Prediction algorithms and edge technology. Zigbee used to manage low data rates and low power consumption along with mess topology to communicate sensor nodes quickly and UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) is being used to kill dangerous insects in the crop with the help of sensor nodes connected to it. Model has been implemented extended Hybrid algorithms in sensor network for its connection processing. Finally the results are stored in cloud and the same analyzed to predict accuracy using both learning technique belongs to supervised and unsupervised. The final outcome of crop yield prediction using implemented model is 93 % accurate when compare to other existing model.

articleTitle: Cyber Attack Prevention Method for Enhanced Privacy of Patients Digital Healthcare Data in Smart Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: As the healthcare sector continues to become more digital, the security and protection of sensitive data has become a key concern. This article presents an innovative approach to securely identify anonymous employees and patients in smart hospitals by implementing robust security measures. A two-factor authentication process using One Time Password (OTP) and CAPTCHA is integrated into the proposed system. This reduces the potential risk of unauthorized access and prevents anonymous users from spamming the registry. To increase the security of stored credentials, password encryption techniques are implemented to convert sensitive information into an unreadable format. This ensures the confidentiality of passwords stored in the database. Additionally, the proposed system provides an export feature that allows authorized personnel to access and securely transfer the information. This feature is implemented using strict access controls and encryption protocols. In this model, selected sensitive data is also hidden from administrators. This research contributes to ongoing efforts to improve digital security and provides a model that can be adapted and implemented in healthcare systems to maintain data integrity and privacy. A model that emphasizes the balance between safety and ease of use.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Physical Activity Intensity from Wearable Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper aims to establish a robust machine learning approach for accurately categorizing the level of physical activity based on data collected from wearable sensors. Data from more than 10,000 participants was gathered through the utilization of sensors embedded in smartphones and smartwatches. These sensors include accelerometers, gyroscopes, and heart rate monitors. The acquisition of critical attributes, such as heart rate metrics, spectral entropy, and variance, involves meticulous feature engineering and thorough preprocessing. These measures effectively capture the temporal and spectral aspects of physical activity. An ensemble model is constructed using Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM) to achieve precise predictions of activity intensity categories. The GBM model consistently maintains accuracy levels above 99% for all types of physical activity, ranging from moderate to vigorous, sedentary, and mild. In order to ensure the model's robustness and prevent overfitting, hyperparameter optimization is conducted through k-fold cross-validation. The findings demonstrate the impressive precision with which machine learning algorithms classify activities. The implications can have far-reaching effects on the promotion of physical activity and the improvement of health outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Classification of Gravitational Wave Images using CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The discovery of gravitational waves resulting from the merger of binary black holes revolutionized physics and astronomy. Amid signal complexity and noise capture, data performance is critical. This work presents a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm using real-time data from the "Gravity Spy" dataset at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/tentotheminus9/gravity-spy-gravitational-waves. A combination of CNN model and Fourier transform accuracy of gravitational wave signal expression. It is worth noting that frequency domain signal analysis is better than time domain signal analysis in capturing signal characteristics. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CNN in improving signal recognition by achieving an accuracy of 94.63%. This research helps advance the exploration of the void by proposing a deeper study, thus promoting a deeper understanding of astrophysical phenomena.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Flood Detection System Using Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Floods cause immense damage worldwide, resulting in significant financial losses and loss of life. Existing flood detection methods often face limitations, including delays and errors due to manual data interpretation and limited coverage. In this study, we propose a novel flood detection system that leverages deep learning techniques for semantic segmentation. Our system employs a U-Net architecture to analyze aerial and satellite images, identifying flood-affected areas at a pixel level. Trained on a diverse dataset of labeled flood images from various regions, our model is both robust and adaptable. Notably, our system achieves an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.85, surpassing traditional methods in accuracy. This advanced system offers the potential to provide real-time flood information, enhancing disaster response and management. With real-time flood mapping, emergency services can better understand the disaster’s scope and plan rescue operations more effectively. Improved emergency response and resource management become possible with timely, precise data on flooded areas, allowing for informed decisions regarding evacuation, relief distribution, and infrastructure maintenance. Future work will focus on integrating additional data sources, such as weather conditions and water flow rates, to further enhance system performance.

articleTitle: Campus-Nest: Synergizing Student Sojourns Through Seamlessly Streamlined Accommodation Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a significant surge in the number of individuals opting to study abroad, leading to a substantial increase in the challenges associated with finding affordable and conveniently located housing near their educational institutions and essential amenities. Recognizing this pressing issue, we have developed a web application dedicated to simplifying the accommodation search for students The platform extends to students a comprehensive array of housing possibilities meticulously aligned with their distinct prerequisites. These criteria encompass factors like geographical location, budgetary

articleTitle: Experience Replay: A value-based deep reinforcement approach for Malicious URL Detection in the Tor Browser
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Finding malicious URLs in Tor is vital for preserving network security and privacy. Subsequently, Tor affords anonymity by routing traffic over a sequence of relays, it's frequently used for both legitimate and illegitimate reasons. Malicious URLs can lead to various threats, including phishing, malware distribution and illegal activities. Malicious URLs can lead users to websites hosting malware, which can compromise their devices and steal sensitive information. This article explores the discovery of malicious URLs through the ML and DL concepts. By utilizing the techniques such as Correlation-based Feature Selection, Chi-Square Test, Principal Component Analysis and Linear Discriminant Analysis, key features which are contributing to URL detection can be identified. Implementation of KNN, K Means, Random Forest, DQN and DDQN algorithms offers intuitions into how malicious URLs are recognized and alleviates possible cyber threats efficiently. The objective of this work includes, the idea of applying the deep reinforcement learning methods in which can pave the way to surge the accuracy of detection of the URL. It also stretches an idea for employing the deep reinforcement learning techniques for the chosen dataset.

articleTitle: Predict Solar Panel Power Production Using Weather Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Solar energy is one of the widely used renewable energy in homes and industries and could replace fossil fuels. Frequently changing weather conditions are the main factor that affects solar power generation. Sri Lanka is a tropical country that is affected by unpredictable weather conditions. It is situated very near to the equator and receives more sunlight. Many solar panel users in Sri Lanka generate electricity for ordinary households and industrial purposes. Solar panel users must rely on fossil fuel energy when solar power generation decreases. It increases the load on the main grid.This research focuses on how weather conditions affect solar panel productivity and how solar panel users can use renewable energy in an efficient way using accurate weather prediction systems. Weather data and solar panel energy production data were collected and analyzed for this research. A Google form was distributed to the solar panel users to collect data about the weather prediction systems that are used to estimate solar panel power production. First, the correlation between weather conditions and solar energy production was analyzed. A Neural Network(NN) and the SARIMA algorithm are used to create the weather prediction system and compare the accuracy. Then, the weather prediction system is used to identify the increment and decrement in solar panel power production. This research aims to transform the weather prediction system into a solar power prediction system and use solar power efficiently to manage the load on the main grid.

articleTitle: Secure Social Healthcare System Over Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The increasing reliance on e-healthcare systems, especially within cloud environments, has prompted concerns regarding the susceptibility of patient health records to insider attacks. These attacks pose a substantial risk, potentially resulting in the manipulation of health records, unauthorized data usage, and significant financial losses stemming from data breaches. Furthermore, healthcare institutions face legal and reputational repercussions, underscoring the crucial need for effective detection methods. Here it aims to address the pressing requirement for securing e-healthcare systems by introducing an innovative framework for identifying insider attacks. The proposed approach integrates watermarking extraction and logging detection techniques to distinguish between lawful and unlawful intrusions into the system. An audit trail is implemented to monitor user activities, creating a comprehensive record for subsequent analysis. The evaluation of the framework demonstrates outstanding precision, recall, and accuracy, establishing it as a robust solution for mitigating insider threats in Cloud-based Healthcare systems. The implementation employs practical software tools such as HeidSQL and NetBeans IDE 7.4, showcasing its feasibility and accessibility for adoption in real-world scenarios. The suggested framework signifies a notable advancement in securing e-healthcare systems, addressing the potential ramifications of misinformation in patient health records and its subsequent impact on individual treatments and outcomes. By bolstering detection capabilities, this research contributes to the overall resilience of healthcare systems operating in cloud environments.

articleTitle: Efficiency Reinvented: A Pioneering MPPT Algorithm For Unprecedented Solar Power Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Non-conventional power sources are becoming more popular due to energy crises and rising energy use. To address growing energy concerns and meet the expanding demand for electricity, renewable energy sources have so gained attention. Photovoltaic (PV) solar energy systems are an important part of the solution because of their amazing benefits, which include abundance and safety. The inverters that are being used ought to efficiently harness the entire power output of the PV solar system and seamlessly feed that energy into the utility grid, all while avoiding any additional constraints. Advancements in MPPT techniques are necessary to improve energy conversion efficiency, as the importance of solar power as a sustainable energy source grows. This study offers a thorough analysis of using the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) approaches, including P&O, Incremental Conductance (INC), and Hill Climbing, highlighting the merits and limitations of each to optimize PV system power generation. A thorough analysis of these algorithms highlights common drawbacks that add to system complexity and expense, such as sensitivity to changing environmental conditions, convergence problems, and the need for additional sensors. Building on this in-depth analysis, the study concludes that a novel MPPT algorithm is required in order to solve these inadequacies and keep up with the rapidly changing field of solar energy applications. This endeavor aims to significantly contribute to the optimization of solar PV systems by pushing the boundaries of MPPT techniques, ultimately encouraging more cost-effective and efficient renewable energy solutions for a sustainable future.

articleTitle: Enhancing AI Proctoring System Using Various ML Models
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Online exams have been the most popular in all educational sectors during the past year because of COVID-19. But proctoring methods are proving to be quite problematic for the universities. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based proctoring technologies automate the monitoring process in this project, doing away with the necessity for human superintendence. When several tests need to be given at the same time, this can increase efficiency and scalability. The project uses ArcFace for accurate facial recognition and YOLO for real-time object detection to provide a complete and effective online test monitoring solution. This multi-modal strategy improves the accuracy of identity verification, identifies things that are not permitted, and adjusts to new security risks. The system provides a strong solution for preserving the integrity of online assessments, prioritizing user privacy, integrating easily with learning management systems, and surpassing current models in terms of speed, scalability, and overall effectiveness. Exam proctors and exam candidate will find it easy to use the user-friendly interfaces of the proctoring system. It will allow the proctor to intervene if needed and provide the test-taker with immediate feedback, including alerts for questionable behavior. The suggested model outperforms other current models by 2.26% when tested using a variety of assessment matrices.

articleTitle: Identification of Missing Gate Faults in Reversible Circuits by a Unity Method
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Reversible computing offers a remarkable capability of minimizing heat dissipation in computing systems. The primary advantage lies in its potential to mitigate heat dissipation in computing machinery. This paper describes an approach for recognizing missing gate faults (MGFs) in reversible circuits. The approach that has been put forward utilizes the unity method to effectively identify all types of MGFs—single, multiple, partial, and repeated gate faults. In this work, the unity method generates the single test pattern at the initial level of the circuit using a backtracking process that undergoes generation and conversion of the unity test pattern to an augmented test pattern, which is further reconstructed. A generated test pattern is crucial for pinpointing respective faults, resulting in a significant reduction in computational overhead. Through experimentation on several reversible benchmark circuits, we validate the efficacy of our approach and also provide a correlative evaluation of the existing work.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Feature Extraction Techniques for Human Activity Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: A comprehensive analysis of feature extraction techniques used in deep learning(DL) based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) across multiple domains such as healthcare, security, and sports were discussed in this article. DL techniques have demonstrated significant improvements in accuracy and resilience over traditional machine learning (ML) methods. Feature extraction is a crucial component of any activity recognition system, essential for determining the final classification outcome. Its primary goal is to capture shared attributes within images from the same class of activities. The term “feature” refers to information derived from raw images using various techniques. The complexity of feature extraction and the quantity of features needed directly affect the performance of activity recognition systems. This paper reviews various methods for feature extraction in HAR systems using DL. HAR systems are vital in several domains, such as healthcare, security surveillance, and human-computer interaction. The process of HAR involves several steps: first, data preprocessing is performed, followed by the extraction of spatial and temporal features (STF). These features are then merged and input into a classifier for activity recognition. According to the review, using CNN for feature extraction yields an accuracy of 98.74%.

articleTitle: SoulEase : AI Enhanced Personal Journal - Text Based Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Self-management is an art of managing your thoughts, feelings and actions that helps you achieve goals in life. In today’s expeditious world individual’s often struggle to maintain equilibrium between their personal life and work. The proposed web application uses NLP to evaluate the user behavior and mood and prepare a customized routine that balances productivity and rest by dynamically scheduling user’s tasks. Current NLP based systems for assessing behavior and mood lack the capacity for thorough and flexible scheduling. It also involves libraries like NLTK. TensorFlow is used which is a machine learning model used to personalize suggestions. The web application analyses journals entered by user using NLP and detect user’s emotions. The application gives AI generated prompts for completing their journal. When user enters their daily tasks, this application analyses the previous works of user and plan a daily schedule for them. The application also motivates them to complete their tasks by AI-generated positive affirmations through email. It analyses user’s answers of questionnaires designed for stress assessment. This model can take audio, video journaling. The web application integrates with calendar events by using google calendar API. It uses google analytics for mood tracking and analytics. The functionality of the application would be supported by strong frontend and backend architectures that make use of ReactJS for frontend and Node.js, MySQL, Firebase, for backend. The proposed app can improve sentiment analysis and it is a unique combination of different features and is expected to be 2% higher than any existing models.

articleTitle: A Detailed Analysis of Cloud Storage and Key Management Techniques in IoT Driven Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) technology has revolutionized smart grid settings, enhancing efficiency and enabling advanced data analytics. However, the integration of IoT devices within smart grids introduces significant challenges related to data storage and security. This survey provides a comprehensive review of the various classifiers and optimization algorithms employed to enhance cloud storage solutions and key management systems within smart grid environments. Moreover, it symmetrically examines different classifiers, like Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) methods, which are designed for managing cryptographic keys, focusing on their ability to secure communications, authenticate devices, and ensure data integrity in the presence of cyber threats. Additionally, it categorizes and evaluates a wide range of optimization methods, including evolutionary algorithms, particle swarm optimization (PSO), gray wolf optimization (GWO) and firefly algorithm (FFA) based techniques for optimizing the classifiers, highlighting their applicability in optimizing storage capacities, data retrieval speeds, and cost-effectiveness. By synthesizing recent advancements and comparing the efficacy of these techniques, the survey identifies the best individuals and emerging trends that promise to strengthen the resilience and efficiency of IoT-enabled smart grids. The findings promote the critical role of integrated classifiers and optimization techniques in achieving scalable, secure, and reliable smart grid infrastructures.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Strategies for Cyber Crime Attack Prevention Harnessing the Power of Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Cybercrime is a major concern in today's cyber world, and immediate action must be taken to prevent it. Traditional cybersecurity systems are vulnerable to acclimatization issues, a high percentage of false positive alerts, and so forth. To address these problems, the study proposes a cutting-edge technique that blends CNNs with transmission characteristics for anti-cybercrime policy. The CN-based system is designed to retrieve network traffic data in real-time, with the reliability of identified hostile activity proportional to the minimizing of false alarms. The system includes components such as data collection and preprocessing, CNN architecture design, training, real-time analysis, and adaptation to emerging threats. Superior performance characteristics can be seen in comparison to existing systems, including 0.90-0.92 greater accuracy, 0.89-0.94 precision, 0.97-0.98 recall, and 0.98-0.93 F1-score with a ROC AUC score of 0.97. Furthermore, the proposed system has faster detection speeds (1200 packets per second) and lower false positive rates for various cyber threat types such as malware (0.03), phishing assaults (0.05), and DDoS attacks (0.02). Thus, the proposed system represents a big step forward in the evolution of cyber security, adopting more active threat identification and mitigation, thereby strengthening existing network security and exposing it to fewer threats.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Applications in Azure for Enhanced E-commerce Customer Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study performs both qualitative and quantitative examination of sentiment analysis applied to the E-Commerce platforms with machine learning technologies being the main component which are run on Microsoft Azure cloud Through a high focus on customers’ emotional targets and feedback, it is assumed that this study will follow the effects of sentiment analysis on e-commerce businesses in general. According to our analysis from the leading e-commerce A-to-Z and grocery companies in India for the past three years through the power of machine learning on Azure we are able to weave intelligence into your solutions. The work describes the final research that globalizes sentiment analysis in the process of preceding customers’ interaction. Moreover, another point of discussion revolves around possibility of the advantages, including weaknesses, that come from conducting reviews of online customers. The research which encompasses this provides the significant contribution on exploiting machine learning for doing the improvement of e-commerce experience with the in depth analysis of sentiment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Proactive Phishing Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Phishing attacks remain a serious problem in cybersecurity, necessitating advances in detection methods. The study describes a novel method for detecting phishing attacks that use advanced machine learning (ML) techniques, notably convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs). CNNs and RNNs were chosen because of their ability to detect spatial and sequential patterns in phishing data. The system achieves improved performance by iterative model refinement and ensemble learning, beating existing rule-based systems in terms of precision (96%), recall (94%), and F1-score (95%). Furthermore, the proposed strategy has significantly lower false positive (3.8%) and false negative (5.7%) rates than existing systems, indicating greater dependability in distinguishing between legitimate and malicious emails. Cross-validation validates that the proposed system is stable and ready for real-world use. As a result, the proposed ML-driven strategy represents a substantial leap in phishing detection, providing increased accuracy (F1-score: 95%) and resilience to emerging cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Real-Time Periocular Based Face Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper presents a stable technique for extracting periocular characteristics from photographs, with an emphasis on critical regions such as eye outlines and their environs. Our technique, which employs edge detection, Gabor filters, and Local Binary Patterns (LBP), accurately captures differentiating periocular properties required for security systems. It properly deals with issues including illumination differences, occlusions, and accessories. In addition, the system has a face identification component optimized for congested situations, which can recognize numerous faces and provide a count of those spotted. Experimental evaluations validate the algorithm’s efficacy, highlighting its potential for biometric authentication and monitoring. Detecting and counting faces in crowded environments provides vital information about crowd control, safety, and operational efficiency in a variety of scenarios.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Decisions: Integrating Machine Learning into Human Resource and Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Efficient human resource (HR) and finance management in today’s fast-paced corporate environment relies on data-driven decisions to maximize resource allocation and increase operational effectiveness. Traditional systems are vulnerable to overlooked possibilities and inefficiency due to the reliance on human processes and limited data. The study proposes a comprehensive method using Machine Learning (ML) to address these difficulties. The system uses scalable ML algorithms to evaluate large datasets, forecast trends, and optimize resource allocation for HR and finance management. With algorithmic transparency and real-time monitoring, the proposed system improves operational performance, decision accuracy, and transparency. When compared to existing methods, the results indicate considerable improvements in attrition prediction (70% accuracy), budget forecasting (90% accuracy), and market trend prediction (88% accuracy). Even when continual optimization is required, incorporating ML delivers significant benefits in decision-making and resource allocation efficiency. To summarize, bringing ML into HR and finance management represents a revolutionary step toward operational excellence and data-driven strategic decision-making.

articleTitle: Smart Farming Based Early Classification of Paddy Blast Disease Using Adaptive Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The backbone of the Indian economy, agriculture is essential to Indians' standard way of life. Plant disease monitoring by hand typically involves a tremendous labor and takes more time to perform. The primary goal of this research is to help farmers, particularly those who are dealing with blast disease in rice crops, by quickly and reliably detecting plant diseases. The primary goal of the research is to catalog the diseases that affect rice and identify crop infections early on. Therefore, the development of soft computing and image processing technologies for smart agriculture applications is the subject of this research study, with a special emphasis on applications in innovative design for the detection of diseases in rice. The key methods of analysis used include preprocessing, classification, feature extraction, and picture acquisition. The lands used for agriculture are the source of input images. Dmey wavelet filtering is the first step in the pre-processing procedure which removes noise from images. Next, image-based crop feature extraction techniques are utilized to perform an extensive study. The proposal is to use the Adaptive deep neural network (ADNN) to address the overlapping issue. In ADNN, the total accuracy is 97.3%. A wide range of rice blast diseases are correctly identified with the desired accuracy, regardless of the obscured settings, according to the evaluation results of the suggested method.

articleTitle: Optimizing Solar PV Systems: Balancing Cost and Efficiency for Sustainable Energy Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The solar photovoltaic (PV) technology is a fundamental pillar in the worldwide quest for sustainable energy solutions. Considering the performance and efficiency of the PV panels, it is pivotal to understand the different factors that affect PV panels operation. This study focuses on the main factors that affect the PV system performance such as material properties, system design factors and cost effects. Crystalline material used to make PV panels exhibit electrical characteristics, examining these improves the open circuit voltage (Voc) and efficiency of the PV panel, these characteristics were clearly examined in this study. Examining these provides us insights of the ideal materials to use in the production of PV panels. Effects of Lithium-ion concentration on cell performance, temperature dependency of PV system parameters, and mismatch factor (M-factor) among various PV system technologies were thoroughly examined in this study. This study also examined the complexities such as capital outlay and integration of energy storage systems required in the implementation of PV system. By performing an extensive analysis on cost-effectiveness and performance aspects related to different system elements, this research attempts to give useful suggestions for optimizing PV system design and operation.This paper provides a holistic view on the factors influencing the performance and efficiency of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems in sustainability. Evaluation of M-factor values within various PV cell categories reveals matching with respect to incident light spectrum that can be used for efficient solar power generation and advancing renewable energy technologies.

articleTitle: HarvestHub: Mobile Agricultural Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This project aims to develop a web application addressing challenges in agricultural marketing, leveraging technology to connect farmers directly with buyers. Recognizing technology’s pervasive role and potential impact, the project seeks to create a user-friendly platform for agricultural trade.The project will employ a comprehensive approach, considering technical development and socio-economic contexts. It begins with analysis of existing systems, informed by literature review and consultations. Iterative cycles of design, implementation, and testing guided by user feedback will be conducted. Key features include support for a local language, secure payments, customizable categorization, and intuitive interface design.The project aims to produce a web application tailored for agricultural marketing. It will provide farmers a platform to showcase products and offer buyers convenient access. By streamlining processes, the application intends to enhance market access, improve transparency, and contribute to sector growth and sustainability.Driven by a commitment to leveraging technology for social good, this project seeks to empower farmers and promote economic development. Through stakeholder collaboration and ongoing evaluation, it aims for sustainability and scalability.

articleTitle: Velocity control of Voice Coil Actuator using Field Programmable Gate Array
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Voice Coil Actuators (VCA) find extensive applications across various domains such as loudspeakers, disk drives, and optical storage devices. Achieving precise velocity regulation poses a significant hurdle in effectively controlling VCA. This challenge arises due to the inherent dynamism and complex nonlinear attributes of VCA. This paper introduces an innovative FPGA-based velocity controller tailored specifically for VCA. The proposed controller integrates a dual-control approach comprising feedforward and feedback mechanisms to realize accurate velocity regulation. The feedforward component leverages a VCA model to anticipate its velocity based on the input current. Conversely, the feedback mechanism employs a Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller to rectify discrepancies between the anticipated and actual velocities. Experimental assessment of the proposed controller was conducted on a prototype VCA system. The outcomes demonstrated the controller's capability to achieve precise velocity regulation, even in the presence of external disturbances. Moreover, the controller exhibited adeptness in accurately tracking intricate velocity profiles. Compared to conventional analog controllers, the FPGA-based velocity controller offers several advantages. The versatility of the proposed controller renders it well-suited for an array of applications spanning robotics, automation, and industrial control.

articleTitle: Zero-Day Threat Detection A Machine Learning Paradigm for Intrusion Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In today's constantly changing cybersecurity world, the demand for sophisticated intrusion prevention systems (IPS) capable of detecting zero-day threats is greater than ever. Traditional intrusion prevention systems (IPS) that rely on signature-based detection approaches frequently fail to detect fresh assaults. To solve these problems, the study presents a new machine learning (ML) methodology for detecting zero-day threats within IPS. The proposed system uses powerful ML methods, including supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, to monitor network traffic patterns and detect anomalous activity that may indicate a danger. The system outperforms existing systems in terms of precision (0.92), recall (0.88), and false positive rates (0.05), due to a hybrid method that combines supervised and unsupervised learning. Performance research revealed considerable improvements in detection accuracy (98%), throughput capacity (100 Gbps), and resource efficiency. The proposed system is a proactive defensive mechanism against developing cyber threats, providing scalable and adaptable security for important assets in dynamic network environments.

articleTitle: Impact of Machine Learning on Applying the Best Worst Method for Social Sustainability in Manufacturing Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This research is carried out merging ML with BWM to intensify decision making in manufacturing supply chain using social sustainability under light. As companies become more focused on environmental sustainability, the capability of machine learning to effectively assess and prioritize sustainability criteria should be highly valued. Through a team of domain experts, the research clearly identifies the most vital social sustainability factors and, afterwards, deploys ML algorithms to analyze and optimize the provided decision-making framework by BWM. The selected approach gives possibility to dynamic weighting of the criteria which is based on real-time data. This way we are able to come up with the more precise and effective sustainability strategies. The results show that the hybrid ML-BWM model is not only an effective tool to enhance the validity and accuracy of evaluations but also one that provides the prudent directions that help the manufacturing sector shape its choice and responses. This paper analyzes the possible outcome of the integration of AI and traditional approach to decision-making process on social aspects of sustainability within supply chain.

articleTitle: Unlocking Consumer Insights: Advanced Sentiment Analysis for Product Evaluation : Decoding Consumer Sentiments: Foundations of Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The paper goes through the sentiment analysis in product evaluation, covering foundational principles, the sentiment analysis in the products using different machine learning models, it goes through the challenges in sentiment analysis to the application of sentiment analysis, it covers implications. It reviews previous studies in sentiment analysis, introduces a balanced Twitter dataset, and outlines the methodology for training and evaluating sentiment analysis models. Results reveal the superior performance of a Random Forest classifier over a Multinomial Naive Bayes model, it discusses the application of sentiment analysis in product assessment, it highlights the role of sentiment analysis in understanding customer sentiments, it identifies the product strengths and weaknesses, and informs the decision-making in product development and marketing. The abstract emphasizes the transformative potential of sentiment analysis in guiding data-driven decision-making processes and the importance of continuous improvement for diverse product categories.

articleTitle: Modified Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm with Deep Learning for Pest Detection through Leveraging Pattern Recognition-based Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The limitations of manual inspection and simple algorithms highlight the need for advanced insect detection systems in agriculture. The study presents the Modified Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm with Deep Learning (MAHADL), a significant breakthrough in pest detection. MAHADL combines the speed and efficacy of the Artificial Hummingbird Algorithm (AHA) with deep learning models such as Recurrent and Convolutional Neural Networks. Combining pattern recognition with the fusion approach improves pest detection accuracy while reducing false positives and negatives. Accurate pest identification is essential for effective agricultural management, which MAHADL provides through data collection, preprocessing, and algorithmic integration. MAHADL outperforms existing systems in terms of accuracy (0.94), recall (0.95), precision (0.92), computational economy (12 hours of training time, 0.5 seconds/image inference time), and decrease in false positives and negatives. The innovative technique provides enhanced agricultural output and sustainability, representing a significant leap in intelligent pest management.

articleTitle: Mitigating Class Imbalance through Multimodal Fusion in VGG19 for Cataract Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Global analysis indicates a notable rise in non- infectious vision impairments, with India seeing a pronounced spike in cases. Numerous international investigations have shown that Indian populations face an elevated likelihood of developing cataracts, glaucoma, and even permanent blindness. This article puts forth a feasible solution for early cataract screening, tapping into state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence technologies to pinpoint potential cataract affliction. Remarkably, this was accomplished with tremendous computational efficiency—the VGG19 deep neural network model managed to train on a modest dataset of only 870 photographic images, yet still achieved excellent diagnostic performance with 99% accuracy. Though rudimentary, this preliminary AI framework demonstrates considerable promise to assist in cataract risk stratification and prevention efforts on a global scale, with particular utility in high-risk Indian communities. Additional research with more expansive datasets will further refine the precision and generalizability of the model across human populations. But these initial findings provide a crucial first step toward ameliorating worldwide visual morbidity using sophisticated decision-support tools.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for EEG Seizure Detection using CNN with Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Epileptic seizures are a significant agony for those who suffer from them. Epileptic studies primarily focus on understanding the abnormal behavior of brain signals. Detecting seizures in EEG signals manually is a very chaotic and challenging task. Therefore, we propose an automatic seizure detection system that drastically reduces the manual effort required for seizure detection while providing accurate results. The proposed method involves extracting twelve statistical features from segmented data and adjusting labels to facilitate binary classification using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The dataset is normalized and balanced using SMOTE to address class imbalance. Evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision and recall are computed on the test set with results visualized through accuracy and loss curves. User input allows for predictions on specific test data, determining the presence of seizures based on model predictions. This structured approach ensures reliable seizure detection through the use of advanced deep learning techniques and comprehensive model evaluation. Furthermore, a comparative study was conducted to assess the effectiveness of the proposed model against conventional machine learning algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Gradient Boosting and Decision Tree. Our analysis reveals that CNN consistently demonstrates superior performance compared to these methods.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Decision Tree Algorithm

articleTitle: Real-Time American Sign Language Gesture Recognition Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The study presents a novel approach to improving American Sign Language (ASL) recognition accuracy, which is vital for the hearing-impaired. Utilizing transfer learning with the MobileNetV2 architecture and optimized training, the model achieves high accuracy. With a dataset of 274,612 RGB images and rigorous pre-processing, training was expedited on Kaggle’s Dual GPU T4 infrastructure. The proposed approach utilizes the categorical cross-entropy loss function and the Stochastic Gradient Descent optimizer. It leverages the pre-trained features of MobileNetV2, fine-tuning them specifically for ASL recognition. Remarkable results include 99.82% training accuracy, 99.14% validation accuracy, and fast real-time processing (99 milliseconds per step). This robust model promises broader application in education, assistive devices, and communication aids, fostering inclusivity for the hearing-impaired. Future research may explore dialect and gesture variations for enhanced accessibility.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT) for variable load and wind flow directions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: To solve the world's energy problems, renewable energy sources are essential, and wind energy is becoming more and more of a viable option for producing electricity sustainably. In order to assess a vertical axis wind turbine's performance under various operating situations, we ran a number of tests in this study. We examined the impacts of wind angle, wind speed, and variable load on turbine RPM and power output through methodical research. The turbine's effectiveness in capturing wind energy was demonstrated by our findings, which showed a direct and proportional relationship between wind speed and turbine rotational speed. Furthermore, we saw that while the turbine would stop when the resistance to the load reached zero, the speed of the turbine increased, highlighting the crucial function that load regulation plays in turbine operation. Furthermore, changes in wind angle provided information about how well the turbine responded to shifting wind directions. Interestingly, unique cut-in and cut-out speeds were found, defining the functional operating range of the turbine. These findings add to our knowledge of the dynamics of vertical axis wind turbines and offer insightful information for maximizing turbine performance in renewable energy applications. Our analysis emphasizes how important it is to continue conducting research and development in order to advance wind energy technologies and move toward a sustainable energy future.

articleTitle: Development of an IoT-Enabled Smart Drainage and Health Monitoring System for Enhancing Safety and Efficiency of Manual Scavengers
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated IoT-based system to address the challenges faced by manual scavengers and improve overall drainage management in urban areas. The system consists of two key components: smart drainage monitoring, which uses an IoT-enabled network to track water flow, detect blockages, and trigger maintenance alerts to prevent overflows; and health monitoring of manual scavengers, where wearable IoT devices continuously monitor the vital signs, toxic gas exposure, and skin conditions of the vulnerable workforce. By combining smart drainage management and health monitoring, this system aims to enhance public sanitation, protect manual scavengers, and work towards the eradication of this inhumane practice. The paper discusses the system architecture, key technologies, and the potential societal impact of this integrated approach to addressing this critical public health and humanitarian issue.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Climate Change Adaptation and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Given the rapid pace of global climate change, it is crucial to develop practical solutions for both prevention and adaptation. The aim of this endeavor was to provide a comprehensive framework that would facilitate understanding and decrease the consequences of climate change. The platform has an advanced climate impact prediction model that precisely forecasts potential environmental consequences, temperature and sea level increases on the platform. Interactive climate simulations showcased several climatic scenarios and sophisticated climate data examination using interactive data visualization tools enable real-time scenario analysis that successfully communicated complicated climate data to users. While a Climate Change News Aggregator gathered important news and study to offer up-to-date details on the climate disaster, a customized carbon footprint calculator assesses individual environmental impacts and provides valuable recommendations for reducing carbon footprints. The Climate Resilient Infrastructure Planner can give useful tips for politicians and urban planners in building strong infrastructure projects. People and governments may be able to fight climate change with the help of new technology and easy-to-use tools. This study shows that we need a big plan to deal with and adapt to the effects of climate change. It also shows how important it is to keep working together and coming up with new ideas on this important topic.

articleTitle: Towards a Greener Future: Harnessing Green Computing to Reduce ICT Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: The escalating environmental impact of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) has raised concerns about its substantial carbon footprint. Green computing, a concept that focuses on minimizing the environmental impact of computing and IT infrastructure, has emerged as a promising approach to address this issue. This research paper investigates the potential of integrating green computing practices to curtail the environmental ramifications of ICT operations. Understanding the fundamental forces behind the adoption of green computing in business, industry, and government is crucial since ICTs are so critical to technical innovation, the economy, and environmental protection. By examining the principles and methodologies of green computing, this study aims to delineate its role in reducing energy consumption, minimizing e-waste, and fostering eco-friendly practices within the realm of information technology. Examined are the major implementation challenges and the global adoption of green computing. Through a comprehensive review of existing literature and case studies, this research assesses the efficacy of green computing strategies in mitigating the carbon footprint of ICT infrastructures. Furthermore, it evaluates the economic viability and long-term sustainability implications for businesses and society at large. ICT would be a bigger enhancer of productivity and utility with a global carbon limitation, offering opportunity for the industry to be financially successful as a crucial component of a global net zero society. The paper concludes by proposing recommendations for the seamless integration of green computing into ICT ecosystems, emphasizing the pivotal role of stakeholders in fostering a more sustainable digital landscape while simultaneously reducing carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Health Assistance System for Brain Disease Detection Using ML
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study examines the utilization of machine learning techniques for the diagnosis of multiple diseases, aiming to revolutionize diagnostic processes. This project contains detection of diseases such as Parkinson’s, Alzheimer, Mental Ailment and Stress Level. Leveraging diverse variety of datasets and using advanced algorithms, this research indulges into the development of a predictive model which is capable enough to identify the particular disease at it’s earliest stage and also classify such conditions. By examining various medical indicators, imaging data or information, and symptomatology, the proposed framework demonstrates promising accuracy in detecting abnormalities in the nervous system. Furthermore, this abstract also discusses about the stage of the disease, preferred remedies and therapies derived from the detected patterns, facilitating precautions and focused treatments. The combination of machine learning with medical diagnostics not only enhances early detection but also opens ways for personalized therapeutic strategies, treatments and potentially bringing a change in the management and cure of nervous disorders and abnormalities.

articleTitle: Mobile Marker-Based AR Children App for Learning Map
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Marker-based Augmented Reality (AR) technology has gained substantial attention in recent years due to its potential to enhance user interactions with the real world by overlaying digital content onto physical objects. This research paper presents a prototype mobile application of marker-based AR technology called MapEdu in the form of an interactive Indian map designed as an assistive technology for children. The primary objective of this study is to explore the feasibility and effectiveness of using marker-based AR within a mobile application to create an interactive and engaging learning experience for children, specifically focusing on the geographical and cultural aspects of India. The proposed mobile application aims to provide an educational platform that seamlessly blends digital text information with real-world geographic maps, enabling children to explore and learn about various states, cities, landmarks, and cultural elements of India. The findings of this paper highlights the benefits of interactive learning through AR, particularly in subjects that involve spatial and geographical concepts. The MapEdu application's effectiveness as an assistive technology for children can pave the way for the integration of AR into educational curricula, fostering a more immersive and engaging learning environment.

articleTitle: Integration Of Blockchain In Learning Management System(LMS) : A Secure Software for Learning Platform in Education and Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: In the current era of digital education, ensuring the security and confidentiality of user data within Learning Management Systems (LMS) is a critical concern. This project addresses this challenge by proposing the integration of blockchain technology into the architecture of an advanced LMS. The project aims to establish a secure and transparent framework for user authentication and data management, leveraging the decentralized and immutable nature of blockchain. By implementing blockchain technology, the project endeavors to fortify the LMS with robust security protocols and tamper-resistant authentication mechanisms, bolstering user trust and data integrity. The envisioned LMS platform will combine cutting-edge technologies to offer an intuitive user interface, seamless payment processing, optimized media streaming, and efficient data storage, catering to the evolving needs of educational institutions. Through the integration of blockchain, this project seeks to redefine the standards of security and transparency within LMS, contributing to a more secure and trustworthy online learning environment for educators and learners alike. The implementation of recent technologies ensures that the LMS platform meets the highest standards of performance, security, and scalability, thereby positioning it as a top-tier solution for institutions and organizations seeking to provide an exceptional online learning experience.

articleTitle: V2G-Enabled Electric School Buses for Grid Support and Peak Load Management
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: This study explores the possibility of replacing Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) enabled Electric school buses to reduce the diesel bus associated pollution without incurring additional costs. This analysis looks at how adding V2G technology to school bus fleets could benefit the environment by supporting grid during peak hours thus reducing the overall grid power consumption. The work also evaluates the proposed idea’s economic feasibility and considers potential grid service income streams to ascertain the viability of V2G-enabled Electric buses. A schedule with 3 modes of operation namely ) PV to EV ii) EV to grid ii) grid to EV is proposed and the mode switching is done using a State flow-based technique. A 24-hour simulation for incorporating the 3 modes of operation is also simulated. By examining both the environmental and economic aspects, this study provides light on the feasibility and effectiveness of using V2G-enabled Electric school buses as a sustainable transportation choice.

articleTitle: Implementation of Deep Learning Based Enhanced Resolution Paradigms for Medical Diagnostics: A Study
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
abstract: Medical imaging researchers frequently talk about the issue of super-resolution. Medical image resolution often remains unsatisfactory because of limitations in acquisition time, radiation dose, or hardware resources. The relevance of deep learning networks has accelerated computer vision development, dramatically improving medical imaging. Advanced deep learning algorithms have recently been habituated to address the finest resolution issues of images in medical diagnostics and have formed innovative results. This study explores the various super-resolution techniques proposed over the last five years.

articleTitle: Flood Detection on Adverse Natural Conditions using CatBoost algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 7th International Conference on Circuit Power and Computing Technologies (ICCPCT)
